prs.title: feat(channels): deliver GitHub events to PR-bound sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR connects the GitHub channel to the sessions that actually follow a PR. When a session has a PR binding (it created, reviewed, or verified the PR — the bindings shown in the Web Shell sidebar), GitHub events about that PR can now be delivered into that session as a prompt instead of always going to a channel-owned session. The injected prompt marks all GitHub content as untrusted event data, keeps the session's reply inside the session (nothing is auto-published to GitHub), and runs the same group/sender/pairing preflight as the normal channel path. A bound session that is dormant after a daemon restart is woken automatically for the delivery; only a truly deleted session falls back to the normal channel path. A full prompt queue is treated as backpressure and defers the event instead of consuming the retry budget.

A second, opt-in piece adds edge-triggered state watching for bound PRs inside the channel's existing poll cycle: CI failure on the PR head (named failed checks, once per head), merge-conflict appearance, head advancement, and merge/close transitions. Detection is API-level and spends no model tokens until a real transition fires; a steady-state PR costs one API call per poll, at most 30 bound PRs are watched, and transitions are persisted before dispatch so restarts never re-fire them. Incomplete binding snapshots (a workspace failed to list, or a scan cap was hit) never prune the persisted watch baseline.

Both features are controlled by two new GitHub channel settings, `deliverToBoundSessions` and `prWatchEvents`, both default off. Existing deployments are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

A user who follows a PR in a Qwen Code session gets no help from the GitHub channel today: the channel routes every event to its own `chat_thread` sessions, which have none of the following session's context, and the two session systems never meet. Worse, the events that matter most while a PR is in flight are invisible to the channel: a pure CI failure produces no comment and therefore no dispatch, and a merge conflict produces no GitHub notification at all. The result is that the session best placed to handle "CI is red on my PR" or "my PR now conflicts" never hears about it. This PR closes both gaps using infrastructure that already exists (PR bindings, the prompt queue, the channel poll loop), without changing the channel's public-reply contract for its own sessions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure a GitHub channel in a workspace's `.qwen/settings.json` with `"deliverToBoundSessions": true` and `"prWatchEvents": ["ci_failure", "merge_conflict", "head_change", "state_change"]`, start it under `qwen serve`, and create a session bound to an open PR (create the PR from the session, or `PATCH /session/:id/metadata` with `{"pr":{"number":N,"url":"...","state":"open"}}`).
2. Post a comment on the PR. Expected: the bound session receives one injected prompt containing the comment and the untrusted-data warning; no channel-owned session is created for the thread; nothing is posted back to GitHub automatically. With `groups.*.senders: "allowlist"`, a comment from a non-allowlisted author is dropped before delivery.
3. Turn the PR's checks red (or push a new head, make the PR conflict, merge it). Expected: one injected prompt per transition, naming the failed checks for CI; repeating the same state produces no repeat; restarting the daemon and re-observing the same state produces no re-fire, while a new transition after the restart still fires.
4. Remove the binding (delete the session record) and comment again. Expected: the event falls back to the normal channel path (channel session + public reply), i.e. today's behavior.
5. With both settings unset, confirm behavior and API call volume are unchanged (the worker never calls the new reverse-lookup route).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: events only ever reached channel-owned sessions; a pure CI failure or a merge conflict triggered nothing. After (isolated daemon + mock GitHub API, real Web Shell UI):

Comment event injected into the bound session — the prompt carries the PR identity and the untrusted-data warning, and the reply stays in the session:

![Bound session receives the comment event](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/github-bound-session-events/bound-session-comment-event.png)

CI failure transition injected into the same bound session, naming the failed check:

![Bound session receives the CI failure event](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/github-bound-session-events/bound-session-ci-failure-event.png)

The two new settings in the Web Shell channel editor (descriptor-driven, no UI code change):

![Channel editor showing the new fields](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/github-bound-session-events/channel-editor-new-fields.png)

In the run that produced these screenshots, `github-posts.jsonl` recorded zero public posts for the bound deliveries. Unit coverage at the current head: 4,299 tests green across `channels/base` (1652), `channels/github` (344), the cli worker/route/session suites (2172), the core PR-binding service (99), and the Web Shell channel editor (32), including gate enforcement, case-insensitive binding keys, partial-snapshot pruning guards, the CI grace window, wake error classification, queue backpressure, absence-deferral, tombstones, admission idempotency, and the relay-marker gate; 16 mutation checks (each fix reverted, its regression test red) all killed. An isolated-daemon E2E suite (23 planned steps plus a dormant-wake re-verification, 72 assertions) passed against a mock GitHub API; the post-review fix-round E2E re-verification was reported in a follow-up comment.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Local build (`npm run build && npm run bundle`, `node dist/cli.js serve`) on Alibaba Cloud Linux 3, Node v24.22.1; isolated `QWEN_HOME`/`QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` daemons with a zero-dependency mock GitHub API and mock OpenAI endpoint; Web Shell screenshots via chrome-headless-shell + CDP.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: GitHub content now reaches interactive sessions as prompts when an operator opts in. Mitigations: both settings default off; the same group/sender/pairing preflight as the channel path runs before bound delivery; payloads are explicitly marked untrusted; the target session's own approval mode governs its actions; replies are never auto-published. The state watch adds bounded API calls (≤30 watched PRs, one call per PR per poll at steady state, conditional check fetches with a 10-minute grace window for late-registering checks).
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows not tested locally; webhook push ingestion (the existing static-target webhook route is untouched), cross-session peer messaging for this path, and automatic PR binding of channel-created sessions are explicitly out of scope; standalone `qwen channel start` (non-daemon) degrades to today's behavior with a warning. The post-review E2E re-verification is still running and will be reported in a follow-up comment.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: **two existing route behaviors change.** (1) `POST /session/:id/load` and `/resume` answer `404 workspace_not_found` (previously `400 workspace_mismatch`) for an explicit `cwd` with no registry entry (a permanent absence); reversible states (draining/transitioning/blocked) keep the 400, and session **creation** (`POST /session`) is unchanged — a client branching on `400 workspace_mismatch` for load/resume should also handle `404 workspace_not_found`. (2) The channel-worker prompt authorization gained a process-level relay credential for cross-workspace bound delivery: classification in a foreign workspace requires the explicit `qwen.daemon.channelBoundRelay` intent marker in addition to a registered worker token and a primary/trusted target, while home-workspace turns keep the per-workspace predicate — a plain prompt carrying a foreign worker token stays an ordinary interactive prompt. The residual token-holder risk is documented in the design's Constraints and risks. The prompt route also accepts an optional additive `idempotencyKey` (repeated admissions of the same key deduplicate into the original 202). New route `GET /sessions/pr-bindings` is read-only and process-global; new channel settings default off; `ChannelBaseOptions.boundSessions` is optional and only the daemon worker provides it.

Design documents (bilingual, synchronized): [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/github-channel-bound-session-events/docs/design/2026-11-02-github-channel-bound-session-events.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/github-channel-bound-session-events/docs/design/2026-11-02-github-channel-bound-session-events.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 把 GitHub channel 与真正跟进 PR 的会话接通。当会话带有 PR 绑定（它创建、评审或验证过该 PR——即 Web Shell 侧栏显示的绑定）时，关于该 PR 的 GitHub 事件现在可以作为 prompt 投递进该会话，而不是总去 channel 自有的会话。注入的 prompt 把所有 GitHub 内容标记为不可信事件数据，会话的回复留在会话内（不会自动发布到 GitHub），并执行与正常 channel 路径相同的 group/sender/pairing 前置门禁。daemon 重启后处于休眠态的绑定会话会被自动唤醒接收投递；只有真正已删除的会话才回退到正常 channel 路径。prompt 队列满被视为背压，推迟事件而不是消耗重试预算。

第二个 opt-in 部分在 channel 既有轮询周期内为绑定 PR 增加边沿触发的状态监视：PR head 的 CI 失败（点名失败 check，每个 head 一次）、合并冲突出现、head 前进、合入/关闭迁移。判定在 API 层完成，真实迁移出现前不花模型 token；稳态下每个 PR 每轮询一次 API 调用，最多监视 30 个绑定 PR，迁移先持久化再投递，重启不会重放。不完整的绑定快照（某 workspace 列表失败或触及扫描上限）绝不会剪掉持久化的监视基线。

两个功能由两个新的 GitHub channel 设置控制：`deliverToBoundSessions` 与 `prWatchEvents`，均默认关闭。既有部署不受影响。

## 为什么需要

今天在 Qwen Code 会话里跟进 PR 的用户得不到 GitHub channel 的任何帮助：channel 把每个事件路由到它自己的 `chat_thread` 会话，那些会话没有跟进会话的任何上下文，两套会话体系互不相通。更糟的是，PR 进行中最关键的事件对 channel 不可见：纯 CI 失败不产生评论因此不产生投递，合并冲突根本不产生 GitHub 通知。结果是最适合处理「我的 PR CI 红了」「我的 PR 冲突了」的会话永远听不到消息。本 PR 用已有设施（PR 绑定、prompt 队列、channel 轮询循环）补齐这两个缺口，不改变 channel 自有会话的公开回复契约。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 workspace 的 `.qwen/settings.json` 配置 GitHub channel，开启 `"deliverToBoundSessions": true` 与 `"prWatchEvents": ["ci_failure", "merge_conflict", "head_change", "state_change"]`，在 `qwen serve` 下启动，并创建一个绑定到 open PR 的会话（从会话创建 PR，或 `PATCH /session/:id/metadata` 传 `{"pr":{"number":N,"url":"...","state":"open"}}`）。
2. 在 PR 上发评论。预期：绑定会话收到一条注入 prompt，含评论原文与不可信数据警告；不为该线程创建 channel 自有会话；不自动向 GitHub 发帖。配置 `groups.*.senders: "allowlist"` 时，非 allowlist 作者的评论在投递前被丢弃。
3. 把 PR 的 check 转红（或推新 head、制造冲突、合入）。预期：每个迁移一条注入 prompt，CI 失败点名失败 check；重复同一状态不重复触发；重启 daemon 后重观同一状态不重放，而重启后的新迁移仍触发。
4. 移除绑定（删除会话记录）后再评论。预期：事件回退正常 channel 路径（channel 会话 + 公开回复），即今天的行为。
5. 两个设置都不开时，确认行为与 API 调用量不变（worker 不调用新的反查路由）。

### 证据（前后对照）

之前：事件只到 channel 自有会话；纯 CI 失败或合并冲突什么都不触发。之后（隔离 daemon + mock GitHub API，真实 Web Shell 界面）：

评论事件注入绑定会话——prompt 带 PR 身份与不可信数据警告，回复留在会话内：

![绑定会话收到评论事件](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/github-bound-session-events/bound-session-comment-event.png)

CI 失败迁移注入同一绑定会话，点名失败 check：

![绑定会话收到 CI 失败事件](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/github-bound-session-events/bound-session-ci-failure-event.png)

Web Shell 渠道编辑器中的两个新设置（描述符驱动，无 UI 代码改动）：

![渠道编辑器显示新字段](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/github-bound-session-events/channel-editor-new-fields.png)

产出这些截图的运行中，`github-posts.jsonl` 对绑定投递记录零公开帖。当前 head 单测覆盖：`channels/base`（1652）、`channels/github`（344）、cli worker/路由/会话套件（2172）、core PR 绑定服务（99）与 Web Shell 频道编辑器（32）共 4,299 个测试全绿，涵盖门禁强制、大小写不敏感绑定键、partial 快照剪枝守卫、CI 宽限窗口、唤醒错误分类、队列背压、缺席推迟、tombstone、准入幂等与 relay 标记门；16 项变异验证（逐一还原修复→对应回归测试变红）全部击杀。隔离 daemon E2E 套件（23 个计划步骤 + 休眠唤醒复验，72 条断言）对 mock GitHub API 通过；评审修复轮的 E2E 复验已在后续评论汇报。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境

本地构建（`npm run build && npm run bundle`，`node dist/cli.js serve`），Alibaba Cloud Linux 3，Node v24.22.1；隔离 `QWEN_HOME`/`QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` daemon，配零依赖 mock GitHub API 与 mock OpenAI 端点；Web Shell 截图经 chrome-headless-shell + CDP。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：操作者 opt-in 后，GitHub 内容会以 prompt 形式进入交互式会话。缓解：两个设置默认关闭；bound 投递前执行与 channel 路径相同的 group/sender/pairing 前置门禁；payload 显式标记不可信；目标会话自身的审批模式约束其动作；回复绝不自动发布。状态监视增加有界 API 调用（≤30 个被监视 PR，稳态每 PR 每轮询一次调用，条件化 check 拉取并对迟注册 check 设 10 分钟宽限窗口）。
- 未验证/超出范围：macOS/Windows 未本地测试；webhook 推送接入（既有静态 targets 的 webhook 路由不动）、此路径的跨会话 peer 消息、channel 自建会话的自动 PR 绑定均明确超出范围；standalone `qwen channel start`（非 daemon）降级为今天的行为并告警。评审修复轮 E2E 复验仍在进行，将在后续评论汇报。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：**两处既有路由行为变更。**（1）`POST /session/:id/load` 与 `/resume` 对无注册条目的显式 `cwd` 返回 `404 workspace_not_found`（原为 `400 workspace_mismatch`，属永久性缺席）；可逆状态（draining/transitioning/blocked）仍返回 400，会话**创建**（`POST /session`）不变——依赖 load/resume 的 `400 workspace_mismatch` 的客户端需同时处理 `404 workspace_not_found`。（2）channel-worker 的 prompt 授权为跨 workspace 绑定投递新增进程级中继凭据：在外部 workspace 的分类除已注册 worker token 与 primary/受信目标外，还要求显式的 `qwen.daemon.channelBoundRelay` 意图标记；本 workspace 回合保持按 workspace 谓词，携带外部 worker token 的普通 prompt 仍是普通交互式 prompt。残余的 token 持有者风险记录于设计文档 Constraints and risks。prompt 路由另接受可选的增量字段 `idempotencyKey`（同键重复受理去重为原 202）。新路由 `GET /sessions/pr-bindings` 只读、进程级；新 channel 设置默认关闭；`ChannelBaseOptions.boundSessions` 可选，仅 daemon worker 提供。

设计文档（双语同步）：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/github-channel-bound-session-events/docs/design/2026-11-02-github-channel-bound-session-events.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/github-channel-bound-session-events/docs/design/2026-11-02-github-channel-bound-session-events.zh-CN.md)

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): align shared MySQL schema conventions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Document all 38 Managed Agent tables and 843 columns in English, and align the shared pre-release schema with Alibaba's MySQL conventions. Each table receives an unsigned auto-increment row ID while its original business key remains unique and non-null. Boolean columns use `is_` names and unsigned tiny integers with a 0/1 constraint; nonnegative counters use unsigned integers; indexes use `idx_`/`uk_` names; fixed-format digests use `CHAR`; and the long host lookup uses a bounded prefix. SQL consumers, nullable numeric reads, CSI evidence and catalog validation follow the same definitions. Hosted SSE checks project the renamed SQL terminal flag into the existing API field on both public and WebShell surfaces.

Server and Broker schema admission and validation require `STRICT_TRANS_TABLES` or `STRICT_ALL_TABLES` in both global and session SQL modes before schema writes. This prevents ordinary unsigned writes from silently clamping negative values; the application does not change SQL modes. Every application connection must retain strict mode throughout operation, and `IGNORE` writes can still downgrade range errors to warnings.

The existing `gmt_create` and `gmt_modified` names, millisecond values and timestamp behavior are retained. No duplicate creation/update timestamps are added. Database foreign keys are removed while application admission and transaction checks remain in place. Physical row IDs are validated but excluded from domain projections and CSI evidence. Permissions, Workspace access grants, physical deletion and retention behavior are preserved.

## Why it's needed

The schema lacked persisted explanations and used inconsistent physical keys, boolean definitions and index names. Keeping the baseline, readers and validator aligned makes database inspection clearer and lets startup reject incompatible catalogs. Independently pinned business keys protect uniqueness and non-nullability across all 38 tables. Short discriminator indexes retain full values for covering/ordered queries, and shared digest columns retain variable widths where namespaces use different formats.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-ddl-comments/docs/design/2026-11-02-managed-schema-conventions.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-ddl-comments/docs/design/2026-11-02-managed-schema-conventions.zh-CN.md). Both versions cover the same decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria, referencing the official Huangshan manual.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Initialize a fresh strict-mode catalog through Broker or Flyway. Expect 38 application tables, 843 documented columns and schema version 1. Repeated initialization should validate the existing catalog. Either a non-strict global mode or a non-strict current session must cause refusal before schema writes.
2. Verify generated row IDs, rejection of duplicate business identities, non-nullability of all 38 business-key column sets, and nullable/generated flags. Under each supported strict mode, MySQL should reject an ordinary negative unsigned UPDATE with errno 1264 and preserve the stored value; invalid flag value 2 should also be rejected. Row IDs should not enter domain projections or CSI evidence.
3. Exercise queue admission, approval selection, journal writes, publication collection and Runtime repository operations, including bounded schedule limits and nullable Workspace-bound Session generations. Public payload names, protocol state values, error reasons and authorization behavior should retain their existing meanings.
4. Change a generated expression, unsigned declaration, ID generation, business key or host-index prefix. Startup should refuse the drift, unexpected foreign keys and legacy/partial/foreign catalogs.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI behavior. The original 805 domain columns retain their order, defaults and nullability; 38 physical ID columns are appended. All original business keys, 58 CHECK constraints and 90 explicit indexes remain represented, with the intended type/name conversions and host-index prefix.

Historical local evidence from the initial implementation: selected Maven reports contain 615 cases, with 609 passed, four failed because a media generator required an absent Core JavaScript build, and two skipped. The four failures remain gaps, not passes. The selected passes include 67 CSI inventory and nine binding-control cases; production compilation and Checkstyle also passed. Five selected integration cases passed on disposable MySQL 8.4.11, covering baseline/constraints, system-catalog refusal, Server stores, Broker repositories and case-sensitive business keys. The database was removed afterward. Root build, typecheck and all 54 affected E2E-driver unit tests passed after the script updates. These results do not establish fresh validation of subsequent Java changes.

CI on the preceding head `4b4889dee5` completed successfully: all 20 reported checks passed, including Java fast, real-daemon E2E and the Managed Agent fast-tier aggregate. This supersedes the four cleanup-fixture failures on `428f4703d9`, which came from the missing strict-mode query mock. Native MySQL, Hosted process/failover and complete transport gates were skipped under fast tier, so full native/process acceptance remains pending.

The Hosted SSE projection regression produced four failures/four passes with the old row lookup and eight passes after the fix. It covers public/WebShell projections with Boolean and numeric terminal values, complete API keys, timestamp units, JSON data and omitted NULL fields. The read-only test-engineer independently imported the actual helper and reproduced the same eight-case result. The no-AK CI lane now selects this regression and its pinned command manifest includes it: the inventory case failed before registration and passed afterward, and the command-contract case passes. Root npm run build and npm run typecheck passed once on the final clean commit `33261fc143`; scoped ESLint/Prettier and diff whitespace checks passed. A static consumer census derived all 23 physical-column renames from the baseline and found no additional stale executable SQL-row column read; public/JSON fields, protocol state names and deliberate legacy-refusal fixtures retain their meanings. That census does not establish runtime correctness for every ID, foreign-key replacement, digest or index. No additional local Java/Maven/MySQL or prerequisite build was run because the shared Java validation budget is exhausted. Full native/Hosted execution remains pending CI; helper-level passes are not process acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Focused historical checks above; current Java/native increment pending CI |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Historical local runs used macOS 26.6.2 arm64, JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.16, H2 2.4.240, MySQL 8.4.11 and Flyway 11.7.2. MySQL ran as an isolated process with binary logging disabled and `max_allowed_packet=134217728`; the Linux container's native-AIO setting does not apply to this local run. Maven used a task-owned repository with the sibling SDK built from this checkout.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: physical primary keys and index layout change. Referential integrity relies on application transactions; direct SQL can create orphan references. Business uniqueness, tenant/actor checks and writer/lease fencing are preserved. Strict global defaults and every application's session mode are now deployment prerequisites; startup validation cannot police later administrative or pool-mode changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: fresh full unit/H2, native MySQL and Hosted/fault acceptance; native media cases requiring the absent JavaScript build; Linux/Windows execution; deletion/retention changes. Restoring the archived fixture's original boolean column does not repair its pre-existing timestamp mismatch or revive legacy migration.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the shared V1 baseline and CSI field names change. Under the existing pre-release policy, recreate development catalogs. No V2 migration, schema-version increment, Flyway repair or history rewrite is provided.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 的改动

为 Managed Agent 全部 38 张表及 843 个字段添加英文数据库注释，并按照阿里巴巴 MySQL 规约整理共享的发布前数据库基线。每张表新增无符号自增行 ID，原业务键保留唯一和非空约束。布尔字段使用 `is_` 命名、无符号微整型及 0/1 约束；非负计数使用无符号整数；索引采用 `idx_`/`uk_` 命名；固定格式摘要采用 `CHAR`；较长的主机查询使用有界前缀。SQL 消费者、可空数值读取、CSI 证据及数据库结构校验同步调整。 Hosted SSE 检查在 public 和 WebShell 两种表面都把更名后的 SQL 终止标志投影为现有 API 字段。

Server 和 Broker 的结构准入及校验要求全局和会话 SQL 模式均包含 `STRICT_TRANS_TABLES` 或 `STRICT_ALL_TABLES`，在写入结构前完成检查。这可防止普通无符号写入把负数静默截断为零；应用不会修改 SQL 模式。运行期间每个应用连接都必须保持严格模式，`IGNORE` 写入仍可把范围错误降级为警告。

沿用现有 `gmt_create`、`gmt_modified` 命名、毫秒值及时间行为，不新增重复的创建/更新时间字段。移除数据库外键，保留应用准入和事务检查。物理行 ID 参与结构校验，但不进入领域投影和 CSI 证据。权限、Workspace 授权、物理删除和保留期行为保持不变。

## 为什么需要

此前数据库缺少持久化说明，物理主键、布尔字段及索引命名也不一致。同步整理基线、读取器和校验器，方便查看数据库，并让启动过程拒绝不兼容的数据库结构。独立固定的业务键保护全部 38 张表的唯一性及非空约束。短判别字段索引保留完整值，以支持覆盖查询和有序查询；多个命名空间使用不同摘要格式的共享字段继续采用变长类型。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-ddl-comments/docs/design/2026-11-02-managed-schema-conventions.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-ddl-comments/docs/design/2026-11-02-managed-schema-conventions.zh-CN.md)。两种语言完整覆盖相同的决策、约束和验收标准，并引用官方黄山版手册。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 分别通过 Broker 或 Flyway 初始化严格模式的新数据库，预期得到 38 张应用表、843 个有注释的字段，schema 版本仍为 1。重复初始化应完成已有结构校验。全局或当前会话模式任一非严格时，都应在写入结构前拒绝。
2. 检查行 ID 自动生成、业务身份重复拒绝、全部 38 张表业务键列的非空性及可空/派生布尔标志。MySQL 在两种受支持严格模式下都应拒绝普通的负数无符号 UPDATE，返回 1264 并保留原值；标志值 2 也应被拒绝。行 ID 不应进入领域投影或 CSI 证据。
3. 验证队列准入、审批设置、日志写入、发布资源收集及 Runtime 存储操作，包括有界调度上限及可空的 Workspace 绑定代次。公开载荷字段名、协议状态、错误原因及授权行为应保留原有含义。
4. 修改派生表达式、无符号声明、ID 生成、业务键或主机索引前缀，启动应拒绝这些偏移，以及非预期外键、旧版、不完整和包含其他业务对象的数据库。

### 验证证据（修改前后）

不涉及 UI 行为。原有 805 个领域字段保持顺序、默认值和可空性，末尾增加 38 个物理 ID 字段。原业务键、58 个 CHECK 约束和 90 个显式索引均保留，仅执行预期的类型、命名及主机索引前缀调整。

初始实现的历史本地证据：所选 Maven 报告共包含 615 个用例，609 个通过，4 个因媒体生成器需要的 Core JavaScript 构建产物缺失而失败，2 个跳过。4 个失败项仍是验证缺口，没有计为通过。通过项包含 67 个 CSI 清单及 9 个绑定控制用例；生产代码编译和 Checkstyle 也已通过。临时 MySQL 8.4.11 上所选 5 个集成用例通过，覆盖基线/约束、系统数据库拒绝、Server 存储、Broker 存储及业务键大小写区分，随后已清理数据库。脚本更新后的根目录构建、类型检查及全部 54 个相关 E2E 驱动单元测试通过。这些结果不代表后续 Java 修改已经重新验证。

前一版本 `4b4889dee5` 的 CI 已成功完成：报告的 20 项检查全部通过，包含 Java fast、真实 daemon E2E 和 Managed Agent fast-tier 汇总。这取代了 `428f4703d9` 上因缺少严格模式查询 mock 导致的四个清理夹具失败。fast tier 仍跳过原生 MySQL、Hosted 进程/故障恢复及完整传输门禁，因此完整的原生/进程验收仍待执行。

Hosted SSE 投影的定向回归在旧行读取方式下为四项失败/四项通过，修复后八项全部通过。覆盖 public/WebShell 的布尔及数值终止标志、完整 API 字段、时间单位、JSON 内容和 NULL 字段省略。只读 test-engineer 独立导入实际 helper，复现了同样的八例结果。no-AK CI 已纳入该回归及对应固定命令清单：清单断言在登记前失败、登记后通过，入口契约断言也通过。根目录 npm run build 和 npm run typecheck 在最终干净提交 `33261fc143` 上各运行一次并通过；针对性 ESLint/Prettier 和 diff 空白检查通过。静态消费者核对从基线导出全部 23 处物理列名变更，未确认新的可执行 SQL 行列名读取遗漏；公开/JSON 字段、协议状态及特意保留的旧库拒绝夹具保持原义。该核对不代表全部 ID、外键替代、摘要或索引的运行行为已经验证。Java 共享验证预算已耗尽，没有新增本地 Java/Maven/MySQL 或其前置构建。完整原生/Hosted 执行仍待 CI；helper 层通过不代表进程验收。

### 已验证平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | 已完成上述历史针对性检查；当前 Java/原生增量待 CI |
| 🪟 Windows | 未在本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | 未在本地验证 |

### 环境

历史本地运行使用 macOS 26.6.2 arm64、JDK 21.0.12.1、Maven 3.9.16、H2 2.4.240、MySQL 8.4.11 和 Flyway 11.7.2。MySQL 使用独立进程，关闭二进制日志，`max_allowed_packet=134217728`；Linux 容器的原生 AIO 配置不适用于此次本地运行。Maven 使用本任务独立的依赖仓库，兄弟 SDK 从当前 checkout 源码构建。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：物理主键及索引布局改变。关联完整性改由应用事务保证，直接执行 SQL 可以创建孤立引用。保留业务唯一性、租户/actor 检查和 writer/租约 fencing。严格的全局默认值及每个应用会话模式成为部署前提；启动校验无法控制之后的管理员或连接池模式变更。
- 未验证或不在范围内：新的完整 unit/H2、原生 MySQL 和 Hosted/fault 验收；依赖缺失 JavaScript 构建产物的原生媒体验证；Linux/Windows 运行；删除/保留期策略调整。恢复归档夹具原布尔列名，并不修复原有时间字段不匹配，也不会恢复遗留结构升级路径。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：共享 V1 基线及 CSI 字段名变化，遵循现有发布前策略，需要重建开发数据库。不提供 V2 迁移、schema 版本递增、Flyway repair 或历史改写。

prs.title: fix(core): name the model and setting in media refusals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a model cannot accept an image, audio, or video file, Qwen Code refuses it with a message the model then reads. That message named neither the model nor the setting behind the refusal, and it read identically whether the input modalities were guessed from the model name or declared by the user. In both cases it ended by pointing at skills, which is the wrong direction when the real cause is a configuration value.

The refusal now leads with the model id and states how the modalities were resolved. A value inferred from the model name tells the caller to declare `generationConfig.modalities` on the provider entry. A value the user declared points at where it was declared instead. The rest of the guidance — that `read_file` cannot process the file either, and the skills fallback — is unchanged, as is the separate PDF wording that suggests installing the document-skills extension.

## Why it's needed

Reported in #16178. A provider-backed model with image input configured was refused, and the message sent the reporter down a resize-image path; the setting had been right all along and the resolved route genuinely had no image modality. The message was accurate about the state but not actionable, because the one fact that would have separated "you configured this wrong" from "we guessed wrong from the name" was already computed and then discarded.

The resolved configuration already tracks where each field came from, so the distinction costs no new resolution logic. The source kind is carried on the request context for the API-time path; the read_file path reads it directly. It is deliberately withheld when the generator is serving a model other than the configuration's primary one, so a sub-agent or side query cannot inherit the primary model's attribution and report a setting the user never set for it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Configure an OpenAI-compatible provider entry whose model id matches no known family pattern, without `generationConfig.modalities`, then ask the agent to read a PNG. The refusal should name that model id and say the modalities were inferred from the model name, with the exact JSON key to add.

Then add `"modalities": { "image": true }` to that entry and repeat: the image is read instead of refused, which confirms the advice points at the field that actually decides the outcome.

A model whose id does match a known vision pattern, with image modality left on, should still read images normally — the new text only replaces a refusal.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before and after are the text the model receives. Captured from the real read_file path and the real request-building pipeline, with a 1x1 PNG on disk and modalities resolving empty:

Before (both cases identical):

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". This model does not support image input. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

After, modalities guessed from the model name:

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". Model 'my-custom-openai-id' does not support image input: its input modalities were inferred from the model name. Declare "generationConfig": { "modalities": { "image": true } } on this provider entry to enable it. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

After, modalities declared on the provider entry without image:

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". Model 'my-custom-openai-id' does not support image input: this provider entry's "generationConfig.modalities" is set without image. Check it and re-select the model with /model. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit tests, type checking, lint, and formatting were all run inside a `node:22-bookworm` Linux container against the merged base. The macOS column is ⚠️ rather than ✅: the same suite also passes there, but the bundle build needed for the full CLI integration harness does not complete on this machine's container filesystem, so the end-to-end evidence above was produced from the source-level pipeline rather than a bundled CLI run. Nothing in this change is platform-specific.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests and type checking in a Linux container; no sandbox, no live model endpoint.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the refusal text is what the model reads, so changed wording can shift model behaviour around file handling. The leading clause keeps the substring previous assertions and any model familiarity rely on, and the advice is additive.
- Not validated / out of scope: the reporter's original observation that the setting appeared to need a restart is not addressed here. The modalities are re-resolved on auth refresh and on `/model`, so the hint says "re-select the model with /model" rather than claiming a restart is required; whether their hot-reload path was misbehaving is a separate question left open on the issue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new request-context field is optional and nothing else reads the message text.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16178

prs.title: fix(core): keep the model name when an Ollama Hugging Face id carries a quantization tag
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Ollama model ids pulled from Hugging Face now keep their model name when Qwen Code looks up the model's limits. `hf.co/unsloth/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M` gets the 262,144 window of `qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct` instead of the default 200K. A bare quantization tag after the colon (`:Q4_K_M`, `:Q8_0`, `:IQ4_XS`, `:UD-Q4_K_XL`, `:BF16`) and the `-GGUF` repo suffix are removed before the lookup.

## Why it's needed

`ollama run hf.co/<user>/<repo>-GGUF:<quant>` is the standard way to run a Hugging Face GGUF model in Ollama. The tag handling from #7766 only recognises a quantization tag after a size (`qwen3:8b-q8_0`), so a bare one was kept as the model name and the id fell back to the default limits.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add host mount entries and align managed empty-state layout
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a mount entry that lets a non-React host render the WebShell without hand-drawing any surrounding chrome: a managed-only surface (`renderManagedAgentWebShell`) driven by an injected `baseUrl` / `ManagedAgentProvider` with no backend address hardcoded. The handoff is source-only for now: the mode is not wired into the package `build`/`exports`/`files`, so hosts build `dist/managed-host` themselves. It also lets the managed empty state fill its container instead of leaving a dead band under the composer, surfaces session-failure and unconfirmed-submission notices in one place above the composer without rendering the same message twice, and makes a pending prompt owned by a different conversation offer a redirect to its owning conversation instead of retry/discard from a foreign session.

## Why it's needed

Hosts embedding WebShell currently either mount only the chat surface and rebuild the surrounding shell themselves, or fight the managed empty-state layout (welcome pinned to the top, composer pinned to the bottom) and duplicated, loosely-styled status notices. These entries and layout fixes let a host mount the official full page as-is and get a consistent, centered, single-source presentation of session status, while keeping all business/backend integration on the host side through the injected provider.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `cd packages/web-shell && bun run typecheck` (exit 0) and `npx vitest run client/components/managed/ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx client/ManagedAgentWebShell.test.tsx client/managed-host.test.tsx client/managed-host.dom.test.tsx` (179 passed). To check behavior, mount `renderManagedAgentWebShell` with a stub provider: the empty state fills the container; selecting a failed session shows a single callout above the composer (not a duplicated red line); a pending prompt owned by another session shows "Open the original conversation" and no retry/discard in the foreign session.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the managed empty state pinned the welcome header to the top and the composer to the bottom, and the same failure message rendered twice (session info area plus the alert channel). After: the empty state is vertically centered and a single styled callout sits above the composer. The callout behavior is exercised by the managed smoke tests; before/after screenshots were captured locally and can be attached on request.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

bun + vitest for unit tests; a local Vite host page mounting the built `managed-host` bundle for the visual check.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the `managed-host` mode is reachable only by building it from a checkout, so nothing in CI catches it rotting. The README states that contract, and `files` keeps `dist/types/managed-host.d.ts` out of the published package so the package does not advertise a type with no implementation.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux; a real daemon or Managed runtime (verified against a stub/local bridge). Current head includes a merge from `main` and GitHub reports it as mergeable.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `ManagedAgentProvider.submitPrompt` now resolves `operationId?: string` instead of `operationId: string` — hosts that read `operationId` must handle its absence; existing providers stay assignable, only strict readers are affected. Everything else is additive for existing consumers. The foreign-session pending redirect intentionally changes cross-session retry UX (a foreign session now redirects to the owner instead of retrying in place).

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增挂载入口，让非 React 宿主无需自绘外壳即可渲染 WebShell：仅托管会话的入口（`renderManagedAgentWebShell`），由宿主注入的 `baseUrl` / `ManagedAgentProvider` 驱动，不内置任何后端地址。该入口目前只随源码提供：没有接入包的 `build`/`exports`/`files`，构建 `dist/managed-host` 由宿主自行完成。同时托管空态改为铺满容器，不再在 composer 下方留出死区；将会话失败与未确认提交的提示统一放到 composer 上方、同一消息不再重复渲染；当未决提交属于另一个会话时，改为提供"返回原会话"的跳转，而不是在外会话里重试/丢弃。

## 为什么需要

嵌入 WebShell 的宿主目前要么只挂聊天界面、自己重绘外围外壳，要么忍受托管空态布局（欢迎头顶在上、输入框贴在下）以及重复、样式松散的状态提示。这些入口与布局修复让宿主能原样挂载官方整页，获得一致、居中、单一来源的会话状态呈现，同时把所有业务/后端集成留在宿主侧、通过注入的 provider 完成。

## 评审验证方案

运行 `cd packages/web-shell && bun run typecheck`（退出码 0）与 `npx vitest run client/components/managed/ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx client/ManagedAgentWebShell.test.tsx client/managed-host.test.tsx client/managed-host.dom.test.tsx`（179 通过）。行为验证：用 stub provider 挂载 `renderManagedAgentWebShell`，空态铺满容器；选中失败会话时 composer 上方只显示一条提示（不再重复红字）；未决提交属于其他会话时显示"返回原会话"，外会话中不出现重试/丢弃。

### 前后对比

改动前：托管空态把欢迎头钉在顶部、输入框贴在底部，同一条失败消息渲染两次（会话信息区 + 告警通道）。改动后：空态垂直居中，composer 上方只有一条带样式的提示。提示行为已由托管场景 smoke 测试覆盖；前后截图已在本地留存，可按需附上。

### 测试环境

macOS 已测；Windows / Linux 未测。bun + vitest 跑单测，本地 Vite 宿主页挂载构建出的 `managed-host` 产物做视觉验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：`managed-host` 模式只能从源码 checkout 手动构建，CI 不会发现它腐坏。README 已写明这一约定，`files` 也把 `dist/types/managed-host.d.ts` 排除在发布产物之外，避免包内出现没有实现的类型。
- 未验证/范围外：Windows 与 Linux；真实 daemon 或托管运行时（用 stub/本地桥验证）。当前 head 已包含一次 `main` 合并，GitHub 显示可合并。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：对现有使用者无破坏，入口为新增。外会话未决跳转有意改变了跨会话重试交互（外会话改为跳转到归属会话，而非就地重试）。

设计文档：[英文](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): keep sdk-java resolver bookkeeping and in-house jars out of the host cache (#15281)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The job-local Maven repository that the sdk-java suites resolve from no longer shares mutable inodes with the host cache:

- Every seed site drops `maven-metadata-local.xml` together with the other resolver bookkeeping names (`_remote.repositories`, `resolver-status.properties`, `*.lastUpdated`, `*.tmp`), so the unlocked Maven runs cannot rewrite a host-cache file through a seeded hardlink.
- The locked write-back removes every in-house fixed-release coordinate from the host cache (the `qwen-managed-agent-*` modules are purged by glob, tracking #15871's module split), prunes them at any depth rather than only at the repository root, publishes only job-produced files (the same five names stay job-local), and downgrades a failed cache-directory creation to a warning instead of reddening a green suite.
- The self-hosted Managed Agent Checkstyle leg resolves the SDK from the job-local repository the suite installed it into.
- The release builder's seed copies into the job-local repository instead of nesting a second `repository/` inside it, and drops the same bookkeeping names.
- The workflow meta-tests pin the five exclusions at every seed and both prunes, the write-back's children and their fd 9 closure, the host-side removal, the warning path, and the Checkstyle repository.

## Why it's needed

Moving Maven above the per-host lock is only safe while the job-local repository has no inode in common with the host cache. Maven's resolver rewrites its bookkeeping files in place, and the suites `install` fixed-release in-house artifacts: seeded as hardlinks, they let an unlocked run mutate state that every sibling job on the host reads.

Correction to the earlier description: the lock-scope change itself ("only the write-back takes the lock") landed through #15128 and #15254 and is already on main. #15274 remains open with overlapping cache and deferred-status changes. This PR is the cache-isolation half that makes that scope safe, and it is judged on that, not on the lock wait from #15281.

Reconciliation on 2026-10-31: merged main `812a8c7ccb` and reconciled with #15871's split of the Managed Agent server into nine Maven modules. The seed drops, the write-back prunes and the host-cache purge now cover the full in-house coordinate set; the purge globs `qwen-managed-agent-*` so a future module rename cannot leave a stale host copy behind. All four unique behaviors are retained: the host-cache purge, the seed nesting fix, the self-hosted Checkstyle repository, and the reference-release seed isolation. When #15274 lands, this branch reconciles against its delivered code again.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job of a PR that touches a managed-agent path. The self-hosted step should show the `cp -aln` seed and all three Maven invocations before any `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` line; the lock wait should appear only at the cache write-back, and the write-back should remove the in-house coordinates before copying. Grep the job-local repository for `maven-metadata-local.xml` after the suite: it should hold only job-produced files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a seeded `maven-metadata-local.xml` and a seeded `qwencode-sdk` jar were the same inode as the host cache, so the unlocked `mvn install` changed the host file (same inode, SHA and mtime both moved). After: the host file is byte- and mtime-identical while the job-local copy is still written, the write-back publishes zero bookkeeping files and never the in-house coordinates, and the host cache loses the pre-PR in-house trees. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     |                       Status                        |
| :--------: | :-------------------------------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ meta-tests (367 passed, 11 Linux-only skipped), shell probes, Prettier |
| 🪟 Windows |                   ⚠️ not tested                    |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ CI is authoritative for the Linux-only behavioral legs; earlier heads ran the full meta-tests there |

### Environment (optional)

Meta-tests at head `28eedc0e1a` (macOS): `scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`, `scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`, `scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js` — 367 passed, 11 skipped (the Linux-only behavioral legs run in CI). Local shell probes confirmed the nine-coordinate any-depth prune, the five-name exclusion and the glob host purge. No JDK 21 / Maven locally, so the real Java suite is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a cold host pays the seed cost once, and the write-back is best-effort and capped at 300 seconds, matching the MariaDB lane. The write-back also deletes pre-existing in-house copies from the host cache — intended, because they are the stale fixed-release jars the in-house prune exists to stop publishing.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real ECS pool and its ticketed lock queue; the full JDK 21 Maven suite; the MySQL / MariaDB integration lanes; the hosted legs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #15281 (the lock-scope change landed through #15128 and #15254; this PR closes the cache-isolation gap that the smaller lock scope depends on).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

sdk-java 套件解析所使用的 job 本地 Maven 仓库，不再与宿主缓存共享可写 inode：

- 每个播种站点在删除其他解析器记账文件（`_remote.repositories`、`resolver-status.properties`、`*.lastUpdated`、`*.tmp`）的同时也删除 `maven-metadata-local.xml`，因此不持锁的 Maven 运行无法穿透播种的硬链接改写宿主缓存。
- 持锁的写回会在宿主缓存中删除全部内部固定发布坐标（`qwen-managed-agent-*` 各模块以 glob 清理，跟随 #15871 的模块拆分），按任意深度 prune 而不只匹配仓库根，只发布本 job 产生的文件（同样五个名字留在 job 本地），并把缓存目录创建失败降级为警告，而不是让绿色套件变红。
- self-hosted 的 Managed Agent Checkstyle leg 从套件安装到的 job 本地仓库解析 SDK。
- 发布构建的播种改为向 job 本地仓库内复制，而不是在其中再嵌套一个 `repository/`，并删除同样的记账文件。
- 工作流元测试钉住每个播种点与两处 prune 的五个排除名、写回子进程及其 fd 9 关闭、宿主侧删除、警告路径，以及 Checkstyle 的仓库。

## 为什么需要

把 Maven 移到池级锁之外，只有在 job 本地仓库与宿主缓存没有共同 inode 时才是安全的。Maven 解析器会原地重写记账文件，而套件会 `install` 固定发布坐标的内部构件：一旦以硬链接播种，它们会让不持锁的运行改写同宿主上所有兄弟 job 都读取的状态。

对早先描述的更正：持锁范围的改动本身（“只有写回取锁”）已通过 #15128 和 #15254 落地并在 main 上。#15274 仍然开放，其中缓存和延后状态处理的改动与本 PR 有重叠。本 PR 是让该范围安全成立的缓存隔离部分，评审应以这一点为准，而不是 #15281 的锁等待。

2026-10-31 对齐：合入 main `812a8c7ccb`，并与 #15871 将 Managed Agent server 拆分为九个 Maven 模块的改动对齐。播种删除、写回 prune 与宿主缓存清理现在覆盖完整的内部坐标集合；清理以 glob 匹配 `qwen-managed-agent-*`，未来模块改名也不会遗留过期的宿主副本。四项独有行为全部保留：宿主缓存清理、播种嵌套修复、self-hosted Checkstyle 仓库选择、reference-release 播种隔离。#15274 合入后，本分支会再按其实际交付的代码对齐一次。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

打开一个触及 managed-agent 路径的 PR 的 `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job。self-hosted step 应先出现 `cp -aln` 播种和三次 Maven 调用，之后才可能出现 `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock`；锁等待只应出现在缓存写回处，且写回会先删除内部坐标再复制。套件结束后在 job 本地仓库里 grep `maven-metadata-local.xml`，应当只剩本 job 产生的文件。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：播种出的 `maven-metadata-local.xml` 与 `qwencode-sdk` jar 与宿主缓存是同一 inode，不持锁的 `mvn install` 会改写宿主文件（inode 相同，SHA 与 mtime 都变化）。After：宿主文件字节与 mtime 完全不变，同时 job 本地副本仍被写入；写回不发布任何记账文件、也从不发布内部坐标；宿主缓存中遗留的内部目录被删除。UI 不适用。

### 测试环境

head `28eedc0e1a` 上的元测试（macOS）：`scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`、`scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`、`scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js` —— 367 通过、11 跳过（Linux 专属行为测试交给 CI）。本机 shell 探针实测了九坐标任意深度 prune、五名排除与 glob 宿主清理。本机没有 JDK 21 / Maven，真实 Java 套件交给 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：冷宿主要付一次播种成本；写回是尽力而为且上限 300 秒，与 MariaDB 通道一致。写回还会删除宿主缓存中遗留的内部坐标副本——这是有意为之，因为它们正是内部坐标 prune 要阻止继续发布的过期固定发布 jar。
- 未验证 / 范围外：真实 ECS 池及其票据化锁队列；完整 JDK 21 Maven 套件；MySQL / MariaDB 集成通道；hosted leg。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

与 #15281 相关（持锁范围的改动已通过 #15128 和 #15254 落地；本 PR 补上更小持锁范围所依赖的缓存隔离缺口）。

prs.title: feat(serve): add user-scope Skill activation routes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds two daemon routes that enable or disable Skills in the **user** settings scope, which every workspace merges: `PUT /skills/:name/activation` and `PUT /skills/activation` (batch, up to 100 names). Like `PUT /extensions/activation`, they take no workspace selector. The body is `{ state: "enabled" | "disabled", mode?: "hard" | "default" }`; `mode` applies to disables only. Each request leaves the name in exactly one user list: a `hard` disable (the default) writes `skills.disabled`, a `default` disable writes `skills.defaultDisabled`, and an enable writes `skills.enabled`; the name is removed from the other two.

An enable is refused without writing, answering `200` with `changed: false` and a `block` naming the entry, when the merged config would still keep the Skill disabled: a System/SystemDefaults `skills.disabled` entry under either spelling, a User entry in the other spelling, or a `skills.defaultDisabled` entry no identically spelled grant cancels. Workspace entries never refuse a user write; they keep gating only their own workspace. Batch enables recheck refused names until the batch converges, so the outcome does not depend on request order.

After a change, every registered workspace runtime is reconciled and each changed key emits `settings_changed` with `scope: "user"` and the existing `skill_toggle` mutation object on every workspace event stream. To make the change reach live sessions, `workspaceSkillsRefresh` gains an optional `settingsScopes` parameter: user writes ask the ACP child and its sessions to re-read the user file as well, while every other refresh keeps re-reading only the workspace file. The runtime coordinator keeps that user reload pending until a refresh carrying it succeeds.

The routes are advertised as `user_skill_activation`, with `DaemonClient.setUserSkillActivation` / `setUserSkillsActivation` in the TypeScript SDK and documentation in the serve protocol and capabilities docs.

## Why it's needed

The daemon could only toggle Skills in workspace settings. Hosts that manage Skills across workspaces (for example an embedding product that centrally enables or disables Skills for a user) had no API for the user settings file: the generic `/workspace/settings` route rejects `skills.*`, so they wrote `~/.qwen/settings.json` directly. That bypasses the daemon's settings lock (risking lost updates against other user-scope writers), duplicates the block/spelling rules, and never reaches running sessions, because the Skills refresh only re-read the workspace file. These routes give a supported, locked, consistently validated write path that also applies to live sessions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start `qwen serve` and check `GET /capabilities` lists `user_skill_activation`.
2. `PUT /skills/<name>/activation` with `{"state":"disabled"}`: `~/.qwen/settings.json` gains `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]`; a live session's command list drops the Skill; every workspace stream receives `settings_changed` with `scope: "user"`.
3. Repeat with `{"state":"disabled","mode":"default"}`: the name moves to `skills.defaultDisabled`; a workspace `skills.enabled` entry with the same spelling re-enables it in that workspace only.
4. `{"state":"enabled"}`: the name moves to `skills.enabled`. Add `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]` to System settings and repeat: the response is `changed: false` with `block.scope: "System"` and the file is untouched.
5. Unit tests:
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/skill-settings.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-skills.test.ts src/serve/workspace-runtime-coordinator.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts src/serve/capability-parity.test.ts`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts -t skill`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts -t "serve capability registry"`
   - `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts`

Locally all of the above pass, along with `tsc --noEmit` for `packages/cli` and `packages/sdk-typescript`, eslint, and prettier. A full `src/serve/server.test.ts` run shows one or two different unrelated failures per run under load; the same happens on an unmodified `origin/main`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (daemon API; covered by the unit tests above).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (vitest) on macOS, Node 26.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a `hard` user disable cannot be lifted by any workspace, which is the existing meaning of a user `skills.disabled` entry; callers that want per-workspace opt-in use `mode: "default"`. Re-reading the user file in live sessions now happens only when a user Skill write requests it, so other user settings edited behind those sessions are picked up at the same time.
- Not validated / out of scope: no read route for user-scope Skill lists (reads stay workspace-scoped); `skills.disabledLevels` and `skills.directories` are not writable through these routes; no Managed Agent equivalent (recorded in the capability parity matrix).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New routes and an optional refresh parameter; existing routes and refresh behavior are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

None.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增两个 daemon 路由，用于在**用户级** settings（所有工作区都会合并的那一层）中启用或禁用 Skill：`PUT /skills/:name/activation` 和 `PUT /skills/activation`（批量，最多 100 个名字）。与 `PUT /extensions/activation` 一样，它们不带工作区选择器。请求体为 `{ state: "enabled" | "disabled", mode?: "hard" | "default" }`，`mode` 只对禁用生效。每次请求后该名字只会出现在一个用户级名单中：`hard` 禁用（默认）写入 `skills.disabled`，`default` 禁用写入 `skills.defaultDisabled`，启用写入 `skills.enabled`，并从另外两个名单中移除。

当合并后的配置仍会让该 Skill 保持禁用时，启用请求会被拒绝且不写文件，返回 `200`、`changed: false` 以及指明具体条目的 `block`：System/SystemDefaults 中任一拼写的 `skills.disabled` 条目、User 中另一种拼写的条目，或没有同拼写授权可以抵消的 `skills.defaultDisabled` 条目。工作区条目从不拒绝用户级写入，它们只继续约束各自的工作区。批量启用会对被拒绝的名字反复重查直到收敛，因此结果与请求顺序无关。

发生变更后，所有已注册的工作区 runtime 都会 reconcile，每个变更的 key 会在每个工作区的事件流上发出带 `scope: "user"` 和现有 `skill_toggle` mutation 对象的 `settings_changed`。为了让变更作用到运行中的会话，`workspaceSkillsRefresh` 新增可选参数 `settingsScopes`：用户级写入会要求 ACP 子进程及其会话同时重读用户级文件，其他刷新仍然只重读工作区文件。runtime coordinator 会一直保留这次用户级重读请求，直到某次携带它的刷新成功。

这些路由以 `user_skill_activation` 能力标签发布，TypeScript SDK 提供 `DaemonClient.setUserSkillActivation` / `setUserSkillsActivation`，并更新了 serve 协议文档与 capabilities 文档。

## 为什么需要

此前 daemon 只能在工作区 settings 中切换 Skill。需要跨工作区管理 Skill 的宿主（例如为用户统一启停 Skill 的嵌入式产品）没有操作用户级 settings 文件的 API：通用的 `/workspace/settings` 路由会拒绝 `skills.*`，于是它们只能直接写 `~/.qwen/settings.json`。这样绕过了 daemon 的 settings 锁（可能与其他用户级写入互相覆盖），重复实现了锁定与拼写规则，而且永远不会作用到运行中的会话，因为 Skill 刷新只重读工作区文件。这两个路由提供了受支持、加锁、校验一致，并且能作用到运行中会话的写入路径。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 启动 `qwen serve`，确认 `GET /capabilities` 包含 `user_skill_activation`。
2. 对 `PUT /skills/<name>/activation` 发送 `{"state":"disabled"}`：`~/.qwen/settings.json` 中出现 `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]`；运行中会话的命令列表不再包含该 Skill；每个工作区的事件流都收到 `scope: "user"` 的 `settings_changed`。
3. 改为发送 `{"state":"disabled","mode":"default"}`：该名字移到 `skills.defaultDisabled`；某个工作区中同拼写的 `skills.enabled` 条目只会在该工作区重新启用它。
4. 发送 `{"state":"enabled"}`：该名字移到 `skills.enabled`。在 System settings 中加入 `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]` 后重复：响应为 `changed: false` 且 `block.scope: "System"`，文件不变。
5. 单元测试：
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/skill-settings.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-skills.test.ts src/serve/workspace-runtime-coordinator.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts src/serve/capability-parity.test.ts`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts -t skill`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts -t "serve capability registry"`
   - `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts`

prs.title: refactor(web-shell): share session view reset state
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR consolidates the shared transcript-view reset used by session changes and `/clear`. It also makes the component contract explicit: when a consumer keeps the same transcript component mounted across a session-key change, a reading pause from the previous session is cleared. A reconnect within the same session continues to preserve that pause.

## Why it's needed

The two reset paths maintained overlapping state independently. Sharing their common reset keeps those paths consistent and covers the component's mount-stable session-switch contract. The shipped routes already remount the transcript or render an empty transcript when switching sessions, so this is component-level hardening, not a demonstrated user-visible fix on those routes.

The main-CI failure tracked in #15038 is an unhandled rejection in the hosted workspace tool-turn tests. This Web Shell change does not fix that failure and must not close its tracker.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Keep one transcript component mounted, pause following, and change its session key while supplying the next session's non-empty transcript. Following should resume, both with and without a replay transition.
- Reconnect within the same session after pausing. The reading position should remain paused.
- Clear the transcript within the same session. The existing clear/reset behavior should remain intact.
- Treat the session-switch DOM cases as component-contract coverage; the shipped routes' remount/empty-first behavior is not a before/after reproduction of this change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Earlier review reports establish that the added DOM cases fail without the session-switch pause reset and pass with it. The same reports establish that shipped-route-shaped cases already pass on the base. Those historical results support the component contract only; they are not new validation of the current head.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | No local checks run in this closeout |
| Windows | No local checks run in this closeout |
| Linux | Earlier DOM evidence is recorded in the PR discussion; the previous head's smoke check failed and checks for this closeout are pending |

## Risk & Scope

- The shared reset clears reading-pause, pagination-snapshot and expansion state. Each caller retains its additional resets; the settled-stale latch is cleared by `/clear`, not by the render-phase session switch.
- This PR changes no shipped route's mounting or empty-transcript behavior and does not repair the hosted workspace tool-turn failure.
- No local tests, build, lint or typecheck were run during this closeout, as requested. The previous smoke failure is reported separately and checks for the new head are pending; no passing browser result is claimed.
- No public API or migration change.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15038; this PR does not resolve it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

合并会话切换与 `/clear` 共用的视图重置逻辑，并明确组件契约：调用方若在切换 session key 时保留同一个消息列表实例，上一会话的阅读暂停状态会被清除。同一会话重连仍保留阅读暂停。

## 为什么需要

两条路径原先分别维护重叠的重置状态。共用重置逻辑可以保持行为一致，并补全不重建组件时的会话切换契约。当前已发布页面在切换会话时会重建消息列表，或先渲染空记录，因此本 PR 是组件层加固，不是已证实的现有页面可见缺陷修复。

#15038 跟踪的是 hosted workspace tool-turn 测试中的未处理拒绝。该 Web Shell 改动不能修复此 CI 故障，也不应自动关闭它。

## Reviewer 测试计划

- 保持消息列表实例不变，暂停跟随后，改变 session key 并传入下一会话的非空记录。有回放与无回放两种情况下都应恢复跟随。
- 同一会话暂停后重连，应继续保持阅读位置。
- 在同一会话清空记录，原有清空和重置行为应保持。
- 新增 DOM 用例验证组件契约；已发布页面重建组件或先清空记录的路径不能作为本改动的前后对照复现。

## 已有证据与验证边界

此前评审记录表明，移除会话切换时的暂停重置会使新增 DOM 用例失败，保留时通过；按已发布页面形态编写的对照用例在 base 上原本就通过。这些历史结果只支撑组件契约，不代表本轮重新验证了当前 head。

本轮按用户要求未运行本地测试、构建、lint 或 typecheck。上一 head 的 Web Shell smoke 失败另行记录，新 head 的检查尚未完成；未声称浏览器验证通过。macOS 与 Windows 本轮均未验证，Linux 既有 DOM 证据见 PR 讨论。

## 风险与范围

公共重置处理阅读暂停、分页快照和展开状态；调用方保留各自额外的重置。settled-stale 状态只在 `/clear` 路径清除，不在渲染期会话切换路径清除。本 PR 不改变页面挂载方式，也不修复 hosted workspace tool-turn 故障。无公共 API 或迁移变更。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #15038；本 PR 不解决该 issue。

</details>


### Latest repair

The latest repair also cancels old-session follow/animation callbacks and strengthens continued-follow assertions. It carries the two smoke selector corrections already landed in #15860. These new cases were not run locally; current-head CI remains pending.

auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(web-shell): reset follow pause when the session changes (#15038)

Preserving a reading pause across reconnects also preserved it across a
session switch, because the pause lives in a ref that outlives the
displayed transcript. Switching sessions while paused then left the new
transcript stranded above the latest content even though the reader never
paused it. Drop the pause in the existing session-scoped reset.

Add a DOM test that pauses session A, switches to session B mid-replay,
and asserts B lands at the bottom once catch-up completes.

* test(web-shell): pin the no-replay session switch and share the reset (#15038)

* test(ci): exempt the TUI parity suites from the no-AK gate (#15038)

prs.title: fix(ci): preserve Maven suite results across cache write-back failures
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR hardens the SDK Java Maven cache path after the suite/write-back lock split. Failed MySQL integration suites can still publish downloaded artifacts while preserving the original suite status, cache setup failures preserve the already-known suite result, and the final error annotation identifies the failed Maven stage. Cache seeds report copy failures, tolerate an unavailable cache or failed best-effort prune, and detach mutable resolver metadata before Maven runs — including single-link resolver state inherited from a previous job, since RUNNER_TEMP persists across jobs on the self-hosted pool. Write-back excludes the same metadata and partial-download files.

## Why it's needed

The lock relocation associated with #15262 already landed on main through #15128 and #15254. This branch is the remaining hardening delta: a failed suite should not throw away reusable downloads, a best-effort cache operation should not replace the suite result, and mutable resolver state should not be published as an immutable shared artifact. The test repair in 11c0f4b2fb12c also includes the deferred-status reporter in extracted shell snippets so those tests can exercise their intended paths.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Fail either Maven stage in the self-hosted MySQL integration lane. Reusable downloaded artifacts should reach write-back, later suites should not run, and the step should retain the failed stage's status and annotation.
- Run a green and a failed suite with an unusable cache or missing job-local repository. The cache fault should produce a warning and preserve the suite result.
- Seed a warm cache containing resolver markers and version metadata. Mutable hardlinks should be detached before Maven runs; write-back should publish artifacts while excluding resolver markers, metadata and partial-download files.
- Exercise a cold cache and a seed prune failure. Both should still reach Maven; an actual copy failure should remain visible in the log.
- Plant a plain single-link `resolver-status.properties` / `x.jar.lastUpdated` directly in `${RUNNER_TEMP}/m2-repo` before the seed body runs. The seed prune must delete both while the host-cache peers stay intact. Restoring `-links +1` to the seed prunes must red the `clears inherited single-link resolver state from the job-local repository` witness.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Head `a0d162dbcc` merges main `90eb13e4c6` into `702da7a21a` (which itself merged `60f5c1ed95`); the PR delta is unchanged (the same seven files, 1116 insertions / 198 deletions), and the merged workflow's `.size-baseline` entry is re-recorded to 159271. Earlier measurements below are labeled with the commit they were taken at; the four required suites were re-run after this merge. Prior heads: `d0f6312b82` (main `91a6274075`), `7618d49a` (main `fe30b5daaa`).

| Check | Result | Measured at |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| sdk-java-workflow + sdk-java-lock + workflow-size + main-ci-failure-issue-workflow | 502 passed \| 47 skipped (549), re-run after the latest merge | a0d162dbcc, local macOS (also d0f6312b82 / c7746613ec / 7618d49a) |
| Wider set of ten workflow-parsing suites + qwen-triage-workflow | 743 passed \| 47 skipped; 191 passed \| 10 skipped (triage's pre-existing 5 s subprocess timeouts on a tmux-less Mac pass with `--testTimeout=30000`; no test modified) | a0d162dbcc, local macOS (also d0f6312b82) |
| Maintainer Linux verification: 34 replay cells + author guard suite + 18-row mutation matrix | 61/61 assertions; guard suite 142/142 on Linux; 18/18 mutations killed, no survivors — verdict **merge-ready** (report in the PR thread) | 7618d49a, Linux node:22-bookworm non-root, 2026-10-31 |
| SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21 — real self-hosted pool lane | pass, 30m25s | 7618d49a CI |
| SDK Java (full) tier on the real pool — Runtime Broker and Managed Agent MySQL (1h13m), Hosted process fault (1h54m), EventTransport broker / multi-node, Java 11/17/21, Real daemon E2E, Flyway | all pass | 7618d49a CI |
| Six other suites parsing sdk-java.yml (spotbugs-gate, hosted-process-ci, managed-agent-gate-workflow, managed-agent-server-e2e, event-transport-multi-node-ci, event-transport-broker-ci) | 236 passed \| 0 skipped | c7746613ec, local macOS; PR delta unchanged since |
| Mutation: restore `-links +1` at the four seed prunes | Witness red, vitest exit 1 (`inherited single-link marker survived the seed prune: expected true to be false`); fix restored, green. Re-killed on Linux as row m5b at 7618d49a | c7746613ec local macOS; 7618d49a Linux |
| `.size-baseline` sdk-java.yml entry | 159271 = exact `git show HEAD:.github/workflows/sdk-java.yml \| wc -c` (155529 at d0f6312b82, 153970 before that) | a0d162dbcc |
| prettier / eslint / `git diff --check` | Clean; pre-commit hooks ran | c7746613ec and d0f6312b82 |
| Lint & Static / Test (ubuntu) / web-shell E2E Smoke CI | pass after re-run (first attempts failed on fleet network: actionlint download curl timeouts; corepack pnpm download ETIMEDOUT/ENETUNREACH at install; smoke's unrelated `previews qwen3.8-max reasoning` flake). CI re-runs at the merged head | 7618d49a CI; d0f6312b82 pending |

The 47 macOS skips are the file's Linux-only behavioral pins; the maintainer's Linux round executes them (142/142), so the macOS counts alone do not certify the changed behavior — the Linux verification does. The new inherited-state witness is cross-platform and ran on both systems. Prior Linux A/B and real-pool reports remain historical evidence at their recorded heads.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | 502 passed \| 47 skipped across the four required suites at d0f6312b82 (re-run after the merge); Linux-only behavioral pins skip here |
| Linux | Maintainer replay + guard suite 142/142 + 18/18 mutations at 7618d49a; CI fast Java 21 and the full SDK Java tier pass at 7618d49a; merged head CI pending |
| Windows | Not run locally |

## Current closeout

Round of 2026-10-31 (local takeover after the AutoFix loop reached its round cap): merged main `812a8c7ccb`, resolving the write-back conflicts semantically — main's nine-coordinate prune list (from the #15871 Maven-module split) plus this PR's seven-name `! -name` exclusions, with the matching test pins moved along — and fixed R13-1 by dropping `-links +1` from all four seed prunes so inherited single-link resolver state is cleared again; the write-backs' `-links 1` delta filter is unchanged. Both design-doc languages are synchronized and `.size-baseline` is re-recorded to the exact byte count. Unlike the previous static-only closeout, this round ran the suites and the mutation locally (evidence table above). The merge-order decision R2-6 asked for is recorded: this PR is the chosen landing PR of the family; #15275, #15284 and #15233 are closed, #15254 merged, and #15286 remains the separately owned follow-up.

Later on 2026-10-31: the maintainer merged current main (`7618d49a`, PR files untouched) and published an independent Linux verification at that head — verdict **merge-ready**, 61/61 assertions, 18/18 mutations killed. One non-blocking Suggestion from that report is deferred and recorded here per the repository's post-five-round convergence rule: when the `managed-agent-server` checkout is missing, the deferred-failure annotation names the previous successful Maven stage instead of the checkout (both lanes). The report carries a measured minimal fix (set `mvn_stage` before the `cd`; the test pin counting `mvn_stage` occurrences must move with it). It is follow-up work, not a merge blocker; the deferral is recorded so nothing is silently dropped.

2026-11-01: merged main `91a6274075` (`d0f6312b82`) to clear the base conflict, keeping main's Hosted-admission change (#16010) alongside this PR's hardening; delta unchanged, baseline re-recorded (155529), required suites re-run green. At `7618d49a` CI was fully green (including the full SDK Java tier on the real pool) and the PR held two maintainer approvals (wenshao, yiliang114); CI re-runs at the merged head, and stale-approval dismissal rules may require the two approvals to be refreshed. No review thread is unresolved.

2026-11-02: the maintainer merged main once more (`702da7a21a`, merging `60f5c1ed95`); the PR delta is unchanged apart from main-side comment edits inside `sdk-java.yml`, which now measures 156105 bytes while `.size-baseline` still records 155529 — a 576-byte record nit the CI size check tolerates, to be re-recorded with the next content change. All checks at this head are green, including the re-run `review-pr` whose round-15 review posted zero findings. The two approvals from `7618d49a` were dismissed on push by the stale-approval rule; the PR is MERGEABLE and now waits on two fresh maintainer approvals at `702da7a21a`. prs.title: feat(core): add local notes compaction with a strategy selector
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in local notes compaction strategy. Users can select **Summary** or **Notes and History** under **Chat Compression Strategy** in `/settings`, or set `model.chatCompression.strategy` to `summary` or `notes` in `settings.json`. Summary remains the default; changing the selection requires restarting Qwen Code.

Eligible main sessions gain `session_notes`, `session_history`, `get_context_remaining`, and `new_context`. The model can persist a bounded working checkpoint, start a smaller context from that checkpoint and the latest consumed user request, and recover omitted evidence from the active branch of its local session log. Successful notes rollovers make no summarization request. Notes revisions live in the existing JSONL transcript, with a generated Markdown projection for inspection; checkpoint persistence must succeed before active history changes. Resume, fork, rewind, archive, and deletion handle the matching notes state.

Missing, stale, or unusable notes fall back to summary for automatic and ordinary manual compression. An explicit `new_context` requires a fresh revision and reports an error if it cannot commit. `/compress <instructions>` continues to summarize, and `/compress-fast` keeps its existing behavior. The notes tool bundle respects recording availability and tool policy and is excluded from subagents, teammates, and nested code-mode calls. Ink and OpenTUI display a notes-specific transition notice.

## Why it's needed

Repeated full-history summaries can lose constraints, decisions, and tool evidence that a long task needs later. A local working checkpoint plus bounded history retrieval gives the model a way to carry forward its current state and recover details on demand. Storage and retrieval use the existing session log and require no additional memory backend. Selected notes and retrieved history still go to the configured model provider as normal inference input. Real-model quality, total token cost, and latency remain to be measured before considering a default change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start the local build with no strategy configured and confirm summary behavior. Open `/settings`, search for `compression`, switch to **Notes and History**, and confirm the saved value is `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` and the restart notice appears. Restart and check that the four notes tools are available. Repeat with `summary`, including activation through `settings.json`.
2. In an isolated recorded session, have the model write notes and request a new context in separate tool-only responses using the returned revision. Repeat three times. Each new context should retain the checkpoint and current user constraints, with no summarizer request. Deliberately omit an earlier identifier from the notes, then recover it through history search/read. Resume the session and check that its latest notes revision and old history reference still work.
3. Check that missing/stale revisions, oversized notes, and notes/reset calls mixed with ordinary text or tools cannot install a new context. Disabling recording or denying a required notes tool should disable the complete bundle. After switching to a smaller model window, existing bounded notes should remain readable, while an oversized checkpoint must be shortened before it can authorize a reset.
4. Compare compression commands: `/compress` with fresh notes should use notes; missing/stale notes should fall back to summary; `/compress <instructions>` should forward those instructions to the summarizer even with fresh notes; `/compress-fast` should retain its current tool-output clearing behavior. Check that the next model request uses the committed context and that notes transitions show the notes-specific notice.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual tmux captures of `/settings`, with the search set to `compression`:

**Before — global `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`:**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**After — local bundle `0.24.1`:**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

The fresh-notes `/compress` case displayed `Started a new context from local notes` in the actual TUI. The complete deterministic headless/tmux run passed settings persistence, tool availability, history recovery/resume, six rejection cases, and all six manual-compression cases. After the final fixes, the rebuilt handoff rerun again committed **three distinct notes windows in 15 main requests with zero summarizer requests**; resume took three requests and restored the same notes revision and historical reference.

`npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run bundle` passed. Relevant core, ACP, settings/schema/i18n, and Ink/OpenTUI regression tests passed. The final focused rerun passed 23 core tests and 54 event-adapter tests; the commit hook also passed formatting and ESLint. A separate comment contains the E2E matrix and coverage limits.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js `v26.8.2`; local bundled CLI `0.24.1`; isolated temporary settings and runtime directories; deterministic localhost OpenAI-compatible provider; headless CLI and real tmux interaction. The user's normal settings and sessions were not modified by the tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This changes core recording, compaction, and replay paths. Correctness depends on fresh notes, successful checkpoint persistence, and branch-correct recovery; note completeness still depends on the model. The Markdown file is a generated view, so editing it directly does not update canonical notes.
- Not validated / out of scope: Real-model task quality, token/cost/latency comparisons, full ACP/Web Shell E2E, other provider wire protocols, process-crash/disk/lease fault injection, and Windows/Linux execution. The deterministic E2E suite does not cover automatic/hard-overflow triggers, nested code mode, or fork/rewind/archive lifecycle operations; focused regression tests cover relevant runtime paths, without claiming end-to-end coverage. Cross-session memory, multi-file notes, and a notes editor are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No settings migration is required. `summary` remains the default, existing transcripts remain supported, and enabling or disabling `notes` requires a restart. Ordinary compression can use summary fallback; an explicit `new_context` never silently summarizes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and follow-up validation.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12257

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

增加可选的本地 notes 压缩策略。用户可以在 `/settings` 的 **上下文压缩方式** 中选择 **摘要** 或 **笔记与历史**，也可以在 `settings.json` 中把 `model.chatCompression.strategy` 设为 `summary` 或 `notes`。默认仍为摘要；修改选项后需要重启 Qwen Code。

符合条件的主会话获得 `session_notes`、`session_history`、`get_context_remaining` 和 `new_context` 四个工具。模型可以保存有大小限制的工作笔记，从笔记和最近已消费的用户请求启动更小的上下文，再从本地 session log 的有效分支找回遗漏证据。成功的 notes 换窗口不发起摘要请求。笔记版本保存在现有 JSONL transcript 中，并生成方便查看的 Markdown 文件；只有恢复 checkpoint 持久化成功后才替换当前历史。恢复、分叉、回退、归档和删除操作会处理对应的笔记状态。

自动压缩和普通手动压缩在笔记缺失、过期或不可用时回退到摘要。显式调用 `new_context` 必须提供新鲜的笔记版本，无法提交时返回错误。`/compress <instructions>` 继续生成摘要，`/compress-fast` 保持现有行为。笔记工具组遵循录制可用性及工具策略，并对 subagent、teammate 和嵌套 code-mode 调用关闭。Ink 和 OpenTUI 会显示专门的 notes 换窗口提示。

## 为什么需要

反复生成全历史摘要可能丢失长任务后续需要的约束、决策和工具证据。本地工作笔记加上有界历史检索，使模型能够保留当前工作状态并按需找回细节。存储和检索复用现有 session log，不需要新增 memory 后端。选中的笔记和检索出的历史仍会作为正常推理输入发送给配置的模型 provider。在考虑修改默认策略前，仍需评估真实模型的任务质量、总 token 成本和延迟。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用本地构建启动，不配置策略时确认仍使用摘要。打开 `/settings`，搜索 `compression`，切换到 **Notes and History**，确认保存的值为 `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` 并显示重启提示。重启后检查四个笔记工具可用。再切回 `summary`，并验证通过 `settings.json` 启用的行为一致。
2. 在隔离且开启录制的会话中，让模型先写笔记，再用返回的 revision 请求新上下文；两次调用分别放在独立且只含该工具的回复中。重复三次。每个新上下文都应保留 checkpoint 和当前用户约束，且不发起摘要请求。故意不把某个早期标识符写入笔记，再通过历史搜索和读取找回。恢复会话后，检查最新笔记版本和旧历史引用仍可用。
3. 检查缺失或过期的 revision、超限笔记，以及混入普通文本或其他工具的笔记/换窗口调用，都不能安装新上下文。关闭录制或拒绝任一必需工具后，整个笔记工具组应被关闭。切换到窗口更小的模型后，已有且满足固定大小上限的笔记仍应可读，但超过当前模型预算的 checkpoint 必须缩短后才能用于换窗口。
4. 对比压缩命令：笔记新鲜时 `/compress` 应使用笔记；笔记缺失或过期时应回退到摘要；即使有新鲜笔记，`/compress <instructions>` 也应把指定要求转交摘要模型；`/compress-fast` 应保留现有清理工具输出的行为。检查下一次模型请求使用已提交的上下文，且 notes 换窗口显示对应提示。

### 证据（前后对比）

以下为真实 tmux 捕获的 `/settings` 画面节选，搜索词为 `compression`：

**修改前：全局 `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`：**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**修改后：本地 bundle `0.24.1`：**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

使用新鲜笔记执行 `/compress` 时，真实 TUI 显示 `Started a new context from local notes`。完整的确定性 headless/tmux 测试通过了设置持久化、工具可用性、历史找回与会话恢复、六项拒绝场景以及全部六项手动压缩场景。最终修复后重新构建并复测交接，再次在 **15 次主模型请求中提交了三个不同的 notes 窗口，摘要请求为零**；恢复过程使用三次请求，恢复了相同的笔记版本和历史引用。

`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 和 `npm run bundle` 均通过。相关 core、ACP、设置/schema/国际化、Ink/OpenTUI 回归测试均通过。最后的针对性复测通过了 23 个 core 测试和 54 个 event-adapter 测试；提交钩子的格式和 ESLint 检查也通过。另附评论列出 E2E 场景矩阵和覆盖范围。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js `v26.8.2`、本地 CLI bundle `0.24.1`；使用隔离的临时设置和 runtime 目录、确定性的 localhost OpenAI 兼容模型服务、headless CLI 和真实 tmux 交互。测试未修改用户日常使用的设置和会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：涉及 core 的录制、压缩和回放路径。正确性依赖笔记新鲜度、checkpoint 成功持久化以及有效分支恢复；笔记内容是否完整仍依赖模型。Markdown 文件只是生成视图，直接编辑不会更新权威笔记。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实模型任务质量、token/成本/延迟对比、完整 ACP/Web Shell E2E、其他 provider 的通信协议、进程崩溃/磁盘/写入租约故障注入，以及 Windows/Linux 运行。确定性 E2E 未覆盖自动/硬溢出触发、嵌套 code mode 或分叉/回退/归档生命周期操作；针对性回归测试覆盖了相关运行时路径，但不代表完成了这些场景的端到端验证。跨会话记忆、多文件笔记和笔记编辑器不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无需迁移设置。默认仍为 `summary`，继续支持已有 transcript；开启或关闭 `notes` 需要重启。普通压缩可以回退到摘要；显式 `new_context` 绝不会悄悄改用摘要。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和后续验证。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12257

</details>
