prs.title: fix(core): attribute monitor and workflow notifications to the registering turn
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Monitor and workflow completion notifications now record the turn that registered the task. The ACP Session forwards that turn onto the queued notification, so a result that finishes while the original turn is still active can be included in the next model request instead of waiting for the end-of-turn drain or a separate automatic turn.

`MonitorRegistry.register()` and `WorkflowRunRegistry.register()` capture the turn once, using the same `getInvocationContext()?.promptId ?? promptIdContext.getStore()` rule as background agents and shells. A registration with no turn context remains unattributed. A model-started workflow resume is attributed to the turn that requested it; loading workflow history does not call `register()`, and a UI-driven resume without turn context remains unattributed.

## Why it's needed

#16125 fixed the shell path, but the monitor and workflow paths still emitted completion metadata without `sourceTurnId`. `Session.#takeCurrentTurnBackgroundParts` therefore skipped those notifications until the turn ended. This closes the remaining notification-class gap identified in #16125's review.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused registry and Session tests:

```bash
cd packages/core
npx vitest run src/services/monitorRegistry.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false
npx vitest run src/agents/workflow-run-registry.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false

cd ../cli
npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts \
  -t 'consumes same-turn monitor and workflow results' \
  --coverage.enabled=false
npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts \
  -t 'earlier-turn' \
  --coverage.enabled=false
```

The Session tests verify both directions: same-turn monitor and workflow results reach the second model request without `_qwencode/start_turn`, while earlier-turn results still use a separately admitted automatic execution.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Current fix:

```text
MonitorRegistry:  61 passed
WorkflowRegistry: 160 passed
Session same-turn: 1 passed
Session earlier-turn: 3 passed
```

As a bounded negative control, removing only the two new Session forwarding lines makes the same-turn test fail at the intended boundary:

```text
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 2 times, but got 1 times
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Vitest 3.2.7. The worktree reused existing dependency directories and base build artifacts; no install, build, typecheck, lint, or broad suite was run. A live Web Shell monitor/workflow session was not run locally. Cross-platform coverage remains with CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: attribution is captured at `register()`. A workflow resume started by the model belongs to the resuming turn; one started from UI state without turn context remains unattributed. This keeps earlier and restored work on the existing automatic-admission path.
- Not validated / out of scope: local Windows/Linux execution and a live long-running Web Shell session.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `sourceTurnId` is optional on the task and notification metadata; absent context preserves existing behavior.

## Linked Issues

Closes the monitor/workflow follow-up described in #16119. Follows #16125 and #16176.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Monitor 和 workflow 的完成通知现在会记录注册该任务的 turn。ACP Session 会把这个 turn 继续写入后台通知队列，因此任务在原始 turn 仍运行时结束后，结果可以进入下一次模型请求，而不是等到 turn 末才排空，或另起一个自动 turn。

`MonitorRegistry.register()` 和 `WorkflowRunRegistry.register()` 会在注册时一次性捕获 turn，规则与后台 agent、shell 一致：`getInvocationContext()?.promptId ?? promptIdContext.getStore()`。没有 turn 上下文时保持未归属。模型在当前 turn 发起的 workflow resume 会归属当前 turn；读取历史 workflow 不会调用 `register()`，而 UI 发起且没有 turn 上下文的 resume 仍保持未归属。

## 为什么需要

#16125 已修复 shell 路径，但 monitor 和 workflow 的完成 metadata 仍没有 `sourceTurnId`。因此 `Session.#takeCurrentTurnBackgroundParts` 会跳过这些通知，直到 turn 结束。本 PR 补上 #16125 review 中指出的同一类剩余缺口。

## 验证方式

按上面的四组命令运行聚焦用例。Session 层同时验证两个方向：当前 turn 的 monitor/workflow 结果进入第二次模型请求且不触发 `_qwencode/start_turn`；更早 turn 的结果仍通过单独准入的自动执行送达。

当前代码结果为：MonitorRegistry 61/61、WorkflowRegistry 160/160、Session 同 turn 1/1、Session earlier-turn 3/3。

有界负向对照中只删除本 PR 新增的两行 Session 透传，同 turn 用例会在预期边界失败：

```text
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 2 times, but got 1 times
```

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：归属在 `register()` 时捕获。模型发起的 workflow resume 归属 resume 所在 turn；UI 在无 turn 上下文时发起的 resume 仍不归属。更早或恢复后的任务继续走原有自动准入路径。
- 未验证 / 范围外：本地 Windows/Linux 执行，以及真实长时间运行的 Web Shell 场景。
- 破坏性变更：无。任务与通知 metadata 上的 `sourceTurnId` 都是可选字段，缺少上下文时保持原行为。

本 PR 收口 #16119 中 monitor/workflow 的后续缺口，并跟进 #16125、#16176。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): refuse every URL fetch refuses and say why a health probe failed
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #16051, from the review notes that arrived around its merge.

- **Every URL `fetch` refuses is refused up front.** `start` and `verify` used to refuse a listener URL only when `URL.canParse` rejected it. A `--server-url` without a scheme (`proxy.test:8443`, which parses as an opaque `proxy.test:` URL), with a user name or password, or on a port the Fetch standard blocks (6000, 10080 and 80 others) passed that check and then failed every probe until `--timeout`. The new `fetchRefusal()` refuses all four shapes before any unit starts, for the resolver's URLs and for `--server-url` alike, and says which one it is (`--server-url "proxy.test:8443" is not an http or https URL.`).
- **A probe that is sent and still fails says what it got.** `start`'s timeout used to say only "did not report UP … within Ns", and `verify`'s health row only "is not UP". Now the timeout names the endpoint's last answer and the row names its own: `HTTP 503, status DOWN`, `HTTP 502` (a proxy's error page), `self-signed certificate`, `ECONNREFUSED`, or `The operation was aborted due to timeout`. `fetch` itself words every failure as "fetch failed", so the answer comes from its `cause`.
- **Endpoint text cannot steer the terminal, and a refused URL keeps its password out.** Control characters in the probe answer and in `verify`'s session and turn rows (from the API's error reasons, Session IDs and event types) show as `U+FFFD`. A refused `--server-url` prints its password as `***`. `verify`'s API reads name the `fetch` cause as the health probe does.
- The `listeners()` comment now names the `reachesHarness: false` option `verify` passes.
- The design doc and the deployment guide (English and Chinese) list the refused shapes. The guide also says to point `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` at the CA when the certificate is not one this host trusts.

## Why it's needed

The verify-pr round 2 report on #16051 measured `URL.canParse('proxy.test:8443')` as true and `fetch` rejecting it immediately, so `start --server-url proxy.test:8443` waits out `--timeout` and then reports a server that is in fact UP. Checking the same path showed two more shapes with the same result: credentials in the URL (`Request cannot be constructed from a URL that includes credentials`) and the Fetch standard's blocked ports (`bad port`). A blocked port can come from the resolver's own output, for example `server.port=6000`. In every case the old `health()` swallowed the error, so the operator saw only a timeout. A certificate the host does not trust (`self-signed certificate`) failed the same silent way.

## 这个 PR 做了什么

#16051 合入前后收到几条评审意见，本 PR 是它们的 follow-up。

- **`fetch` 会拒绝的 URL，一律在开始前拒绝。** 以前 `start` 和 `verify` 只在 `URL.canParse` 不通过时拒绝监听 URL。下面几种 `--server-url` 都能通过这项检查，随后每次探测都失败，直到 `--timeout`：没有 scheme 的（`proxy.test:8443` 会被解析成 scheme 为 `proxy.test:` 的不透明 URL）、带用户名或密码的、端口在 Fetch 标准屏蔽列表里的（6000、10080 等共 82 个）。新增的 `fetchRefusal()` 在启动任何 unit 之前拒绝这四种情况，对解析器给出的 URL 和 `--server-url` 一视同仁，并说明属于哪种（`--server-url "proxy.test:8443" is not an http or https URL.`）。
- **探测发出后仍然失败时，说明收到了什么。** 以前 `start` 超时只说 "did not report UP … within Ns"，`verify` 的 health 行只说 "is not UP"。现在超时提示给出端点最后一次的应答，health 行给出本次探测的结果，例如 `HTTP 503, status DOWN`、`HTTP 502`（代理的错误页）、`self-signed certificate`、`ECONNREFUSED`、`The operation was aborted due to timeout`。`fetch` 自己对所有失败都只报 "fetch failed"，所以原因取自它的 `cause`。
- **端点返回的文本无法操纵终端，被拒绝的 URL 不会带出密码。** 探测应答，以及 `verify` 的 session 和 turn 行（来自 API 的错误原因、Session ID 和事件类型）中的控制字符显示为 `U+FFFD`。被拒绝的 `--server-url` 把密码显示为 `***`。`verify` 读取 API 失败时，与健康探测一样给出 `fetch` 的 cause。
- `listeners()` 的注释写明了 `verify` 传入的 `reachesHarness: false` 选项。
- 设计文档和部署指南（中英文）列出了会被拒绝的几种情况。部署指南还说明：证书不受本机信任时，用 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 指向其 CA。

## 为什么需要

#16051 的 verify-pr 第 2 轮报告实测：`URL.canParse('proxy.test:8443')` 返回 true，而 `fetch` 会立即拒绝这个 URL。结果 `start --server-url proxy.test:8443` 会等满 `--timeout`，然后报告一个实际已经 UP 的服务没有起来。顺着同一条路径排查，又发现两种结果相同的情况：URL 带凭据（`Request cannot be constructed from a URL that includes credentials`），以及 Fetch 标准屏蔽的端口（`bad port`）。屏蔽端口也可能来自解析器本身的输出，例如 `server.port=6000`。这几种情况下旧的 `health()` 都把错误吞掉了，运维只能看到超时。证书不受本机信任（`self-signed certificate`）时，同样是这样无声地失败。

- **变异。** 新增 7 个，全部被拦住：去掉整个判断、去掉上限条件、上限边界改成 `<=`、去掉"已有应答"条件、`timedOut` 恒为假、`timedOut` 改按 `AbortError` 判断，以及把 zone 正则改回旧版。合计 26/26。

**评审第 3 轮（`80d7e70e3d`）。**
- **响应头之后卡住的响应体（验证发现 1，Copilot 概览指的也是这一条）。** 响应头一到，`fetch` 就会 resolve。所以响应体被截止时间卡住时，是 `response.json()` 抛出同样的 `TimeoutError`（已在真实 socket 上实测，Node 22.22.2）。这个分支以前没有给出 `timedOut`，于是一个被截止时间截短的探测，会把之前的 `HTTP 503, status DOWN` 覆盖成 `HTTP 200, The operation was aborted due to timeout`。现在读取响应体的分支也会给出 `timedOut`。真实时钟实测：真实端点第一次返回 503，之后发出 `200` 响应头再卡住（`--timeout 3`，每组 4 次）。修复前最后的应答 4/4 次是 abort，修复后 4/4 次是 `HTTP 503, status DOWN`。
- **判断条件中 `timedOut` 这一半（验证发现 2）。** 已用测试守住。"最后应答"测试新增两个真实 socket 用例。一个是响应体卡住。另一个是端点先返回 503 再关闭：下一次探测得到 `connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:<port>`，即使这次探测的时间也被截止时间截短了，它仍会覆盖之前的应答。去掉 `probe.timedOut &&` 现在会让测试失败。含这两个用例的测试重复跑了 20 次，全部通过。
- **"自身 5 秒"的边界（验证发现 3）。** 设计文档改为：探测自身的 5 秒上限在截止时间之前用完，才算它自己超时；其他失败（例如连接被拒）也会覆盖之前的应答。真实时钟下 `--timeout 6` 的第二次探测只剩约 4999 毫秒，先到的是截止时间。规则本身不变，测试用的假时钟钉住了恰好 5000 毫秒这个边界。
- **变异。** 新增 3 个，全部被拦住：读取响应体的分支不给 `timedOut`、`timedOut` 恒为假，以及判断条件去掉 `probe.timedOut`。第 2 轮的 6 个判断条件变异和 zone 变异重跑后，仍全部被拦住。合计 29/29。

**评审第 4 轮（`d8e6c1bb5f`、`5c18f44efa`、`0d44ff8455`、`8ee2ce3b26`）。**
- **bot 对 `80d7e70e3d` 的评审（R1-1 至 R1-5），已在 `d8e6c1bb5f` 和 `5c18f44efa` 中修复。**
  - R1-1：健康应答中的控制字符（C0、DEL、C1）替换为 `U+FFFD`，端点无法移动光标、拆开一行或写剪贴板。已在真实 socket 上用测试钉住。
  - R1-2：无法解析的 Harness URL 会像 `--server-url` 一样点明 IPv6 zone。
  - R1-3：`start` 把保留的值标为 `the last answer`。
  - R1-4：`verify` 的 URL 拒绝已用测试钉住。
  - R1-5：测试服务器 `closes` 在 `t.after` 中关闭。
- **真实 systemd 部署。** 新旧两个 reference 发行包都从本分支打包。环境里有服务账号下真实的 `qma-e2e-*` unit、MySQL 8.4.6，以及接假模型的 Hosted Harness。每个场景分别用 `main` 的升级脚本和本分支的脚本各跑一次：

| 场景 | `main` | 本 PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P0：install 后 `start`、`verify --turn` | — | 都通过 |
| S1：`application.yml` 中 `server.port: 6000`（Spring 正常监听） | 18.7 秒，两个 unit 都已启动，"did not report UP" | 0.8 秒，不启动任何 unit，"is on port 6000, so fetch refuses to dial it"；`verify` 同样拒绝 |
| S2：`--server-url localhost:<port>` | 18.8 秒，unit 已启动，"did not report UP" | 0.8 秒，"is not an http or https URL" |
| S2：`--server-url http://ops:secret@…` | `verify` 在 session 行打印出密码 | 拒绝，密码显示为 `***` |
| S3：Harness URL 为 `localhost:<port>` | 等满 15.9 秒，"not listening on  "（没有主机） | 0.8 秒，不启动任何 unit，"is not an http or https URL" |
| S3：Harness URL 为 `http://[fe80::1%eth0]:<port>` | "which is not a URL" | "which is not a URL: a URL cannot carry an IPv6 zone" |
| S4：Spring 报 DOWN（磁盘空间阈值不可能满足；curl 得到 503 `{"status":"DOWN"}`） | "did not report UP"；"is not UP" | `--timeout` 取 10、13、17 时都给出 `(the last answer: HTTP 503, status DOWN)`；"is not UP: HTTP 503, status DOWN" |
| S5：私有 CA 签发的 TLS（Store 走 https，Harness 信任该 CA） | "is not UP"；session 行 "fetch failed" | 两行都给出 "self-signed certificate in certificate chain"；加上 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 后 `start` 和 `verify --turn` 通过 |
| S5：自签名证书 | — | "self-signed certificate"；加上 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 后 `start` 和 `verify --turn` 通过 |
| S6：前置 nginx，上游写错 | "did not report UP" | `(the last answer: HTTP 502)`；"is not UP: HTTP 502" |
| S6：前置 nginx，上游正确 | — | 经 nginx 的 `start` 和 `verify --turn` 都通过 |

- **真实运行发现的问题，已在 `0d44ff8455` 中修复。**
  - 被拒绝的 `--server-url` 带密码时，会把密码打印出来。现在显示为 `http://ops:***@127.0.0.1:<port>/`。
  - `verify` 的 session 和 turn 行只说 "fetch failed"，而上面的 health 行已给出原因。现在 API 读取失败时给出同样的 cause。
  - 来自 API 的文本会连同控制字节进入这些行：错误原因、无法解析的响应体、Session ID 和事件类型。现在像健康应答一样净化。
  - 把 `0d44ff8455` 换进同一环境后重跑：P0 通过，两处凭据拒绝都已遮蔽，所有输出中都没有密码，TLS 场景的 session 行给出证书错误。
- **不是字符串的 status（Copilot 对 `0d44ff8455` 的概览），已在 `8ee2ce3b26` 中修复。** `printable()` 对端点返回的值调用 `String()`。对于自带不可调用 `toString` 的合法 JSON 对象，例如 `{"status":{"toString":1}}`，`String()` 会抛错，而 `health()` 不在 try 中。在测试环境上，`verify` 还没打印 health 行就以 `Cannot convert object to primitive value` 退出，`start` 在第一次探测时就停止了。现在这类值显示为它的 JSON。在同一环境上，`verify` 打印 `is not UP: HTTP 200, status {"toString":1}`，`start` 等满 `--timeout` 后把它作为最后一次的应答。测试钉住了这两处，以及同样形状的 API 错误原因；改回 `String()` 会让两个测试失败。
- **这里发现、但不属于本 PR 的问题。** 自 #15871 把服务端拆成多个模块后，每个发行包上 `check` 的 database 行都会 WARN "cannot compare the Flyway scripts (no Flyway script found in …)"。迁移脚本挪进了 `BOOT-INF/lib/qwen-managed-agent-persistence-*.jar`，而扫描只读 `BOOT-INF/classes/`。已在 #16175 中单独修复。
- **变异。** 新增 11 个，全部被拦住：`withoutPassword` 改为空操作；拒绝提示不再调用它；API 读取不取 cause；cause 不净化（补了一个 cause 带控制字节的用例后被拦住）；API 的错误原因、无法读取响应体的信息、Session ID，以及通过和失败的 turn 行各自不净化；以及把自动修复的净化和 zone 原因还原。加上把 `printable()` 改回 `String()` 的变异，合计 41/41。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

Linux x86_64 + Node 22.22.2；Linux aarch64 + Node 24.14.0（套件同样 65/65，说明屏蔽端口列表与两个运行时一致）。

### 环境（可选）

不适用，只有单元测试。升级命令运行在 systemd 下，只支持 Linux。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：屏蔽端口列表是从 Fetch 标准抄来的。如果以后的 Node 屏蔽了列表里没有的端口，测试仍会通过，那个端口会退回到超时时报出探测结果（`bad port`），而不是事先拒绝。如果标准删掉某个端口，一致性测试会失败。
- 已在真实 systemd 主机上验证（第 4 轮）。未验证：macOS、Windows。#16051 上有两条评审意见有意保持原样。一条是变异报告认为 `port != 0` 子句是死代码，但它逐字对应 Spring Boot 的 `ManagementPortType` 条件，留着方便读者对照。另一条认为 `serverBaseUrl()` 已无人调用，但它仍是 `listeners()` 里读 `server.env` 的回退，并有自己的测试。`--check` 的问题继续由 #16057 跟踪。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。现在被拒绝的 URL，以前每次探测也都会失败。

## 关联 Issue

#16051 的 follow-up。相关：#16057（本 PR 未处理）。

</details>

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js v24.18.0；本地源码构建和 package 级 Vitest 测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：混合模式会在每个普通工具描述中增加一段简短的嵌套调用声明，使 prompt 略微增大；完整 schema 不会在 `exec` 描述中重复。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未进行真实 provider 的交互式运行，也未在 Windows/Linux 本地执行；支持平台由 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：`tools.codeModeOnly` 已移除。请将 `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` 替换为 `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #10377。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): gate project hooks behind an approval dialog
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Hooks declared in a workspace's `.qwen/settings.json` now need the user's approval before they load, the same way project MCP servers do (#4615). The first interactive start in a workspace that declares hooks shows a dialog listing every hook (event, matcher and command) with Approve / Reject (Esc postpones to the next start or `/hooks` and notes in the transcript that the hooks were not loaded). Every repo-supplied string in the dialog is sanitized to one row, the list shows each hook's env, header names, allowed env vars and prompt text, and it is capped to the terminal height so the options stay visible. The decision is saved per project (keyed by the folder holding the `.qwen/settings.json`, so `/cd` and `--worktree` don't move it) in `~/.qwen/hookApprovals.json`, bound to a hash of the exact hooks configuration, so any later edit asks again while a settled rejection is not re-asked. Approving mid-session un-gates the hooks on the running config and reloads the hook registry; `/hooks` (which re-reads settings) recomputes the gate so an edited block stays unloaded and the dialog pops again. Both the ink and OpenTUI renderers get the dialog, and both `/hooks` browsers (plus the ACP hooks status) list withheld project hooks as awaiting approval. Headless runs cannot prompt, so unapproved project hooks stay unloaded and `qwen -p` prints one stderr line saying how to approve them. Only a YOLO asked for on the command line (`--yolo`, `--approval-mode yolo`) skips the gate, since a repository's own settings can set `tools.approvalMode`; `--bare`, `--safe-mode` and `disableAllHooks` load no hooks and ask nothing. A project `.env` cannot relocate the approvals file. User, system and extension hooks are untouched. Docs for hooks and trusted folders describe the new step, and a design doc (EN + zh-CN) records the decisions.

## Why it's needed

`security.folderTrust.enabled` defaults to `false`, and a disabled feature treats every folder as trusted, so a cloned repository's `.qwen/settings.json` is merged in full and its `SessionStart` (or any other) command hooks run the moment `qwen` starts there, with no prompt. "Clone a repo, open an AI coding tool in it" is a routine action, which makes this remote code execution for anyone who can get a user to clone a repository. Project MCP servers from the same file already have a hash-bound approval gate; project hooks had none. Gating hooks the same way closes the hole without changing the folder-trust default or breaking repositories that legitimately use project hooks: they keep working after a one-time approval.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Create a repository with `.qwen/settings.json` containing `{ "hooks": { "SessionStart": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "touch /tmp/repo-hook-ran" }] }] } }` and use a fresh `QWEN_HOME` (no `security.folderTrust`). Run `qwen -p hi` in it. Expected: `/tmp/repo-hook-ran` is not created and stderr says the project hooks were not loaded because they are not approved. On main the file is created silently.
2. Run `qwen` interactively in the same repository. Expected: a yellow "Untrusted hooks in .qwen/settings.json" dialog lists `SessionStart  touch /tmp/repo-hook-ran`; the hook has not run while the dialog is open. Choose Approve. Expected: `~/.qwen/hookApprovals.json` now has a record for the repository path with `status: approved`; a second start shows no dialog and the hook runs. `qwen -p hi` now also runs it.
3. Edit the hook command in `.qwen/settings.json` and start again. Expected: the dialog is back (the stored hash no longer matches) and the hook does not run until re-approved. Choose Reject: no dialog on later starts, hooks stay unloaded, until the block changes again.
4. With the dialog pending in a session, run `/hooks`: project hooks are listed as awaiting approval; after approving, they are enabled under source Project.
5. `qwen --yolo -p hi` runs the hook without a record; adding `"tools": {"approvalMode": "yolo"}` to the repository's own settings does not, and `qwen -p hi` stays gated. `--safe-mode`, `--bare` and `disableAllHooks` load no hooks and print no warning.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (main @ 628ab5c1af), headless, fresh home:

```
$ qwen -p hi
PONG
$ ls -l /tmp/repo-hook-ran
-rw-r--r--  1 user  wheel  0 Oct 19 11:15 /tmp/repo-hook-ran
```

After, headless:

```
$ qwen -p hi
Project hooks in .qwen/settings.json were not loaded: they are not approved for this folder. Run qwen interactively here to review them.
PONG
$ ls -l /tmp/repo-hook-ran
ls: /tmp/repo-hook-ran: No such file or directory
```

After, interactive start (captured with expect; the hook file does not exist while the dialog is open):

```
   │ Untrusted hooks in .qwen/settings.json
   │ This workspace declares hooks: commands Qwen Code runs on events such as
   │  session start or before a tool call. Approving lets them run with your
   │ privileges. Approval is bound to this exact configuration — if
   │ .qwen/settings.json changes, you will be asked again.
   │
   │   SessionStart  touch /tmp/repo-hook-ran
   │
   │ › 1. Approve these hooks
   │   2. Reject (esc)
```

After approving, `~/.qwen/hookApprovals.json`:

```json
{
  "/private/var/.../cloned-repo": {
    "hash": "a6f5750fd7ee774be7238ccc4fe62412ca9e52fb6dbb9909834f2a5a939ad74c",
    "status": "approved"
  }
}
```

A second interactive start shows no dialog and creates `/tmp/repo-hook-ran`; after editing the hook command, `qwen -p hi` is gated again.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local `npm run bundle` build run against a mock model provider; unit tests via `npx vitest run` in `packages/core` and `packages/cli`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: users who rely on project hooks see one new dialog per repository (and again after each edit to the hooks block). Headless and ACP sessions in a repository whose hooks were never approved interactively silently skip them; headless prints a warning, ACP does not yet.
- Not validated / out of scope: an ACP request to approve project hooks (follow-up, mirroring the MCP one); the experimental LSP `.lsp.json` command path described in the issue; re-firing `SessionStart` for hooks approved mid-session (they register for subsequent events; the next session runs them from the start). Windows and Linux rely on CI.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none in settings. Existing project hooks stop loading until approved once; the approval file is new and user-local.

Design doc: [docs/design/2026-10-19-project-hooks-approval-gate.md](https://github.com/TianYuan1024/qwen-code/blob/fix/project-hooks-approval-gate/docs/design/2026-10-19-project-hooks-approval-gate.md) / [中文](https://github.com/TianYuan1024/qwen-code/blob/fix/project-hooks-approval-gate/docs/design/2026-10-19-project-hooks-approval-gate.zh-CN.md).

Closes #14746

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

工作区 `.qwen/settings.json` 里声明的 hooks 现在需要用户批准后才会加载，与项目 MCP 服务器（#4615）一致。在声明了 hooks 的工作区第一次交互式启动时，会弹出对话框列出每条 hook（事件、matcher、命令），可选批准或拒绝（Esc 推迟到下次启动或打开 `/hooks` 时，并在会话记录中提示 hooks 未加载）。对话框中仓库提供的每个字符串都被清理为一行，列表展示每个 hook 的 env、请求头名称、允许的环境变量和 prompt 文本，并按终端高度截断以保证选项可见。决定按项目（以 `.qwen/settings.json` 所在目录为键，`/cd` 与 `--worktree` 不影响）保存在 `~/.qwen/hookApprovals.json`，绑定 hooks 配置的哈希，因此之后的任何修改都会重新询问，而已拒绝的配置不会反复询问。会话中批准会解除运行中 config 的闸门并重载 hook 注册表；`/hooks`（会重新读取设置）会重新计算闸门，修改过的 hooks 块保持不加载并再次弹出对话框。ink 与 OpenTUI 两套渲染器都有该对话框，两个 `/hooks` 浏览器（以及 ACP hooks 状态）都把被扣留的项目 hooks 标为等待审批。无头模式无法提示，未批准的项目 hooks 保持不加载，`qwen -p` 在 stderr 打印一行说明如何批准。只有命令行要求的 YOLO（`--yolo`、`--approval-mode yolo`）跳过闸门，因为仓库自己的设置可以设置 `tools.approvalMode`；`--bare`、`--safe-mode` 与 `disableAllHooks` 不加载 hooks 也不询问。项目 `.env` 不能改变审批文件位置。用户、系统和扩展 hooks 不受影响。hooks 与 trusted folders 文档描述了新步骤，并附设计文档（中英）。

## 为什么需要

`security.folderTrust.enabled` 默认关闭，关闭时每个目录都被视为受信任，克隆仓库的 `.qwen/settings.json` 会被完整合并，其中 `SessionStart`（或任何事件）的命令 hook 在 `qwen` 启动时就执行，没有任何提示。"克隆仓库 → 在里面打开 AI 编码工具"是再普通不过的操作，这相当于对任何能让用户克隆仓库的人开放了远程代码执行。同一文件里的项目 MCP 服务器已经有哈希绑定的审批闸门，项目 hooks 却没有。用同样的方式给 hooks 加闸门，既不改目录信任默认值，也不破坏合法使用项目 hooks 的仓库：一次批准后照常工作。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 创建一个仓库，`.qwen/settings.json` 内容为 `{ "hooks": { "SessionStart": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "touch /tmp/repo-hook-ran" }] }] } }`，使用全新的 `QWEN_HOME`（未设置 `security.folderTrust`）。在其中运行 `qwen -p hi`。预期：`/tmp/repo-hook-ran` 未创建，stderr 提示项目 hooks 因未批准而未加载。在 main 上该文件会被静默创建。
2. 在同一仓库交互式运行 `qwen`。预期：黄色的 "Untrusted hooks in .qwen/settings.json" 对话框列出 `SessionStart  touch /tmp/repo-hook-ran`；对话框打开期间 hook 未执行。选择 Approve。预期：`~/.qwen/hookApprovals.json` 中出现该仓库路径的记录，`status: approved`；再次启动不再弹框，hook 执行；`qwen -p hi` 也会执行它。
3. 修改 `.qwen/settings.json` 中的 hook 命令后再启动。预期：对话框再次出现（存储的哈希不再匹配），重新批准前 hook 不执行。选择 Reject：之后启动不再弹框，hooks 保持不加载，直到该块再次变化。
4. 对话框待定时运行 `/hooks`：项目 hooks 显示为禁用；批准后 `/hooks` 在 Project 来源下显示为启用。
5. `qwen --yolo -p hi` 无需记录即执行 hook；在仓库自己的设置里加 `"tools": {"approvalMode": "yolo"}` 则不行，`qwen -p hi` 仍被拦截。`--safe-mode`、`--bare` 与 `disableAllHooks` 不加载任何 hooks，也不打印警告。

### 证据（修复前 / 后）

见上方英文部分：修复前无头运行静默创建文件；修复后无头运行被拦截并给出警告，交互式启动显示审批对话框，批准后写入 `hookApprovals.json`，再次启动不再询问；修改 hook 后再次被拦截。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows、Linux 依赖 CI ⚠️。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：使用项目 hooks 的用户每个仓库会多一次对话框（hooks 块每次修改后再问一次）。从未交互式批准过的仓库，无头与 ACP 会话会静默跳过项目 hooks；无头会打印警告，ACP 目前不会。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：ACP 审批项目 hooks 的请求（后续，照 MCP 的实现）；issue 里描述的实验性 LSP `.lsp.json` 命令路径；会话中批准后补发 `SessionStart`（批准后对后续事件生效，下一次会话从头执行）。Windows 与 Linux 依赖 CI。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：设置无变化。既有项目 hooks 在批准一次之前不再加载；审批文件为新增的用户本地文件。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #14746

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): prove A3 rewritten command recovery without Hook rerun
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Completes the remaining A3 rewritten-input / Hook-no-rerun half of the G3 Step 3 recovery matrix. It proves that a command input rewritten by a Hook is treated as a new, independently approved step rather than inheriting the previous step's Allow; that completed Hook occurrences and completed command steps replay durable results after restart without physical re-execution; and that an outer skill expanding into two command steps survives a crash between the steps while preserving the second Action's identity and deadline. It adds a packaged failover arm, durable evidence collection, focused regression witnesses, and synchronized English/Chinese design documentation.

## Why it's needed

Issue #14481 tracks recovery gaps where restart could reuse an approval for a different final command input, rerun already-completed Hooks or command effects, or lose the identity of a later command step. These behaviors are safety- and correctness-critical for managed command execution: a rewritten input must not ride on a stale Allow, and durable receipts must be the source of truth for replay. This change closes the A3 gap with real packaged evidence rather than only unit-level assertions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the new packaged command-rewrite failover arm in the managed-agent harness. The expected observation is a three-generation sequence: generation 1 waits for the first command approval; generation 2 allows the first step, completes it and its PostToolUse occurrence, then crashes when the second approval is requested; generation 3 replays the first step and completed Hook occurrences from durable results without physical rerun, preserves the second Action's ID, creation time, expiry, and input reference, and requires a separate Allow for the second step. The final evidence must show two distinct Actions, one physical execution for each command stage and each completed Hook occurrence, settled command receipts, recorded model traffic, a completed relief Turn, terminal count 2, and reliable close. A focused TypeScript regression can be run with `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-command-step-hook-recovery.test.ts`. The merged branch passes local TypeScript build/typecheck and contract/meta suites; full Java and Hosted CI gates are pending on this PR.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI recovery and evidence changes. A separate PR comment contains the packaged run report, evidence hashes, local gate results, and CI-pending caveats.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS TypeScript tests, build, and typecheck; real packaged managed-agent harness on Linux with Temurin 21, MySQL 8.4, registered storage, and delegated cgroup. Acceptance remains pending until the required CI gates pass on the merged revision.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Recovery now distinguishes extension-owned Hook/command replay from native approval continuation; incorrect gating could either re-execute durable effects or block legitimate recovery. The added packaged arm and regression witnesses pin both sides.
- Not validated / out of scope: Full post-merge Java/Hosted CI suites are not yet green. Local full ESLint was OOM-limited on this host, so lint was run partitioned with generated build outputs ignored. R2 remains out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No public API migration. Action ID validation now accepts the command-step Action grammar alongside the legacy tool approval grammar; stored development catalogs should follow the module's baseline schema policy.

Design documentation: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-a3-rewritten-hook/docs/design/2026-11-01-hosted-a3-rewritten-hook.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-a3-rewritten-hook/docs/design/2026-11-01-hosted-a3-rewritten-hook.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and follow-up work.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14481 (G3 Step 3 A3 rewritten-input / Hook-no-rerun recovery). This PR does not auto-close the tracker.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

完成 G3 Step 3 恢复矩阵中剩余的 A3「改写输入 / Hook 不重跑」半边。它证明：被 Hook 改写后的命令输入会作为新的、需要独立批准的步骤处理，而不是继承上一步的 Allow；已完成的 Hook occurrence 和已完成的命令步骤在重启后通过持久化结果重放，不会物理重跑；外层 skill 展开成两个命令步骤时，在两步之间崩溃仍能保留第二个 Action 的身份和截止时间。它新增了一个打包故障支路、持久化证据采集、聚焦回归见证，以及同步的英文/中文设计文档。

## 为什么需要它

Issue #14481 跟踪了一些恢复缺口：重启后可能把批准复用于不同的最终命令输入、重跑已经完成的 Hook 或命令副作用，或者丢失后续命令步骤的身份。这些行为对受管命令执行的安全性和正确性至关重要：改写后的输入不能搭上旧的 Allow，持久化回执必须作为重放的唯一事实来源。这个变更用真实打包证据关闭 A3 缺口，而不仅依赖单元级断言。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 managed-agent harness 中运行新增的打包 command-rewrite 故障支路。预期观察到三代序列：第 1 代等待第一个命令批准；第 2 代允许第一步，完成第一步及其 PostToolUse occurrence，然后在请求第二个批准时崩溃；第 3 代从持久化结果重放第一步和已完成 Hook occurrence，不物理重跑，保留第二个 Action 的 ID、创建时间、过期时间和输入引用，并要求对第二步单独 Allow。最终证据必须显示两个不同 Action、每个命令阶段和每个已完成 Hook occurrence 各一次物理执行、已落定的命令回执、记录的模型流量、完成的 relief Turn、terminal count 2，以及可靠 close。聚焦 TypeScript 回归可通过 `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-command-step-hook-recovery.test.ts` 运行。合并后的分支已通过本地 TypeScript build/typecheck 和契约/元测试套件；完整 Java 和 Hosted CI 门禁仍待本 PR 触发。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A — 非 UI 的恢复与证据变更。单独的 PR 评论包含打包运行报告、证据哈希、本地门禁结果和 CI 待通过说明。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

本地 macOS TypeScript 测试、构建和类型检查；Linux 上的真实打包 managed-agent harness，使用 Temurin 21、MySQL 8.4、注册存储和委托 cgroup。在所需 CI 门禁于合并修订上通过之前，验收仍为 pending。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：恢复逻辑现在区分扩展拥有的 Hook/命令重放与原生批准 continuation；错误门控可能导致重跑持久化副作用，或阻塞合法恢复。新增打包支路和回归见证钉住了两侧。
- 未验证 / 范围外：合并后的完整 Java/Hosted CI 套件尚未变绿。本机完整 ESLint 受 OOM 限制，因此 lint 采用分区运行并忽略生成构建产物。R2 仍不在范围内。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无公共 API 迁移。Action ID 校验现在在旧版工具批准语法之外接受命令步骤 Action 语法；已存储的开发目录应遵循模块的基线 schema 策略。

设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-a3-rewritten-hook/docs/design/2026-11-01-hosted-a3-rewritten-hook.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-a3-rewritten-hook/docs/design/2026-11-01-hosted-a3-rewritten-hook.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和后续工作。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14481（G3 Step 3 A3 改写输入 / Hook 不重跑恢复）。本 PR 不自动关闭该跟踪 Issue。

prs.title: fix(permissions): match amend invocations instead of raw text
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The AUTO-mode amend guard now matches parsed shell invocations instead of testing the raw command text. It splits compound commands, strips heredoc bodies, unwraps shell wrappers, skips transparent execution prefixes, and only then checks for a `git commit` invocation carrying `--amend`.

The guard still recognizes absolute git paths, `.exe` paths, environment assignments, `sudo`/`env`/`timeout`-style prefixes, shell wrappers, control-flow keywords, and `eval`. Inert text inside arguments, quoted strings, grep patterns, and heredocs is no longer treated as an amend.

## Why it's needed

Issue #13570 reported that commands containing no git invocation were hard-blocked merely because their text mentioned `git commit --amend`. This affected bug reports, tests, changelog entries, commit-message arguments, grep patterns, and heredocs.

The previous substring match was also easy to defeat through indirection. Parsing actual command segments fixes the false positive while making recognition stricter about what actually executes.

This PR addresses defect 1 in #13570 only. #13636 already fixed the destructive-denial escalation path; the policy changes for the user-prompt escape hatch, `pmForcedAsk` ordering, and `skipClassifierReason` ordering are intentionally out of scope here.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With AUTO mode active and no session commit registered, run a command that merely contains the amend phrase in data, such as `node -e 'console.log("a report about git commit --amend behaviour")'`, `echo "git commit --amend"`, `grep -n "git commit --amend" CHANGELOG.md`, or a heredoc that writes the phrase to a file. The command should reach normal permission evaluation instead of returning the destructive-command denial.

Then try actual amends through common spellings: `git commit --amend --no-edit`, `/usr/bin/git commit --amend`, `git -c core.editor=true commit --amend`, `bash -c 'git commit --amend'`, `sudo env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=now git commit --amend`, `timeout 10 git commit --amend`, `if true; then git commit --amend; fi`, and `eval 'git commit --amend'`. These should remain blocked when HEAD was not registered as a session commit.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A. This is a permission-parser change with unit coverage, not a user-visible layout change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Local tests were intentionally not run under the current execution constraints. CI will exercise the added regression cases.

### Environment (optional)

N/A.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The new recognizer handles the shell forms the codebase already models. Runtime string construction remains outside static recognition, as it was with the previous guard — but that parity does not hold for every indirection form: the previous substring guard still fired on some spellings this token-based recognizer cannot see, so the two are not interchangeable and this PR narrows the surface rather than matching it exactly.
- Not validated / out of scope: Verified locally — `destructive-commands.test.ts` and `shell-semantics.test.ts` (156 passing) and `prettier --check` on both changed files. Not run: the rest of `packages/core`, the build, and typecheck; those are CI's. The prompt-based escape hatch, user `ask`-rule ordering, and `skipClassifierReason` ordering from #13570 are not changed in this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13570

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

AUTO 模式的 amend 防护现在匹配解析后的 shell 调用，而不是检查原始命令文本。它会拆分复合命令、移除 heredoc 正文、解开 shell wrapper、跳过透明执行前缀，然后才检查是否存在带 `--amend` 的 `git commit` 调用。

防护仍然能识别绝对 git 路径、`.exe` 路径、环境变量赋值、`sudo`/`env`/`timeout` 这类前缀、shell wrapper、控制流关键字以及 `eval`。参数、引号字符串、grep 模式和 heredoc 中仅提及 amend 的惰性文本不再被当作 amend。

## 为什么需要

Issue #13570 报告：一些根本没有执行 git 的命令，只因为文本里出现了 `git commit --amend` 就被直接拦截。受影响的有 bug 报告、测试、changelog、提交信息参数、grep 模式和 heredoc。

旧的子串匹配也很容易被间接写法绕过。解析真实命令段既修复了误报，也让识别更贴近实际执行内容。

这个 PR 只处理 #13570 的缺陷 1。#13636 已经修复了 destructive denial 的升级路径；用户 prompt 逃生口、`pmForcedAsk` 顺序和 `skipClassifierReason` 顺序属于策略变更，本 PR 有意不处理。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

在 AUTO 模式且未注册会话提交的情况下，运行只在数据中包含 amend 短语的命令，例如 `node -e 'console.log("a report about git commit --amend behaviour")'`、`echo "git commit --amend"`、`grep -n "git commit --amend" CHANGELOG.md`，或用 heredoc 把该短语写进文件。命令应进入正常权限评估，而不是返回 destructive-command 拒绝。

然后尝试实际 amend 的常见写法：`git commit --amend --no-edit`、`/usr/bin/git commit --amend`、`git -c core.editor=true commit --amend`、`bash -c 'git commit --amend'`、`sudo env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=now git commit --amend`、`timeout 10 git commit --amend`、`if true; then git commit --amend; fi` 和 `eval 'git commit --amend'`。当 HEAD 不是本会话注册的提交时，这些命令仍应被拦截。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A。这是权限解析变更并配有单元测试，不涉及用户可见布局变化。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

按照当前执行约束，本地测试有意未运行。新增的回归用例会由 CI 执行。

### 环境（可选）

N/A。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：新识别器覆盖代码库已经建模的 shell 形式。运行时拼接字符串等不支持的动态构造仍不在静态识别范围内，这一点与旧防护一致。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：未在本地运行测试、构建、typecheck、lint 或格式化。未修改 #13570 中基于 prompt 的逃生口、用户 `ask` 规则顺序和 `skipClassifierReason` 顺序。
- Breaking changes / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #13570

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): avoid unsupported forced Anthropic tool selection
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Avoids forced tool selection on Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1. Requests that previously required a tool use `auto` on those models and explicitly name the expected tools. Only schema-response requests offer JSON text as an alternative; ordinary tools are still instructed to call the tool. Supported and unknown models retain the existing request shape.

## Why it's needed

These models reject `tool_choice:any` with HTTP 400. JSON side queries use that selection mode, so permission classification, memory selection and other structured requests fail even while the main conversation works. This is documented in [Anthropic's tool-choice restrictions](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/define-tools#forcing-tool-use) and reported in #15542.

The change stays on the Anthropic wire and uses the existing model-version parser. It does not change the OpenAI-compatible behavior tracked in #13919 or introduce a structured-output subsystem.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run a structured side query on an affected model. The outgoing Anthropic request should use `auto`, include the schema-tool instruction, and return the structured result from either tool arguments or JSON response text. Repeat on Haiku 5.5 or Opus 4.6: these must retain `any`. Dotted and provider-prefixed affected model IDs should select the same fallback. Normal AUTO requests and requests without tools should be unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent loopback HTTP probe drives the real JSON client, Anthropic generator and Anthropic SDK. The fixture rejects forced tool selection for affected models according to the documented API contract; no generator or converter is mocked.

| Probe | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sonnet 5.5 / Opus 5.5 JSON query | Sends `any`, receives 400, query fails | Sends `auto`, structured result extracted |
| Haiku 5.5 / Opus 4.6 controls | Sends `any`, succeeds | Still sends `any`, succeeds |
| Expanded 8-model × 2 response-format matrix | Not used as baseline | 16/16 pass, covering tool arguments and JSON text |

501 related tests pass across the Anthropic provider/converter, JSON client and forked-agent consumers. Build, bundle, repository-wide typecheck and lint pass. Formatting and diff checks pass. Full `npm run preflight` was attempted: clean install/build, formatting, lint and typecheck passed, followed by 3,573 passing tests in the first four workspaces. The CLI suite then reported `read ECONNRESET` in the unchanged `multi-workspace-sessions.test.ts` case “validates the workspace session search query parameters”; I interrupted the remaining full run. That exact test passed in isolation on this head (1 passed, 177 skipped). Its cause is not established; I am not claiming a fully green preflight. The remaining full-suite tests and final serve-bundle check did not complete.

This is wire-level reproduction against a local service, not a live Claude API test or a measurement of model adherence. The globally installed CLI was also tried in an isolated local session, but that older binary only exercised the main conversation, not the side-query path. The current-source wire probe is the reproduction evidence.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS arm64 | ✅ |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment

Node 26.7.0, pnpm 11.24.0, base `1dc74d58384ca1fe8c29730970f1f7c60d1e5265`. Tests use dummy credentials and local HTTP only. Provider unit tests ran with inherited Anthropic credential/base-URL overrides unset.

## Risk & Scope

- `auto` does not guarantee a tool call. Existing JSON consumers accept tool arguments or a JSON object in response text; the fallback instruction makes that expectation explicit.
- This does not globally enable strict schemas or alter schema validation. Live model adherence and token-budget behavior remain unmeasured.
- No dependency changes, permission changes, or migration required. The existing main-session AUTO path is unchanged.
- Prepared with local Grok Build, then independently reviewed and verified; compilation and scope corrections were applied before delivery.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15542.

prs.title: feat(serve): enable remote access from settings without restarting
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds **Settings → Connections → Allow remote connections** to a running `qwen serve`. Remote access starts off. A local operator can enable it without restarting the daemon, then copy its address and a separate bearer token into another Web Shell's connection form. The listener uses the selected network interface and prefers the existing port; a collision is reported instead of silently choosing another port.

Disabling access or resetting the token disconnects remote clients while preserving the primary listener, workspaces, sessions and running prompts. Reconnecting with the current token returns to the original session. The sidebar now reflects offline and unauthorized states, and connection errors explain invalid tokens, readable policy denials, mixed content, and inconclusive network/CORS/certificate failures.

## Why it's needed

An address/token form was insufficient when an existing daemon only listened on loopback or did not allow the local browser origin. Changing startup configuration disrupted the very sessions the user wanted to reach. This adds an explicitly enabled, separately authenticated entrance to the same runtime and puts the setup guidance beside the connection form.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start an ordinary daemon and open its local Settings → Connections. Remote access should be off. Select an interface if several are available and enable it; the displayed address should use the original numeric port unless an explicit alternate port was selected.
2. From a second local Web Shell, add that address and token, select the saved host, and send a message. The workspace, response and persisted session should belong to the target daemon.
3. Disable remote access while a task is running. The client should disconnect and show offline, while the primary local service and task continue. Re-enable, enter the new token, and restore the same session. A token reset should similarly reject the old credential and display unauthorized.
4. Occupy the requested remote port and enable access. Expect an explicit bind error and an off switch; no unrelated listener should be stopped. Restarting the daemon should also return remote access to off.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: issue #15877 records a loopback-only remote listener and a rejected browser-origin preflight. A later two-daemon acceptance run also caught a stale “connected” sidebar badge after the transport disconnected.

After: two separate local daemons with isolated configuration, workspaces and controlled model providers completed the address/token flow. Both messages were received and persisted only by daemon B; daemon A had no matching session. Disable/re-enable retained both process IDs and restored the same session ID. The focused follow-up confirmed offline after disable, unauthorized with the revoked token, and connected after restoring the same session. The accompanying acceptance comment contains screenshots.

Previously completed feature validation: 314 targeted tests, affected CLI/Web Shell typechecks, and the Web Shell application build passed. Final sidebar regression: 11/11 passed; after aligning with current main, the authentication and sidebar suites passed 68/68. Formatting passed for all changed files. Local correctness and security review found no blocking issue. These feature checks are reused evidence from the same unchanged backend implementation; they were not all rerun for PR creation.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local daemon/browser/ACP acceptance |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22, source daemon entrypoint, two independent local daemon processes, the Mac's assigned IPv4 interface, real browser/ACP transports and controlled OpenAI-compatible providers. No external model or remote server deployment was used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a remotely reachable operator API grants the daemon user's authority. Management is restricted to an authorized local primary connection; the secondary listener has its own token, Host and browser-origin policy. Existing public assets/discovery and independently authenticated routes retain their own contracts.
- Not validated / out of scope: another physical machine's firewall/NAT, IPv6, browser-trusted TLS deployment, and the complete Desktop/IDE/managed compatibility matrix. No support for hot-upgrading an already running older binary. A full merge-base runtime comparison was not rerun; evidence is single-candidate acceptance plus a before/after capture of the badge fix.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: remote access remains off by default and is not persisted across restarts. Existing explicit external primary binds remain externally configured. HTTP should be used on a trusted network; HTTPS pages require an HTTPS target and appropriate origin configuration.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/live-remote-access-settings/docs/design/2026-10-30-live-remote-access.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/live-remote-access-settings/docs/design/2026-10-30-live-remote-access.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the same ownership, authentication, lifecycle and acceptance boundaries.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15877.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 本 PR 的改动

为运行中的 `qwen serve` 增加“设置 → 连接 → 允许远程连接”。远程访问默认关闭，本地操作者可以免重启开启，再把显示的地址和独立 bearer token 填入另一端 Web Shell 的连接表单。入口绑定所选网卡并优先沿用原端口；端口冲突会明确报错，不会自动换端口。

关闭访问或重置 token 会断开远程客户端，同时保留主监听器、工作区、会话和运行中的任务。使用当前 token 重连可恢复原会话。侧栏现在跟随离线和未授权状态；连接错误会解释无效 token、可读取的策略拒绝、混合内容，以及无法进一步区分的网络/CORS/证书失败。

### 为什么需要

已有 daemon 只监听回环地址或未允许本地页面来源时，仅填写地址和 token 无法完成连接。修改启动参数又会打断用户想访问的会话。本次为同一个 runtime 增加显式开启、独立鉴权的入口，并把配置指引放到连接表单旁。

### 审阅者验证步骤

1. 普通启动 daemon，打开本地“设置 → 连接”，远程访问应默认关闭。多个网卡时先选择，再开启；未明确设置其他端口时，显示地址应沿用原数字端口。
2. 从第二个本地 Web Shell 添加地址和 token，选中已保存的主机并发消息。工作区、回复和持久化会话都应属于目标 daemon。
3. 任务运行中关闭远程访问。客户端应断开并显示离线，主入口和任务继续运行。重新开启、填写新 token 后应恢复同一会话。重置 token 同样使旧凭据失效，并显示未授权。
4. 占用要开放的端口后开启，应显示明确绑定错误且开关保持关闭，不停止无关监听器。daemon 重启后远程访问也应恢复关闭。

### 前后证据

修改前：#15877 记录了远端只监听回环地址，以及浏览器来源预检被拒绝。之后的双实例验收还发现传输断开后侧栏仍显示“已连接”。

修改后：两个分别配置工作区和受控模型服务的本地 daemon 完成了地址/token 连接。两条消息都只由 B 接收和持久化，A 没有对应会话。关闭再开启保留两个 PID，并恢复同一会话 ID。专项补验确认关闭后显示离线、撤销的 token 显示未授权，更新 token 恢复原会话后显示已连接。验收评论包含对应截图。

之前的功能验证已有 314 项针对性测试、CLI/Web Shell 类型检查和 Web Shell 页面构建通过。最终侧栏回归：11/11 通过；对齐当前 main 后，认证与侧栏测试共 68/68 通过。所有改动文件的格式检查通过；本地正确性和安全审查未发现阻塞问题。功能验证复用了后端实现未变的既有证据，并未为开 PR 全部重跑。

### 验证环境

macOS 已验证本地 daemon、浏览器及 ACP；Windows、Linux 未验证。使用 Node.js 22、源码 daemon 入口、两个独立 daemon 进程、本机已分配 IPv4、真实浏览器/ACP 传输和受控 OpenAI 兼容服务。没有调用外部模型或部署远端服务器。

### 风险与范围

- 远程 operator API 拥有 daemon 用户权限。管理操作要求授权的本地主入口连接；新增入口拥有独立 token、Host 和浏览器来源策略。已有公共静态资源/discovery 和独立鉴权路由保留原契约。
- 未验证另一台机器的防火墙/NAT、IPv6、浏览器可信 TLS 部署及完整 Desktop/IDE/managed 兼容矩阵。不支持热升级正在运行的旧二进制。没有重跑完整 merge-base 运行对照；证据为单个候选版本验收，以及侧栏修正前后的截图。
- 远程访问默认关闭，重启后不保留；显式对外绑定的主入口仍由原配置管理。HTTP 用于可信网络；HTTPS 页面需要 HTTPS 目标和合适的来源设置。

[英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/live-remote-access-settings/docs/design/2026-10-30-live-remote-access.md)和[中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/live-remote-access-settings/docs/design/2026-10-30-live-remote-access.zh-CN.md)同步描述归属、鉴权、生命周期与验收边界。

关联并修复 #15877。

</details>

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): add local Docker recipe with a host-side model proxy
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Gives local `/verify-pr` rounds a concrete, tested way to run inside Docker with the model credential held on the host. A new standalone model proxy relays only chat-completion requests, swaps the container's per-run bearer token for the real API key upstream, and prints its listen coordinates as one JSON line. The skill gains a step-by-step recipe that pairs this proxy with a Docker invocation and an in-container provider configuration, so a maintainer no longer has to invent the isolation boundary — or the credential plumbing — by hand. The CI lane is untouched and keeps its own inline proxy.

## Why it's needed

The skill requires local rounds to execute untrusted PR code inside a credential-free boundary, but documented only the boundary check, not how to satisfy it: there was no proxy to keep the real model key out of the container, no Docker template, and a non-obvious trap where the isolation gate refuses any non-empty `OPENAI_API_KEY` — including a harmless proxy token. The recipe resolves that trap by carrying the token under a dedicated variable that the provider configuration reads through `envKey`, and each step is backed by a real container smoke run rather than reasoning.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the new pin suite plus the existing verify-pr suites: `npm run test:scripts:unit -- scripts/tests/verify-pr-credential-scan.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-model-proxy.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-prepare.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-guard.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-watch-gate.test.js` — 187 tests passed (78 new), covering bearer rejection, exact path allowlist, base-path prefixing, upstream key injection, hop-by-hop stripping (fixed set and `Connection`-nominated names), gzip upstream bodies with the header stripped, pre-header disconnect abort, paused-downstream survival, slow-but-healthy streams, upstream reset survival, IPv6 listen formatting, the CLI's exit codes and JSON coordinates, `--context` head pinning, credential-scan boundaries (nested credentials and credential-bearing git config refused, installed tree allowed, the bare git@ username benign), and the recipe's trust lines.
- Follow the skill recipe with any OpenAI-compatible upstream: run the trusted preflight with the PR clone as cwd, start the proxy from a trusted checkout bound to the Docker bridge, start the named detached container against a standalone PR clone with the base `.qwen` pinned read-only, and confirm the in-container scan and isolation gate pass while a chat-completion POST succeeds only with the per-run token.
- Negative controls (run locally, observed): `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the container makes the gate exit 4; a nested `vault/.env` makes the scan exit 1; a tree whose only credential-shaped files are inside `node_modules` passes the scan.

Local smoke evidence (this branch, `node:22-bookworm`, mock upstream on the host, revised recipe): the real trusted prepare ran with `cwd=<pr-clone>`; inside the named container the base-pinned skill hash equals the base commit's blob and differs from the PR head's; `printenv QWEN_VERIFY_PROXY_TOKEN` equals the token exported from `proxy.json`; the scan passes a clean tree and an installed tree, and refuses `vault/.env`; the gate passes in step 5 and in the round-shell shape (with the attestation passed to `docker exec`); a container POST reaches the upstream with the real key injected while `proxy-authorization` and the `Connection`-nominated header never arrive; the mounted snapshot carries all eight metadata keys; a file written in `/work` is owned by the host uid; and the checker with `--context` passes while the forged artifact `context.json` only produces a head mismatch warning.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — maintainer tooling and documentation, no user-visible UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (unit suites + real Docker smoke) |

### Environment (optional)

Docker 26.1.3, `node:22-bookworm` container, mock upstream on host loopback; vitest via `test:scripts:unit`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the new proxy duplicates the CI lane's inline relay by design — the proxy holds the real key, so the CI lane must not execute a script from the PR-head checkout; the two copies can drift, and the script header calls this out.
- Not validated / out of scope: a full `/verify-pr` round inside the container with a real model was not run; the smoke covered the trusted preflight, base-pin, scan boundaries, gate (both shapes), relay, snapshot mount, ownership, checker pinning, and the negative controls. The CI workflow is unchanged; the recipe requires a standalone PR clone (a linked worktree's gitfile is outside the mount), and every script plus the base `.qwen` comes from the trusted checkout. The `review-pr` bot lane was red at `3509c2d1aa`: it exhausted ten retries on `API Error: 429 rpm exceeded` and exited 1 — a model-quota failure, not this diff; the other lanes are green.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为本地 `/verify-pr` 轮次提供一种具体且经过测试的方式：在 Docker 内运行验证，同时把模型凭据留在宿主机。新增一个独立的模型代理，只转发 chat completions 请求，把容器持有的一次性 bearer token 在上游替换为真实 API key，并以一行 JSON 打印监听坐标。skill 增加了分步配方，把该代理与 Docker 启动模板、容器内 provider 配置组合起来，维护者不必再手工发明隔离边界和凭据接线。CI 车道不受影响，保留自己的内联代理。

## 为什么需要

skill 要求本地轮次在无凭据边界内执行不可信的 PR 代码，但此前只文档化了边界检查，没有说明如何满足它：没有能把真实模型 key 挡在容器外的代理，没有 Docker 模板，还有一个不直观的坑——隔离门禁拒绝任何非空的 `OPENAI_API_KEY`，包括无害的代理 token。配方通过让 token 走一个专用变量、由 provider 配置经 `envKey` 读取来化解这个坑，且每一步都有真实容器冒烟证据，而非推理。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 运行新增 pin 套件与现有 verify-pr 套件：`npm run test:scripts:unit -- scripts/tests/verify-pr-credential-scan.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-model-proxy.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-prepare.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-guard.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-watch-gate.test.js`——187 条测试通过（新增 78 条），覆盖 bearer 拒绝、精确路径白名单、base path 前缀、上游 key 注入、hop-by-hop 剥离（固定集合与 `Connection` 点名的头）、gzip 上游响应（头被剥离）、响应头前断连中止、下游暂停存活、慢但健康的流、上游重置存活、IPv6 监听格式化、CLI 的退出码与 JSON 坐标、`--context` 头部钉住、凭据扫描边界（嵌套凭据与带凭据 git config 拒绝、已安装树放行、裸 git@ 用户名良性），以及配方的信任行。
- 按 skill 配方对任意 OpenAI 兼容上游操作：以 PR 克隆为 cwd 运行可信预检，从可信 checkout 启动绑定 Docker 网桥的代理，对独立 PR 克隆启动具名后台容器并只读挂载 base `.qwen`，确认容器内扫描与隔离门禁通过，且 chat completions POST 只有携带一次性 token 才成功。
- 负面对照（本地已实测）：容器内设置 `OPENAI_API_KEY` 时门禁 exit 4；嵌套 `vault/.env` 让扫描 exit 1；仅 `node_modules` 内含凭据文件的树通过扫描。

本地冒烟证据（本分支，`node:22-bookworm`，宿主机 mock upstream，修订后的配方）：真实可信 prepare 以 `cwd=<pr-clone>` 运行；具名容器内 base-pin 的 skill 哈希等于 base 提交 blob、且不同于 PR head；`printenv QWEN_VERIFY_PROXY_TOKEN` 与从 `proxy.json` 导出的 token 一致；扫描放行干净树与已安装树、拒绝 `vault/.env`；门禁在第 5 步与轮次 shell 形态（宣誓经 `docker exec` 传入）均通过；容器内 POST 到达上游且真实 key 已注入，`proxy-authorization` 与 `Connection` 点名的头未到达上游；挂载的快照含全部八个元数据键；在 `/work` 写入的文件属主为宿主 uid；带 `--context` 的检查器通过，而被伪造的产物 `context.json` 只产生 head 不匹配警告。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——维护者工具与文档，无用户可见界面。

### 测试平台

macOS 与 Windows 未测试；Linux 已测试（单元套件 + 真实 Docker 冒烟）。

### 环境（可选）

Docker 26.1.3，`node:22-bookworm` 容器，宿主机 loopback 上的 mock upstream；vitest 经 `test:scripts:unit` 运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：新代理有意与 CI 车道的内联转发重复——代理持有真实 key，CI 车道绝不能执行来自 PR head checkout 的脚本；两份实现可能漂移，脚本头注释已说明。
- 未验证/超出范围：未在容器内用真实模型跑完整 `/verify-pr` 轮次；冒烟覆盖了可信预检、base-pin、扫描边界、门禁（两种形态）、转发、快照挂载、文件属主、检查器钉头部与负面对照。CI workflow 未改动；配方要求独立的 PR 克隆（链接 worktree 的 gitfile 在挂载之外），且每个脚本与 base `.qwen` 都来自可信 checkout。`review-pr` bot 车道在 `3509c2d1aa` 为红：10 次重试后 `API Error: 429 rpm exceeded` 并退出 1——模型配额问题，不是本 diff；其余车道为绿。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): scrub advisor selector from startup errors
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The startup error for an unavailable Advisor model now renders the configured aux-model selector through the existing credential-safe display formatter. A selector such as `openai:missing-advisor\0https://user:sk-secret@gw.example/v1` is shown as `openai:missing-advisor (https://gw.example/v1)` instead of writing the userinfo credential and a literal NUL byte to stderr.

The raw selector is still passed unchanged to Advisor availability and routing checks; only the human-readable failure message is scrubbed.

## Why it's needed

Issue #12856 tracks the surfaces that emitted NUL-separated aux-model selectors verbatim. The earlier merged fix covered the daemon, ACP, settings, system-info and model-readback paths, but left the startup Advisor-validation failure open because the stored selector is also the routing key.

When an Advisor pin exists at User scope but its provider entry does not exist in the current workspace, startup fails with that selector interpolated into a `FatalConfigError`. The critical-error handler writes the message to stderr, placing a live credential in terminal scrollback, CI logs or redirected error files precisely when the user is inspecting the failure.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure `advisorModel` with a missing model name and an `https://user:sk-secret@host/v1` registry base URL, then start the CLI in a workspace where that provider is unavailable. Expected: startup still fails with the Advisor configuration error, but the model line shows the selector and scrubbed endpoint without userinfo or a raw NUL; the raw selector still determines which configured models count as available.
2. Repeat with an ordinary selector such as `missing-advisor`. Expected: the existing error text is unchanged.
3. Repeat with an non-http suffix or a value that cannot be parsed as a selector. Expected: the display helper drops the unpublishable suffix rather than echoing it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The regression test drives the real `loadCliConfig` startup path and captures the resulting `FatalConfigError`. It asserts that the message contains the scrubbed model label and does not contain `sk-secret` or a NUL byte.

The current execution constraint did not permit local tests, build, typecheck or formatting commands, so these checks were not run locally and no passing result is claimed.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit-test path only; no live provider or model request is involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the rendered label can differ from the persisted selector, but this is deliberate and matches every other aux-selector display surface. The routing value itself is not transformed.
- Not validated / out of scope: local tests, build, typecheck and formatting were not run. The remaining startup-handshake work discussed in #12856 is unrelated; this PR covers only the deferred Advisor stderr surface.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Persisted settings keep their current format.

## Linked Issues

Refs #12856. This closes the deferred startup-error surface, while the issue remains the tracking point for any remaining class-wide format decisions.

原始 selector 仍会原样传给 Advisor 可用性检查和路由逻辑；只有面向用户的失败文案会被清洗。

### 如何验证

当前执行约束不允许运行本地测试、构建、类型检查或格式化命令，因此这些检查未在本地运行，也不声称通过。

- 未验证 / 不在范围内：未运行本地测试、构建、类型检查与格式化。#12856 中其他启动握手相关工作与本 PR 无关；本 PR 只覆盖延期的 Advisor stderr 输出面。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。持久化设置维持现有格式。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #12856。本 PR 完成其中延期的启动错误输出面，issue 仍作为剩余格式统一决策的追踪入口。

prs.title: fix(core): require explicit trust for project frontmatter and LSP
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Repository-supplied skill and subagent hooks, skill permission grants, and project language servers now require explicit directory trust. Disabling the folder-trust feature no longer authorizes those execution paths. Users can enable folder trust and approve their directory, or supply an affirmative IDE workspace-trust decision. Project hooks and grants recheck trust when used; language servers check before executable probes or startup, including reloads and restarts.

The change reuses the existing directory-trust flow. It adds no approval store or dialog, preserves the legacy trust behavior of unrelated features, and keeps user, bundled and extension configuration under its existing policy.

## Why it's needed

With default settings, folder trust treats every directory as trusted. A repository can therefore execute frontmatter hook commands or start a configured language server without a directory-trust decision. #14748 addresses settings-file hooks; these are the remaining execution paths identified in #14746. This PR is independent of that approval-dialog implementation and does not replace it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Use a fresh user home and a repository with a skill hook, subagent hook and project language-server command that each write a harmless marker. Keep folder trust at its default and allow ordinary skill/agent invocation. Invoking the skill and agent should still load their instructions and permit ordinary allowed tools, but no hook marker should appear. Enabling experimental LSP should not run the project server or its executable availability probe.
2. Enable folder trust in user settings and explicitly trust that directory. Repeat the same scenarios: all three markers should appear. A project cannot bypass the gate by declaring an extension source or disabling its own server trust requirement.
3. Project skill grants should apply only with explicit trust and stop applying after revocation. Personal skill grants remain available. The hooks browser and matching checks should agree with the actual execution gate when legacy trust is true but explicit trust is false.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The baseline E2E used the installed CLI, version 0.25.1, with a localhost mock provider, fresh homes and default approval mode. All three markers appeared with no trust file. This baseline is version-scoped; it is not claimed as an execution of the PR's base commit.

The local built CLI, version 0.26.6, passed six E2E runs: default trust produced none of the three markers; explicitly enabled and granted trust restored all three. JSON transcripts confirmed that skill/agent invocation and ordinary glob calls still succeeded. A separate probe of the built production permission modules observed project grant decisions of ask → allow → ask across grant/revocation, while a user skill remained allowed.

Validation: full build, bundle and typecheck; changed-file ESLint and formatting; 2,530 core tests across 13 targeted files and 109 CLI tests across four targeted files. A separate E2E report follows in a PR comment.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.22.3, pinned pnpm dependencies, isolated fixture homes and a loopback OpenAI-compatible mock. Typecheck required the same 6 GB Node heap limit used by the repository build.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: projects relying on these executable configurations must explicitly enable and grant folder trust, or use affirmative IDE trust. YOLO does not waive this requirement. Skill and agent instructions remain usable without those side effects.
- Not validated / out of scope: real IDE companion E2E, live IDE hook revocation, Windows/Linux local execution, and full language-server protocol initialization. Extension LSP policy is covered by unit controls, not the marker E2E. Settings-file hook approval remains in #14748; per-skill and LSP-specific approval dialogs are not added.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: enable `security.folderTrust.enabled` in user settings and trust the directory using the existing startup dialog or `/trust`; restart after CLI trust changes. Existing directory-trust storage is reused. Manual trust-file edits retain the existing restart boundary.
- Core API migration: direct permission-manager consumers that grant repository-scoped rules must supply `isExplicitlyTrustedFolder()`; the old `isTrustedFolder()` probe no longer authorizes those grants. An absent probe withholds repository grants while preserving direct user grants.
- Project external-agent executors retain their existing trust gate and are not covered by this PR. Their separate execution path needs its own reproduction and fix; this PR does not claim that every repository-supplied executable is now gated.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/project-execution-explicit-trust/docs/design/2026-11-03-project-execution-trust.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/project-execution-explicit-trust/docs/design/2026-11-03-project-execution-trust.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #14746. Follow-up to #14748; neither is closed by this PR alone.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

仓库提供的 skill/subagent hooks、skill 权限授予和项目语言服务器现在要求显式目录信任。关闭目录信任功能不再授权这些执行路径。用户可开启目录信任并批准目录，或由 IDE 明确授予工作区信任。项目 hooks 与权限在使用时重新检查信任；语言服务器在探测可执行文件或启动之前检查，覆盖重载和重启。

改动复用现有目录信任流程，不增加审批存储或对话框。无关功能继续使用原有信任语义；用户、内置和扩展配置保留现有策略。

## 为什么需要

默认配置下，关闭目录信任会让所有目录被视为受信任，因此仓库可在没有目录信任决策时执行 frontmatter hook 命令或启动语言服务器。#14748 处理 settings 文件中的 hooks；本 PR 处理 #14746 指出的剩余执行入口，独立于其审批对话框实现，也不替代它。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用全新用户目录，并在仓库中配置分别写入无害标记的 skill hook、subagent hook 和项目语言服务器命令。保持默认目录信任，并允许普通 skill/agent 调用。调用后指令正文和普通已允许工具仍可用，但不应产生 hook 标记；开启实验性 LSP 也不应执行项目服务器或可执行文件探测。
2. 在用户设置中开启目录信任并明确授信，再重复相同场景，三个标记均应出现。项目不能通过声明扩展来源或关闭自己的服务器信任要求绕过检查。
3. 项目 skill 权限只在明确信任时生效，撤销后停止生效；个人 skill 权限继续可用。旧信任为真、显式信任为假时，hooks 浏览器与匹配检查应与实际执行门禁一致。

### 证据（前后对比）

基线 E2E 使用已安装的 CLI 0.25.1、本地 mock、全新 home 和默认审批模式；在没有信任文件时观察到三个标记。该基线明确限定版本，不宣称执行了本 PR 的基线提交。

本地构建的 CLI 0.26.6 通过六次 E2E：默认信任时三个标记均不出现；开启并明确授信后三个均恢复。JSON 会话确认 skill/agent 调用及普通 glob 成功。另以构建后的生产权限模块验证了项目权限随授信/撤销呈 ask → allow → ask，个人 skill 始终可获准。

验证包括完整构建、打包、类型检查，改动文件的 ESLint 与格式检查，以及 13 个 core 文件的 2,530 项测试和四个 CLI 文件的 109 项测试。独立 E2E 报告附在 PR 评论中。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows、Linux ⚠️ 未在本地测试。

### 环境

Node.js 22.22.3、锁定的 pnpm 依赖、隔离的测试 home 和回环地址上的 OpenAI 兼容 mock。类型检查需要与仓库构建相同的 6 GB Node 堆限制。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：依赖这些可执行配置的项目必须开启并授予目录信任，或使用 IDE 明确授信；YOLO 不豁免。没有这些副作用时，skill 与 agent 的正文仍可用。
- 未验证或范围外：真实 IDE companion E2E、IDE 实时撤销后的 hook 执行、Windows/Linux 本地运行及完整语言服务器协议初始化。扩展 LSP 策略有单测对照，未由标记 E2E 覆盖。settings hooks 审批仍由 #14748 处理；不新增逐 skill 或 LSP 专用审批对话框。
- 迁移：在用户设置开启 `security.folderTrust.enabled`，通过现有启动对话框或 `/trust` 信任目录；CLI 信任变更后重启。复用现有目录信任存储；手动修改信任文件仍沿用现有重启生效边界。
- Core API 迁移：直接构造权限管理器并授予仓库级规则的调用方，必须提供 `isExplicitlyTrustedFolder()`；原有 `isTrustedFolder()` 不再授权这些权限。缺少探针会扣留仓库授予的权限，用户直接授予的权限仍然可用。
- 项目外部 agent executor 仍沿用原有信任门禁，不在本 PR 的修复范围内。该独立执行路径需要另行复现和修复；本 PR 不宣称已覆盖所有仓库提供的可执行配置。

设计文档的中英文链接见上方，两者保持完整同步。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14746；补充 #14748。本 PR 不单独关闭它们。

</details>
