prs.title: feat(acp): run Goal turns on the shared loop
prs.body:
## What this PR does

With `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` on, ACP's Goal turns now run on the shared round, the shared tool batch and the client's stop point. This is PR 2c-3 of #15327.

A Goal turn is one of two kinds:

- A **runtime continuation**, which the Goal runtime schedules, is a `Goal` round under the turn's permit. ACP records the continuation's message and adds its system and todo reminders, as today, and the round runs no UserPromptSubmit.
- A **user prompt while a Goal runs** is a `UserQuery` under the permit ACP claimed for it. Otherwise it is like any fresh prompt.

ACP keeps the scheduling around the turn as today: the queue the runtime fills, the claim of a user prompt's turn, the start and end notifications, and the settlement of the turn.

Every round of the turn carries the permit, the turn key and the origin, its tool-result requests and continuations included. The round's own signal is the Goal signal. So the client leaves a cancelled round, or one cut short for queued input, to ACP, which still tells a new prompt's handoff from a cancel. The client handles the rest:

- Once the Stop hook and the Todo Stop Guard let the turn stop, the client finishes the Goal turn.
- A round that fails, loops or reaches the Stop hook's cap pauses the Goal, with the reason ACP gives it.

A turn that a tool ends, or that ACP's loop protection stops, still settles in ACP. ACP records the end of the turn with the tool that ended it.

A round that takes queued input as its response finishes does not let the client finish the Goal turn: the turn stays with ACP, which answers the input under the same permit. A round that runs after the Stop hook's cap released the permit answers it outside the Goal.

The model counts as started once the round's request reached history, read from the chat's push count. A runtime continuation is marked delivered at that point, and at the latest when the client reaches its stop policies, before it can finish the turn.

When the client finishes a user prompt's Goal turn, it skips its memory tasks, so ACP runs them when the prompt ends, as for any fresh prompt.

Core changes:

- `SendMessageOptions.userTurnRecordedByHost` also covers a `Goal` round, whose message the host recorded.
- A stop policy's continuation keeps the Goal fields of its send, so a Todo Stop Guard continuation runs under the same permit. Without them, the client would refuse it, because an active Goal requires an exact permit.

With the setting on, one behavior differs from today, as the design's Compatibility section lists: loop protection that stops a Goal turn pauses the Goal, with the loop as the reason. This applies to the client's loop protection and to ACP's own. The Goal no longer finishes the turn and lets the runtime schedule the next continuation. This matches headless and the TUI.

## Why it's needed

Goal turns were the last prompt turns that still ran ACP's legacy send path, stop loop and tool step, so every loop fix had to be made there again.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run `npm run bundle`, then `cd integration-tests && npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`.
  - The new scenario "a Goal its second continuation completes" runs `/goal` with chat recording on. The first continuation stops on its own. The second calls `update_goal` with `complete`, which ends its turn, and the verifier accepts. With the setting off and on, the scenario must send the model the same requests, and produce the same `session/update` notifications, stop reasons and Goal turn ends. The other scenarios must be unchanged.
- Unit tests:
  - `packages/core` `client-goal.test.ts`:
    - a Goal round whose message the host recorded;
    - a stop policy's continuation of a Goal turn under the same permit, finished once.
  - `packages/cli` `Session.test.ts`, "on the shared agent loop round" under the Goal tests:
    - a runtime continuation sent as a `Goal` round with its permit, turn key, origin and round signal, recorded once by ACP, with no UserPromptSubmit, and marked delivered;
    - a user prompt in a Goal turn sent as a `UserQuery` under its claimed permit;
    - the pause reasons ACP gives the client for the Stop hook cap, a failure and a blocked Managed session;
    - a Goal paused when loop protection ends its turn;
    - a runtime continuation whose request never went out, handed back to the runtime and not marked delivered;
    - a Goal turn that took input as its response finished, kept to answer it under the same permit;
    - input taken as the Stop hook capped the turn, answered outside the Goal;
    - the memory tasks of a user prompt's Goal turn, run once by ACP;
    - a runtime continuation marked delivered at the client's stop when no model event follows its request.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: the change is behind an off-by-default setting, and the parity suite compares both loops.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local results on Linux:

- ACP parity suite 23/23 and headless parity suite 12/12, from a fresh `npm run bundle`
- root `npm run typecheck` (all workspaces and `typecheck:integration`) passes
- core `client.test.ts`, `client-goal.test.ts`, `agent-loop.test.ts` and `src/goals/`: 1,192 passed
- cli `src/acp-integration/` and `nonInteractiveCli.test.ts`: 3,448 passed; the one failure is `acp-output.test.ts`, a Node stream test this PR does not touch, which fails the same way without this PR
- each new unit case fails when the change it covers is reverted
- eslint and prettier clean on the changed files

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: settlement of a Goal turn is now split. The client settles a turn that stops, fails, loops or reaches the Stop hook's cap. ACP settles a turn that is cancelled, cut short, handed off, ended by a tool or stopped by its own loop protection. With the setting off, nothing changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: cron and background-notification turns (PR 2c-4). Follow-ups: ACP keeps a Goal turn by aborting the round's signal, so the client takes its cancelled exit for that round; a stop-policy result that hands the turn back to the host would replace this. A Goal turn that reaches `maxSessionTurns` pauses with a generic "the turn was interrupted" reason, the same as in the TUI.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design: [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) and [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md). Both have the new PR 2c-3 section, the widened `userTurnRecordedByHost` row, the new ACP scenario and the intended difference.

## Linked Issues

Part of #15327.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

开启 `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` 后，ACP 的 Goal 轮次改为使用共享模型轮、共享工具批和 client 的 stop 点。这是 #15327 的 PR 2c-3。

Goal 轮次分两种：

- **runtime 续写**由 Goal runtime 安排，是这一轮 permit 下的 `Goal` 模型轮。和现在一样由 ACP 记录续写消息，并加上它的系统提醒和 todo 提醒；这一轮不运行 UserPromptSubmit。
- **Goal 进行中的用户 prompt**是 ACP 为它认领的 permit 下的 `UserQuery`，其余与任何全新 prompt 相同。

轮次外围的调度和现在一样留在 ACP：runtime 填充的队列、用户 prompt 所在轮次的认领、开始和结束通知，以及轮次的结算。

这一轮的每个模型轮，包括工具结果请求和续发请求，都带上 permit、轮次 key 和来源。模型轮自己的 signal 就是 Goal signal，因此被取消的模型轮，或因排队输入被打断的模型轮，client 都交给 ACP 处理，ACP 仍然区分新 prompt 的接手和取消。其余的由 client 处理：

- Stop hook 和 Todo Stop Guard 允许这一轮停下后，client 结束这个 Goal 轮次。
- 模型轮失败、出现循环或达到 Stop hook 上限时，client 按 ACP 给出的原因暂停 Goal。

被工具结束的轮次，或被 ACP 的循环保护停下的轮次，仍由 ACP 结算，ACP 用结束这一轮的那个工具记录轮次结束。

模型轮在响应结束时接收了排队输入的，client 不会结束这个 Goal 轮次：轮次留在 ACP，由 ACP 在同一个 permit 下回答这条输入。Stop hook 上限已经释放 permit 之后运行的模型轮，在 Goal 之外回答输入。

模型轮的请求进入历史后才算模型已经开始，这由 chat 的推送计数判断；runtime 续写也在这时标记为已送达，最晚在 client 运行 stop policy 时标记，早于 client 可能结束这一轮的时刻。

client 结束用户 prompt 的 Goal 轮次时会跳过记忆任务，因此由 ACP 在 prompt 结束时运行，和任何全新 prompt 一样。

core 的改动：

- `SendMessageOptions.userTurnRecordedByHost` 也覆盖 `Goal` 模型轮，表示宿主已经记录了它的消息。
- stop policy 的续发请求保留原请求的 Goal 字段，因此 Todo Stop Guard 的续发在同一个 permit 下运行。没有这些字段，client 会拒绝这次续发，因为进行中的 Goal 要求精确的 permit。

开启设置后，有一处行为和现在不同，列在设计文档的兼容性一节：循环保护停下 Goal 轮次时会暂停 Goal，并以循环作为原因。client 的循环保护和 ACP 自己的都是如此。Goal 不再像现在这样结束这一轮、让 runtime 安排下一次续写。这和 headless、TUI 一致。

## 为什么需要

Goal 轮次是最后几类仍走 ACP 旧发送路径、Stop 循环和工具步骤的 prompt 轮次，每个 loop 修复都要在那里再做一遍。

## 验证方法

- 运行 `npm run bundle`，然后 `cd integration-tests && npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`。
  - 新场景 "a Goal its second continuation completes" 在开启 chat recording 的情况下运行 `/goal`。第一次续写自行停下；第二次调用 `update_goal` 提出 `complete`，这会结束这一轮，verifier 随后接受。设置关闭和开启时，这个场景必须向模型发送相同的请求，产生相同的 `session/update` 通知、stop reason 和 Goal 轮次结束。其余场景必须不变。
- 单元测试：
  - `packages/core` 的 `client-goal.test.ts`：
    - 宿主已记录消息的 `Goal` 模型轮；
    - Goal 轮次中 stop policy 的续发在同一个 permit 下运行，且只结束一次。
  - `packages/cli` 的 `Session.test.ts`，Goal 测试下的 "on the shared agent loop round"：
    - runtime 续写作为 `Goal` 模型轮发出，带 permit、轮次 key、来源和模型轮 signal；由 ACP 记录一次，不运行 UserPromptSubmit，并标记为已送达；
    - Goal 轮次中的用户 prompt 作为 `UserQuery`，在认领到的 permit 下发出；
    - ACP 交给 client 的暂停原因：Stop hook 上限、失败、被阻止的 Managed 会话；
    - 循环保护结束这一轮时暂停 Goal；
    - 请求一直没有发出的 runtime 续写交还给 runtime，且不标记为已送达；
    - 在响应结束时接收了输入的 Goal 轮次留下来，在同一个 permit 下回答；
    - Stop hook 达到上限时接收的输入在 Goal 之外回答；
    - 用户 prompt 的 Goal 轮次的记忆任务由 ACP 运行一次；
    - 请求发出后没有模型事件时，runtime 续写在 client 的 stop 点标记为已送达。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Goal 轮次的结算现在分在两处。client 结算停下、失败、出现循环或达到 Stop hook 上限的轮次；ACP 结算被取消、被打断、被新 prompt 接手、被工具结束或被它自己的循环保护停下的轮次。设置关闭时没有任何变化。
- 未验证/不在范围内：cron 和后台通知轮次（PR 2c-4）。后续：ACP 通过中止模型轮的 signal 来留下 Goal 轮次，因此 client 对这一轮走取消退出；改为由 stop policy 返回“交还宿主”的结果可以取代这种做法。Goal 轮次达到 `maxSessionTurns` 时以通用的 “the turn was interrupted” 原因暂停，和 TUI 相同。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): reserve Hosted gate ports below the ephemeral range
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Hosted integration tests now take every port they hand to a process before that process is up from one shared allocator, `HostedGateTestSupport.reservePort()`. It hands out numbers from 20000–27999, below the ephemeral ranges Linux (32768–60999 by default) and macOS (49152–65535) use, from one counter per test JVM, and probes each number so one that some process already listens on is skipped.

26 Hosted classes move onto it. They reserved a port by binding port 0, closing the socket and passing the number to Spring, the Harness, a Spring fixture child or the Runtime Broker, which bound it seconds later. The two classes that kept their probe sockets open across part of the boot (`HostedSessionRelayFaultGatesIT`, `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT`) keep doing so, on reserved numbers. `HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT` already used this scheme privately (#14522); its copy is removed so the fork has one counter.

On Linux the allocator reads `/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range` once. (An integer sysctl only answers a read at offset 0, and `Files.readString` starts a size-0 file with a one-byte read, so it would see `3`; the file is read with a full-size buffer.) On a host whose ephemeral range starts below 28000 the window would no longer help, so there it falls back to kernel-chosen numbers, never handing out the same one twice in a fork, and says so once on stderr.

`HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT`'s boot retry recognised a lost Harness port only by the move message `port N is in use, trying`. Since #15244 `--profile hosted-harness` exits with `port N is in use; --profile hosted-harness does not move to another port` instead, and Node's lowercase `address already in use` misses the class's case-sensitive check, so that retry could no longer fire for the Harness. It now matches the exit message, and the boot's teardown still deletes the attempt's rows when settling the tenant's work fails, so the retry does not trip over its own rows.

The retries from #15432 (`bootWithFreshPorts`) and #14153/#15224 stay for a listener outside the fork. No production code changes.

## Why it's needed

A port probed with port 0 is in the ephemeral range. Once the probe socket closes, the kernel can give the same number to anyone else binding port 0, or to the local end of an outgoing connection, before the intended process binds it. That process then fails with `Address already in use`; the Harness exits rather than moving, because Spring already names its exact port.

The 240 CI runs whose `hosted-harness-mysql-reports` artifact was still retained (10-26 to 11-02, `main` and pull requests) include 9 runs that each lost one cell this way, in four classes, none of them covered by #15432:

| run | branch | cell | what could not bind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [40319736811](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40319736811) | PR | `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT.fg11c2SpringKillBeforeWatermarkNeverFiresTwice` | Harness, port 46697 |
| [40628289562](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40628289562) | PR | `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT.fg11c2SpringFixtureBootsAndScansOnMySql` | Harness, port 39845 |
| [40827534316](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40827534316) | PR | `HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT.fg11eRunListCursorHoldsAcrossAnInsertOnMySql` | Runtime Broker listener |
| [40835806118](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40835806118) | PR | `HostedHookCancelFaultGatesIT.fg13dCancelWithStoppedWorkerStaysUnknownAndKeepsTheHoldOnMySql` | Spring (Tomcat) |
| [40839441566](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40839441566) | PR | `HostedChannelProcessCrashIT.fg7cProcessCrashesNeverReplayChannelEffectsOnMySql` | Harness, port 38035 |
| [40844574764](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40844574764) | PR | `HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT.fg11bStoreFaultsNeverFireTwiceOnMySql` | Spring (Tomcat) |
| [40899091327](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40899091327) | PR | `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT.fg11c2SpringFixtureBootsAndScansOnMySql` | Harness, port 43151 |
| [41235909018](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41235909018) | `main` nightly | `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT.fg11c2SpringFixtureBootsAndScansOnMySql` | Harness, port 41973 |
| [41315953818](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41315953818) | PR | `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT.fg11c2TwoScannerRaceFiresOnce` | fixture Tomcat, ports 41401/39259 |

That is one Hosted run in 27 going red for a reason unrelated to the change under test. The `main` row is the 10-31 nightly; its other two failures were fixed by #16074. Below the ephemeral range the kernel never picks a number on its own, so only a bind by that exact number can take one, and within the fork only `reservePort` hands numbers out.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `HostedGateTestSupportTest` (default surefire lane) covers the allocator: distinct numbers inside the window, skipping a number someone listens on, wrapping from 27999 to 20000, the fallback skipping a repeated kernel number, parsing the range file (cross-checked against the real procfs file), and the window decision on both sides of 28000. 13 mutants of the allocator each turn the case aimed at them red.
- On a Linux box with Docker, MySQL 8.4.6 and a delegated cgroup v2 root, run the Hosted lane as the CI step does. To see the race itself, run `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT` while another process keeps binding port 0 on loopback.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Rig: aarch64 Linux, JDK 21, Node 22, MySQL 8.4.6, `ip_local_port_range` 32768–60999, the CI step's `mvn -Phosted-harness-mysql ... clean verify checkstyle:check`. "Port stealer" is a process that keeps about 4000 loopback sockets bound to port 0, replacing them every 2 seconds, which is what any process in the job binding port 0 does at a higher rate.

| arm | tree | condition | result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B0 | `main` | no stealer, `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT` | 5/5 pass |
| B1 | `main` | stealer, same class | 3 of 5 error: Harness `port 44733 is in use; --profile hosted-harness does not move to another port`, fixture Tomcat `Address already in use` ×2 |
| B2 | `main` | stealer, same class | 5 of 5 error, all bind conflicts (`BindException`, `Port 43401 was already in use`, …) |
| P1, P2, P3 | this branch (P3 is the final commit) | stealer, same class | 5/5 pass each, no bind conflict |
| TLB | `main` | Harness port held during boot attempt 0, `HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT#leadRunsATeamThroughTwoNamedMembers` | error: `Hosted Harness exited: … port 46527 is in use; …`, no retry |
| TLP | this branch | same | pass: `boot attempt 0 lost its ports, retrying: … HarnessPortConflict: Hosted Harness lost the port race on 20560`, attempt 1 on 20563 |
| full | this branch | no stealer, whole Hosted lane | 167 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 4 skipped, `BUILD SUCCESS`; 35 report classes as in CI; no fallback note; 222 of the Tomcat ports bound were in the window, and the other 62 came from listeners that bind port 0 themselves |

The TLB/TLP hold was a test-only probe applied on the rig, not part of this PR.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux: unit tests, the mutants and checkstyle on x86_64 (JDK 25); the Hosted lane and the A/B arms on aarch64 (JDK 21). macOS was not run; its default ephemeral range starts at 49152, above the window. The Hosted ITs refuse to run on Windows.

### Environment (optional)

`-Phosted-harness-mysql clean verify checkstyle:check` with the CI step's arguments, a fresh `hosted_harness_test` database and a delegated cgroup root.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the guarantee needs the window below the host's ephemeral range. GitHub's Ubuntu runners and every test machine checked use 32768–60999; a Linux host tuned lower falls back to today's behavior with a one-time note. A process outside the fork that binds a window number by name can still collide; the probe skips one that is already listening, and the existing retries remain for that case.
- Not validated / out of scope: `EventTransportMultiNodeGate` (its own job; #14860 covered its RocketMQ ports), `Issue13180*`, `preflight/*` and `SshRuntimeInteropTest` (surefire tests, none seen failing this way), the TypeScript drivers (they listen on port 0 and keep the socket open), and production `SshConnectionManager`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test code only.

## Linked Issues

Related to #15432, #14522, #14153 and #15224, the earlier per-class fixes for the same race. The `main` failure was filed on #15744 along with two fg10 cells, which #16074 fixed; the fg11c2 cell in that report is this race.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Hosted 集成测试在子进程起来之前要把端口号交给它。现在这些端口统一从一个共享分配器 `HostedGateTestSupport.reservePort()` 取。它只发 20000–27999 的号，低于 Linux（默认 32768–60999）和 macOS（49152–65535）的临时端口范围；每个测试 JVM 共用一个计数器，并且逐个探测，已经有进程监听的号会跳过。

26 个 Hosted 类改用它。这些类原来的做法是先 bind 0、关掉 socket，再把号码交给 Spring、Harness、Spring fixture 子进程或 Runtime Broker，几秒后由对方去 bind。`HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT` 早就私下用了同样的做法（#14522）；它的私有副本已删除，整个 fork 只保留一个计数器。

在 Linux 上，分配器会读一次 `/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range`。整数型 sysctl 只响应偏移 0 处的读，而 `Files.readString` 对大小为 0 的文件会先读 1 个字节，读到的只有 `3`，所以这里改用足够大的缓冲区一次读完。如果宿主的临时端口范围从 28000 以下开始，这个窗口就不再起作用，这时退回由内核选端口，同一个 fork 内不会重复发号，并在 stderr 上提示一次。

`HostedSessionRelayFaultGatesIT` 和 `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` 原来会在启动的一部分过程中一直持有探测 socket，现在照样持有，只是绑定的是预留的号码。

`HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT` 的启动重试原来只靠换端口提示 `port N is in use, trying` 来识别 Harness 端口被占。自 #15244 起，`--profile hosted-harness` 改为打印 `port N is in use; --profile hosted-harness does not move to another port` 后直接退出；Node 报的又是小写的 `address already in use`，匹配不上这个类区分大小写的检查。所以对 Harness 来说，这个重试已经不可能触发。现在改为匹配退出提示。另外，即使结算租户工作失败，启动清理也会照常删除本次尝试插入的行，重试不会撞上自己留下的数据。

#15432 的 `bootWithFreshPorts` 和 #14153/#15224 的重试都保留，用来应对 fork 外的监听者。生产代码没有改动。

## 为什么需要

用 port 0 探测到的端口在临时端口范围内。探测 socket 一关，内核就可能在目标进程 bind 之前，把同一个号交给别的 bind 0 的进程，或者分给某条出站连接作本端端口。目标进程随后就会报 `Address already in use`。Harness 不会换端口，因为 Spring 已经记下了它的确切端口，所以它直接退出。

`hosted-harness-mysql-reports` 产物还保留着的 CI 运行共有 240 次（10-26 至 11-02，包括 `main` 和各个 PR）。其中 9 次运行各有一个用例因此失败，分布在 4 个类，都不在 #15432 的覆盖范围内（明细见英文部分的表格）。也就是说，大约每 27 次 Hosted 运行就有 1 次因为与改动无关的原因变红。表中 `main` 那一行是 10-31 的夜跑，它的另外两个失败已由 #16074 修复。在临时端口范围以下，内核从不自行选号，只有按这个确切号码 bind 才会占用它；而在 fork 内部，只有 `reservePort` 会发号。

## 评审验证方式

### 如何验证

- `HostedGateTestSupportTest`（默认 surefire lane）覆盖分配器：
  - 发出的号互不相同且都在窗口内；
  - 跳过有人监听的号；
  - 从 27999 回绕到 20000；
  - 回退路径跳过内核重复给出的号；
  - 解析范围文件，并与真实的 procfs 文件交叉校验；
  - 28000 两侧的窗口判断。
- 针对分配器的 13 个变异，每个都会让它针对的用例变红。
- 在装有 Docker、MySQL 8.4.6 和委派 cgroup v2 根的 Linux 机器上，按 CI 步骤的方式跑 Hosted lane。想直接看到这个竞争，可以在另一个进程不断往 loopback bind 0 的同时运行 `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT`。

### 证据（前后对比）

rig：aarch64 Linux，JDK 21，Node 22，MySQL 8.4.6，`ip_local_port_range` 为 32768–60999，按 CI 步骤运行 `mvn -Phosted-harness-mysql ... clean verify checkstyle:check`。“端口窃取进程”会始终在 loopback 上保持约 4000 个 bind 0 的 socket，每 2 秒轮换一次，相当于以更高频率模拟 job 里任何 bind 0 的进程。

| 组 | 代码 | 条件 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B0 | `main` | 不开窃取，`HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT` | 5/5 通过 |
| B1 | `main` | 开窃取，同一个类 | 5 个用例中 3 个报错：Harness 报 `port 44733 is in use; …`，fixture 的 Tomcat 两次报 `Address already in use` |
| B2 | `main` | 开窃取，同一个类 | 5 个全部报错，都是端口冲突 |
| P1、P2、P3 | 本分支（P3 为最终提交） | 开窃取，同一个类 | 每组 5/5 通过，没有端口冲突 |
| TLB | `main` | 第 0 次启动期间占住 Harness 端口，`HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT#leadRunsATeamThroughTwoNamedMembers` | 报错：Harness 因 `port 46527 is in use` 退出，没有重试 |
| TLP | 本分支 | 同上 | 通过：第 0 次在 20560 上识别为 `HarnessPortConflict`，第 1 次换到 20563 |
| 全量 | 本分支 | 不开窃取，整条 Hosted lane | 167 项，0 失败，0 错误，4 跳过，`BUILD SUCCESS`；报告覆盖 35 个类，与 CI 一致；没有回退提示；Tomcat 绑定的端口中 222 个落在窗口内，其余 62 个来自自己 bind 0 的监听 |

TLB/TLP 中占住端口的做法只是在 rig 上临时打的测试探针，不属于本 PR。

### 测试平台

Linux：单测、变异和 checkstyle 在 x86_64（JDK 25）上通过；Hosted lane 和 A/B 对比在 aarch64（JDK 21）上跑。macOS 没有跑，它的默认临时端口范围从 49152 开始，高于窗口。Hosted IT 本身拒绝在 Windows 上运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：这个保证要求窗口位于宿主临时端口范围以下。GitHub 的 Ubuntu runner 和查过的每台测试机都是 32768–60999；如果某台 Linux 机器把范围调低了，会退回今天的行为，并提示一次。fork 外的进程按号 bind 到窗口内的号码，仍可能撞上；对已经在监听的号，探测会跳过，其余情况由原有的重试兜底。
- 未验证或不在范围内：
  - `EventTransportMultiNodeGate`：它有自己的 job，#14860 已经处理了它的 RocketMQ 端口；
  - `Issue13180*`、`preflight/*`、`SshRuntimeInteropTest`：都是 surefire 测试，没见过因此失败；
  - TypeScript 驱动：它们 listen 0 后一直保持监听，没有这个问题；
  - 生产代码 `SshConnectionManager`。
- 破坏性变更：无，只改测试代码。

## 关联 Issue

与 #15432、#14522、#14153、#15224 相关，它们都是针对同一竞争的按类修复。`main` 上那次失败记录在 #15744，同一份报告里还有两个 fg10 用例，已由 #16074 修复；其中的 fg11c2 用例就是这个竞争。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): add semantic statusline colors and live footer preview
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Give built-in status-line items four consistent active-theme colors: project/Git, model/reasoning, context/tokens, and session metadata. Separators stay neutral, and disabling theme colors removes semantic coloring.

Keep the actual input and footer visible while `/statusline` is open, and preview every selection immediately through the saved status line's rendering path. Remove the separate in-dialog preview. The picker owns input while open, including mouse focus and paste; Enter saves once, and Esc discards the draft and restores the previous preset, command, or disabled configuration.

## Why it's needed

Using one accent color for every item makes unrelated information difficult to scan. The old in-dialog preview also hides the real input/footer and does not reflect the saved status line's available width or wrapping. In-place preview makes the result visible before saving without persisting intermediate changes, consistently in Ink and OpenTUI.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In both Ink and OpenTUI, open `/statusline` with a saved preset. Confirm the picker is above the still-visible input and footer, there is no internal Preview section, and toggling items or Use theme colors updates the real footer immediately. Check all four categories; same-category items should match and separators should remain neutral.
2. Press Enter after a change. Expect one save confirmation and the same footer content, wrapping, and colors as the preview. Reopen, change options, and cancel with Esc; expect the original configuration without a settings write. If search is active, the first Esc clears it and the next cancels. Repeat cancellation from custom-command and disabled status-line configurations, preserving custom ANSI colors and an explicit hide-context setting.
3. Resize to 80×24 and 40×20, select enough items to wrap, and navigate to the final item. Expect a usable compact picker, visible input/footer, and the existing two-row status-line limit without overlap. Switching between Qwen Dark and Qwen Light should repaint the category colors without restarting; NoColor should leave the preset footer uncolored.
4. While configuring, click the visible inactive input, type, and bracketed-paste text. The picker alone should receive typing, the input must remain unchanged, and no prompt should submit. After cancellation, ordinary typing and paste should work again.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Interactive tmux testing reproduced the issue with the global 0.26.5 CLI and verified the local bundle in both renderers. Nonessential picker rows are omitted in these layout excerpts.

Before: the picker contains its own preview, and the real input/footer disappears.

```text
Configure Status Line
...
Preview
➜ workspace · statusline-model · v0.26.5
```

After: there is no internal preview; the real input and footer remain beneath the picker. This excerpt is from the final OpenTUI mouse/paste verification, where the input remained empty.

```text
Configure Status Line
...
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
>   Type your message or @path/to/file
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ➜ workspace · statusline-model · Context 100% left · 0 total in · v0.26.5 · 1.0k window
  ⏸ Ask permissions (shift + tab to cycle)
```

ANSI captures confirmed that the previous uniform Qwen Dark accent `(203,166,247)` becomes project `(166,227,161)`, model `(203,166,247)`, context `(137,180,250)`, and session `(249,226,175)`. Theme switching, save/cancel, command/null restoration, narrow wrapping, and input ownership passed. An independent test engineer's E2E report is posted separately on this PR.

Local regression checks passed: full build and typecheck, reviewed CLI build and bundle, 1,236 unique affected unit tests with one existing skip, all 11 native status-line scenarios, native input focus checks at widths 40/80 with eight normal submissions, and two interactive integration tests per renderer. Changed-file lint/formatting, diff checks, and bilingual design-link validation also passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS terminal/tmux; the global 0.26.5 CLI for baseline reproduction, and the locally built bundle under Node for Ink and Bun for strict OpenTUI. Tests used isolated workspace/home/runtime settings, no sandbox and no model requests; user-global settings were not modified.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: keeping the composer mounted requires strict picker input ownership and a bounded height budget. Keyboard, mouse, paste, resize, and save/cancel paths were verified in both renderers, with additional native OpenTUI regression coverage.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux were not tested locally. Preserve current main's real status-line placement below the input and its two-row limit; this is not a global footer redesign. Unrelated OpenTUI NoColor UI chrome is outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no new persisted settings, dependency changes, or migration. Custom-command output semantics are unchanged after cancellation.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and scope.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8363

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次变更

为内置状态栏项提供四组一致的当前主题色：项目/Git、模型/推理、上下文/token，以及会话元数据。分隔符保持中性色，关闭主题色后移除语义着色。

打开 `/statusline` 时保留真实输入框和页脚，每次选择都立即通过已保存状态栏的渲染路径预览。移除对话框内部的独立预览。配置期间由选择器独占输入，包括鼠标聚焦和粘贴；Enter 只保存一次，Esc 丢弃草稿并恢复之前的 preset、command 或禁用配置。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 Ink 和 OpenTUI 中，从已保存的 preset 打开 `/statusline`。确认选择器位于仍然可见的输入框和页脚上方，没有内部 Preview 区域，切换条目或 Use theme colors 会立即更新真实页脚。检查四类信息：同类颜色应一致，分隔符应保持中性色。
2. 修改后按 Enter，应仅出现一次保存提示，保存后的页脚内容、换行和颜色与预览一致。重新打开、修改选项并按 Esc 取消，应恢复原配置而不写入设置。有搜索内容时，第一次 Esc 清空搜索，第二次取消。再从自定义 command 和禁用状态栏配置重复取消测试，确认恢复自定义 ANSI 色并保留显式隐藏上下文指示器的设置。
3. 调整为 80×24 和 40×20，选中足够多的条目使其换行，并导航至最后一个条目。紧凑选择器应可用，输入框/页脚保持可见，状态栏遵循现有两行上限且不重叠。切换 Qwen Dark 与 Qwen Light 应无需重启就刷新分类颜色；NoColor 下 preset 页脚应无颜色。
4. 配置期间点击可见但不活跃的输入框，键入并进行 bracketed paste。只有选择器应接收键入，输入框内容不变且不提交 prompt。取消后普通键入和粘贴应恢复正常。

### 证据（修改前后）

交互式 tmux 测试使用全局 0.26.5 CLI 复现问题，并在两种渲染器中验证本地 bundle。以下布局摘录省略了无关选择器行。

修改前：选择器包含自己的预览，真实输入框/页脚消失。

```text
Configure Status Line
...
Preview
➜ workspace · statusline-model · v0.26.5
```

修改后：没有内部预览，真实输入框和页脚保留在选择器下方。该摘录来自最终 OpenTUI 鼠标/粘贴验证，输入框始终为空。

```text
Configure Status Line
...
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
>   Type your message or @path/to/file
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ➜ workspace · statusline-model · Context 100% left · 0 total in · v0.26.5 · 1.0k window
  ⏸ Ask permissions (shift + tab to cycle)
```

ANSI 捕获确认：原先统一的 Qwen Dark 强调色 `(203,166,247)` 变为项目 `(166,227,161)`、模型 `(203,166,247)`、上下文 `(137,180,250)`、会话 `(249,226,175)`。主题切换、保存/取消、command/null 恢复、窄屏换行和输入归属检查全部通过。独立测试工程师的 E2E 报告将作为单独评论附在本 PR。

本地回归检查通过：完整 build 和 typecheck、审查后的 CLI build 和 bundle、1,236 个去重后的受影响单元测试（另有一个已有 skip）、全部 11 个原生状态栏场景、40/80 列原生输入聚焦检查及八次正常提交，以及每种渲染器各两个交互集成测试。变更文件 lint/格式、diff 检查和双语设计链接验证也通过。

### 已测试平台

| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

macOS 终端/tmux；用全局 0.26.5 CLI 复现基线，用本地构建的 bundle 在 Node 下验证 Ink、在 Bun 下验证严格 OpenTUI。测试隔离 workspace/home/runtime 设置，不使用 sandbox、不发送模型请求，也未修改用户全局设置。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：保留 composer 挂载要求选择器严格独占输入，并为其限制高度。两种渲染器的键盘、鼠标、粘贴、缩放及保存/取消路径均已验证，另补充了原生 OpenTUI 回归覆盖。

prs.title: ci: scope triage finalize concurrency to PR runs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Scopes the `Qwen Triage Finalize` concurrency group to PR-caused runs. PR completions keep serializing per head SHA, while non-PR completions receive a unique group and can no longer occupy a PR's group before the existing job-level event gate skips them. The watched workflow list, PR event gate, and deferred-approval convergence behavior are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

`workflow_run.completed` fires this workflow for every completion of all six watched workflows, including non-PR `Qwen Autofix` and `Managed Agent gate` runs. Those runs skip at the job level, but `cancel-in-progress: false` can still queue them behind or ahead of a live finalize run for the same PR head SHA. Narrowing the group key removes that avoidable contention without dropping any workflow that can be the last PR finisher.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Inspect the parsed concurrency group: a `github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request'` completion resolves to `qwen-triage-finalize-<head-sha>`, while any other event resolves to `qwen-triage-finalize-<run-id>`. Confirm `cancel-in-progress` remains `false`, the six-workflow watch list is unchanged, and the job-level PR/repository gate is unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI workflow configuration change with no user-visible surface.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — static workflow and assertion review only; local tests were not requested.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: PR runs retain the existing per-SHA serialization, while non-PR runs no longer coordinate with one another. This is safe because the job immediately skips for every non-PR event and cannot write triage state.
- Not validated / out of scope: This reduces queue contention but does not reduce the structurally unavoidable number of skipped `workflow_run` runs, because `workflow_run` has no event filter.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15969 — this removes the cross-event group contention; the run-count
inflation the issue headlines is untouched (see Risk & Scope), so the issue
stays open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

将 `Qwen Triage Finalize` 的并发组收窄到由 PR 触发的运行。PR 完成事件仍按 head SHA 串行；非 PR 完成事件会获得唯一分组，因此不会在 job 级事件 gate 将其跳过之前占用某个 PR 的分组。监听的 workflow 列表、PR 事件 gate 和延迟审批的收敛行为均保持不变。

## 为什么需要

`workflow_run.completed` 会在六个被监听 workflow 的每次完成时触发本 workflow，包括非 PR 的 `Qwen Autofix` 和 `Managed Agent gate` 运行。这些运行最终会在 job 级跳过，但在 `cancel-in-progress: false` 下，它们仍可能排在同一 PR head SHA 的真实 finalize 运行前后，形成不必要的等待。收窄分组 key 可以消除这部分争用，同时不会移除任何可能作为 PR 最后一个完成者的 workflow。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

检查解析后的 concurrency group：`github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request'` 的完成事件应解析为 `qwen-triage-finalize-<head-sha>`，其他事件应解析为 `qwen-triage-finalize-<run-id>`。确认 `cancel-in-progress` 仍为 `false`，六个 workflow 的监听列表未变，job 级的 PR/仓库 gate 也未变。

### 证据（修改前后）

prs.title: ci: route the no-AK integration gate to ECS for every pull request
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Routes the no-AK integration gate to the self-hosted ECS pool for every pull request, untrusted forks included, by reading the same classifier output the lint lane reads. The gate's PR-code step already pinned a step-level runner.temp HOME with every model key emptied; that HOME now becomes run-unique and is cleared before use. The routing battery extends its lane-set pin to the recorded two lanes and gains a zero-secrets contract assertion: any real credential added to the PR-code step's env reds the suite. The test lane and the merge-queue-only CLI integration lane keep the association-gated routing unchanged.

## Why it's needed

After the earlier routing changes, an untrusted fork PR's remaining hosted waiters are Test (~40 min) and this gate (~30-60 min) — while the gate is, by construction, the same trust class as the lint lane whose shared-pool risk was accepted on 2026-10-31: its integration step executes PR code, but it holds no secrets (the entire point of the "no-AK" lane is that every model key is emptied at the step that runs that code; the job's only token is the read-only checkout grant). Its PR-code step already isolates HOME. Keeping it on hosted for forks buys no security boundary the lint decision has not already crossed, and it is the largest remaining source of fork PR queue time.

The HOME change closes the one gap found in the lane's existing isolation: RUNNER_TEMP survives across jobs on this pool, so the previously fixed directory name could hand a fork's writes to the next job on the same runner registration — the same cross-job persistence the lint lane's round-2 review caught (R2-1) and fixed with run-unique paths.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Re-run CI on a fork PR from an author without write access: Integration Tests (no-AK, No Sandbox) should land on an ECS runner alongside Lint & Static, while Test stays on ubuntu-latest.
- `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs` (103 tests): the lane-set pin now expects exactly `lint_and_static` and `integration_no_ak`, and the no-AK case asserts the run-unique HOME and the emptied key env.
- Mutation witnesses (verified locally, red/green): reverting the gate's runs-on to the association-gated output, restoring the fixed HOME path, or filling a real credential into the PR-code step each turn the battery red.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI routing only. Before: fork PRs queue this gate on ubuntu-latest (30-60 min) alongside Test. After: the gate follows lint onto the pool for every PR; the fork divergence is proven by the battery and witnessed live by the next fork PR.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: routing battery 103/103, no-AK suite + lanes + size + cleanup suites green, actionlint clean on the workflow, three mutation witnesses red/green. Windows: N/A. Linux: covered by this PR's CI on the pool.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — workflow meta-tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: fork-authored integration code executes on the shared pool — the accepted lint risk class, with strictly less to steal (zero credentials by construction, pinned by the new battery assertion). The kill switch reverts the lane with everything else.
- Not validated / out of scope: the test lane keeps the association gate (it is the remaining heavy PR-code hosted lane, deliberately); no isolation fleet.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the classifier outputs and every other consumer are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把 no-AK 集成门禁对所有 pull request（含不可信 fork）路由到自托管 ECS 池——读取与 lint 车道相同的 classifier 输出。该门禁的 PR 代码步骤本就钉着 step 级 `runner.temp` HOME 并清空所有模型 key；该 HOME 现在改为 run 唯一且先清后建。路由电池把车道集合钉扩展为记录在案的两条，并新增零密钥契约断言：向 PR 代码步骤的 env 填入任何真实凭证都会使套件变红。test 车道与仅 merge-queue 的 CLI 集成车道保持 association 门禁路由不变。

## 为什么需要

此前的路由变更之后，不可信 fork PR 剩余的 hosted 等待项是 Test（约 40 分钟）和本门禁（约 30-60 分钟）——而本门禁按构造与 2026-10-31 已接受共享池风险的 lint 车道同属一个信任类：它的集成步骤执行 PR 代码，但不持有任何密钥（"no-AK"车道存在的意义就是在跑该代码的步骤上清空所有模型 key；job 唯一的 token 是只读检出授权），且其 PR 代码步骤早已隔离 HOME。让它对 fork 留在 hosted 买不到 lint 决策尚未跨过的任何安全边界，却是 fork PR 排队时间的最大剩余来源。

HOME 变更补上该车道现有隔离中唯一的缺口：本池上 RUNNER_TEMP 跨 job 持久，原先固定的目录名可能把 fork 的写入交给同一 runner 注册上的下一个 job——正是 lint 车道第二轮评审抓到（R2-1）并用 run 唯一路径修复的同一类跨 job 持久化。

## 评审验证计划

如何验证：用无 write 权限作者的 fork PR 重跑 CI——Integration Tests (no-AK, No Sandbox) 应与 Lint & Static 一样落在 ECS runner，Test 仍在 ubuntu-latest。跑 `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`（103 个测试）：车道集合钉现在精确期待 `lint_and_static` 与 `integration_no_ak`，no-AK 用例断言 run 唯一 HOME 与清空的 key env。变异验证（本地已做红/绿）：把门禁 runs-on 改回 association 门控输出、恢复固定 HOME 路径、或向 PR 代码步骤填入真实凭证，各自使电池变红。

证据：N/A——纯 CI 路由。前：fork PR 在 ubuntu-latest 上排队本门禁（30-60 分钟）与 Test 并列。后：门禁随 lint 对所有 PR 上池；fork 分歧由电池证明，下一个 fork PR 是线上见证。

测试平台：macOS ✅（路由电池 103/103、no-AK 套件 + lanes + size + cleanup 套件绿、actionlint 对该 workflow 零告警、三个变异红绿）；Windows N/A；Linux ⚠️ 由本 PR 在池上的 CI 覆盖。

风险与范围：fork 编写的集成代码在共享池上执行——已接受的 lint 风险类，且可窃取的东西严格更少（按构造零凭证，由新电池断言钉住）。kill switch 随全局一起退回。范围外：test 车道保留 association 门禁（它是刻意保留的重 PR 代码 hosted 车道）；不做隔离 fleet。无破坏性变更；classifier 输出与其他消费者不变。

关联 Issue：无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): polish composer action menu presentation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The composer Add menu gets consistent icon tiles, regular-weight action labels, short English and Chinese descriptions, and compact spacing. Skills joins the other reference actions without a separator above it, while the remaining separators align with the icons. The existing menu background, border, radius, and shadow stay intact.

Plan uses a decorative switch-shaped state indicator with the same visual weight as other actions. The existing row remains the only interactive control, follows confirmed state, and stays disabled with an explanation during a mode change. Its indicator remains visible in forced-colors mode. Extensions and MCP submenu descriptions occupy one line, with an ellipsis for overflow and the full text available on hover. Corresponding mobile actions use the same icons and text hierarchy.

## Why it's needed

The current menu mixes label-only actions with icon-bearing actions, and long provider descriptions can dominate a submenu. This makes common composer actions harder to scan. The change follows the visual direction discussed in #16155 while keeping descriptions accurate: Extensions and MCP insert references rather than manage or connect services.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open the composer Add menu in dark and light themes. Confirm the regular-weight labels, aligned icons, compact rows, unchanged menu surface, no separator above Skills, and inset separators below the reference actions.
2. Open Extensions and MCP with long item descriptions. Each description should stay on one line with an ellipsis; hovering should reveal its full text. Selecting a reference should insert it into the composer.
3. Toggle Plan through either its row or the visible indicator. Each activation should request one change. While a request is pending, the row should explain why it is disabled and keep the previously confirmed state. After confirmation, the indicator should move to the new state. In forced-colors mode, both its outline and thumb should remain visible.
4. Check a narrow desktop viewport and the mobile drawer. Actions should stay within the viewport, file selection and reference insertion should still work, and keyboard dismissal should restore focus appropriately.

### Evidence (Before & After)

These are actual browser captures with simulated daemon responses. Before is the exact upstream main `e4cf95e774`; After is this PR head `6cd1936b2c`, including regular font weight. All eight images were visually inspected and are hosted on an independent assets branch in `ytahdn/qwen-code`, pinned to an immutable commit. They demonstrate frontend rendering and mocked request behavior, not real daemon or Git operations.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): handle image URL pastes and unavailable files
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Web Shell attaches an image when the clipboard contains exactly one image and its accompanying plain text is a single HTTP(S) URL. Editable office text still takes priority over its bitmap representation, and command drafts keep pasted URL arguments as text. A paste that advertises files without exposing any file objects or plain text now shows the existing unavailable-file warning.

## Why it's needed

The previous text-first behavior treated a copied image's source URL as the intended content and silently ignored the bitmap. A second path ignored clipboard file declarations when no file object was available, leaving the user with no attachment or explanation. Simply preferring every file would regress the existing PowerPoint text workflow, so this change uses a narrow URL heuristic and preserves text handling elsewhere.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Paste a clipboard containing one PNG and a single HTTP(S) URL into a normal conversation draft. Expect an image attachment and no inserted URL text. Image-only paste should also continue to attach an image.
2. Paste multiline PowerPoint-like text accompanied by a bitmap. Expect editable text, preserved line breaks, and no redundant image attachment. A URL-only clipboard or a mixed payload with a caption or multiple images should keep its text behavior.
3. Start a command draft such as `/fork ` and paste the same URL-plus-image payload. Expect the complete URL argument to remain editable, with no image attachment. Check collapsed and expanded touch editors as well as desktop.
4. Paste a payload advertising `Files` but exposing no file objects or plain text. Expect one unavailable-file warning. Ordinary text paste should not produce that warning.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: synthetic DOM reproductions at the original main showed URL text without an image for URL-plus-PNG, and neither an attachment nor a notice for an empty advertised file payload.

After: Chromium browser tests on the merged PR head verify image attachment, editable PPT text, complete command URL arguments, and the unavailable-file warning. The screenshots below use a mock daemon and synthetic clipboard events. They demonstrate rendered UI state, not actual operating-system clipboard formats or real backend attachment submission or command execution.

One image with its source URL becomes an attachment, with no URL inserted into the editor.

![Image attachment from URL-plus-image paste](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/image-url-paste.png)

An advertised file payload without a file object produces a visible warning.

![Unavailable clipboard file warning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/unavailable-file-paste.png)

A command draft retains the complete URL argument and has no image attachment.

![Command URL argument retained as text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/command-url-paste.png)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Vitest/jsdom, Chromium browser E2E, build and type checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.14.0, local source and bundled CLI, Chromium with a mock daemon. Post-merge verification: full build and bundle, repository typecheck, 340 focused Vitest tests, 3 Chromium E2E tests (including one temporary evidence flow), and changed-file lint/format checks passed. The browser screenshots are stored on a separate assets branch at a fixed commit and are not part of the implementation branch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the URL rule is a heuristic. Outside command drafts, an office selection consisting only of an HTTP(S) URL and one bitmap will also prefer the image. Captions, non-HTTP(S) text, multiple images, disabled attachments, and shell mode retain text priority.
- Not validated / out of scope: native Linux/WebKitGTK, actual PowerPoint or screenshot-tool clipboard formats, real backend attachment submission, and backend command execution. The unrelated upstream Java changes are inherited from main and are not part of this PR's effective diff or verification claims.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API, dependency, daemon route, or configuration changes; no migration required.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/e7a08929f3180e6790aeba6161bfb5edb5e61815/docs/design/web-shell-image-url-paste.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/e7a08929f3180e6790aeba6161bfb5edb5e61815/docs/design/web-shell-image-url-paste.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16088

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

当剪贴板恰好包含一张图片，且附带纯文本为单个 HTTP(S) URL 时，Web Shell 会添加图片附件。办公软件的可编辑文字继续优先于其位图表示，命令草稿中的 URL 参数继续按文字粘贴。对于声明了文件却既不提供文件对象也不提供纯文本的粘贴，现在会显示现有的不可用文件警告。

## 为什么需要

此前的文字优先行为会把所复制图片的源 URL 当作目标内容，静默忽略位图。另一条路径在无法取得文件对象时忽略剪贴板的文件声明，用户既得不到附件，也看不到说明。直接让所有文件优先会破坏已有的 PowerPoint 文字粘贴流程，因此本改动使用范围有限的 URL 启发式判断，并在其他情况下保留文字处理。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在普通对话草稿中粘贴同时包含一张 PNG 和单个 HTTP(S) URL 的剪贴板。应生成图片附件，不插入 URL 文字。纯图片粘贴也应继续生成附件。
2. 粘贴附带位图的多行 PPT 风格文字。应保留可编辑文字和换行，不生成冗余图片附件。仅含 URL 的剪贴板，或带说明文字、多张图片的混合载荷，应保留文字行为。
3. 输入 `/fork ` 等命令草稿，再粘贴同样的 URL 加图片载荷。应保留完整、可编辑的 URL 参数，不生成图片附件。除桌面端外，也检查触屏折叠和展开编辑器。
4. 粘贴声明 `Files` 却既不提供文件对象也不提供纯文本的载荷。应显示一次不可用文件警告。普通文字粘贴不应触发该警告。

### 修复前后证据

修复前：原始 main 上的合成 DOM 复现显示，URL 加 PNG 只留下 URL 文字而没有图片；空文件声明既不生成附件，也不显示提示。

修复后：合并最新 main 后的 PR 提交已通过 Chromium 浏览器测试，验证图片附件、可编辑 PPT 文字、完整命令 URL 参数和不可用文件警告。以下截图使用模拟 daemon 和合成剪贴板事件，只证明实际渲染的 UI 状态，不代表真实操作系统剪贴板格式、真实后端附件提交或命令执行验证。

- [URL 加一张图片生成图片附件，编辑器不插入 URL 文字](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/image-url-paste.png)。
- [声明了文件却取不到文件对象时，显示可见警告](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/unavailable-file-paste.png)。
- [命令草稿保留完整 URL 参数，不生成图片附件](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/command-url-paste.png)。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Vitest/jsdom、Chromium 浏览器 E2E、构建和类型检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

Node.js 22.14.0，本地源码和 bundle CLI，Chromium 配合模拟 daemon。合并后验证结果：全量构建和 bundle、仓库类型检查、340 项相关 Vitest 测试、3 项 Chromium E2E 测试（含一项临时证据采集流程）及改动文件的 lint/格式检查均通过。浏览器截图保存在独立素材分支的固定提交中，不进入实现分支。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：URL 规则属于启发式判断。在命令草稿之外，从办公软件复制的单个 HTTP(S) URL 如果附带一张位图，也会优先图片。带说明文字、非 HTTP(S) 文字、多张图片、附件禁用及 shell 模式继续优先文字。
- 尚未验证或不在范围内：原生 Linux/WebKitGTK、真实 PowerPoint 或截图工具的剪贴板格式、真实后端附件提交和命令执行。上游 Java 改动从 main 继承，不属于此 PR 的有效差异或验证结论。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：不改公共 API、依赖、daemon 路由或配置，无需迁移。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): support full model configuration at session creation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Allows a trusted application to supply a complete, immutable model connection when creating a Managed Session: protocol, model, API base URL, API key and validated generation parameters. Public requests use `model_config`; WebShell requests use `modelConfig`. API-key-based OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic and Gemini connections are supported without registering the model or credentials in the Harness.

The connection is encrypted with tenant/Session identity binding and admitted atomically with the Session. Private attachment and recovery carry a configuration digest; only the current authorized writer can retrieve the connection. Each execution receives its own configuration, child Sessions inherit an independently encrypted copy, and omitted configuration preserves existing behavior. Gemini explicitly retains Developer API mode despite host cloud flags and forwards the configured seed.

Configured seeds are also forwarded for ordinary, non-hosted provider calls; a seed already present in the general sampling settings was previously ignored.

## Why it's needed

Applications currently have to configure model connections on the Harness deployment, and Session model selection can only choose registered catalog IDs. Applications serving multiple tenants need to provide different endpoints, credentials and generation settings for concurrent Sessions without changing shared process configuration.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable the Session Store, credential encryption and matching Harness capability, and allow the intended API base URLs. Create two Sessions using the same model ID but different endpoints, keys and generation parameters. Each should call only its assigned provider; a Session without a complete configuration should retain deployment defaults.
2. Replay the creation request with the same idempotency key and content, then change its configuration while retaining the key. Expect the original admission for the replay and a conflict for changed content. Invalid configurations, disallowed endpoints and simultaneous catalog selection must be refused.
3. Detach a completed Session, restart the Harness and reattach it. Its original connection must still be used. A changed digest, unauthorized configuration read or unavailable configuration must prevent execution instead of selecting a host fallback. Child admission should preserve the configuration while re-encrypting it for the child's identity. A public extension child explicitly selecting `inherit` or the current model should also execute with that connection; endpoint or provider-pin drift must be refused.
4. Create a Gemini Session with `seed: 42` while either host cloud-mode flag is true. Expect the Gemini Developer API request path, the Session's API key and the configured seed. Verify credentials are absent from public responses and committed journal resources, and complete-configuration Sessions cannot switch to the host catalog.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The installed CLI 0.25.2 lacked the new capability; this is a negotiation baseline, not a source-level execution comparison. The implemented Harness passed concurrent OpenAI connection isolation, omitted-configuration behavior, prompt replay, digest-conflict refusal and clean-detach/restart recovery with synthetic providers. Focused Java/H2/MySQL tests separately covered admission, encryption, identity binding and private-read authorization.

Gemini process reproduction initially observed a Vertex Express request path and a missing seed under either host cloud flag. After correction, both cases used the Developer API path, the correct Session key and `seed: 42`. Build, typecheck, bundle, focused TypeScript/Java checks, formatting and changed-file lint passed. A separate comment records detailed evidence and its limits. No browser UI changed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Focused unit, native MySQL and synthetic-provider Harness process checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.14.0, JDK 21.0.12.1+1, Maven 3.9.16 and disposable native MySQL 8.4.11. All process checks used isolated settings, loopback providers and synthetic credentials. Typecheck passed with a 6 GiB Node heap.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: credentials are immutable per-Session snapshots; replacing a provider key requires a new Session. The endpoint allowlist is deployment-wide. Trusted callers remain responsible for tenant-specific model permissions and parameter policies, while deployment controls provide tenant quotas, outbound network restrictions and any required process isolation.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real Java-to-Harness-to-provider path, real provider acceptance, process-level approval continuation/child/workflow/compression/Hook execution and mid-Turn crash recovery. Full Java verify/SpotBugs and complete MySQL/Hosted/fault CI profiles remain acceptance gates. OAuth, arbitrary headers, credential rotation, a tenant model registry and browser credential editing are outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the unreleased shared V1 schema is updated in place according to repository policy; development catalogs must be recreated. Deploy matching Server/Broker and Harness builds, and retain encryption keys while persisted Sessions reference them. Requests omitting the new field keep their previous semantics.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-session-model-config/docs/design/managed-session-model-config.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-session-model-config/docs/design/managed-session-model-config.zh-CN.md). Both include the same decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and multi-tenant deployment boundary.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

允许可信业务应用在创建 Managed Session 时下发完整且不可变的模型连接，包括协议、模型、API 地址、API key 和经过校验的生成参数。公共请求使用 `model_config`，WebShell 请求使用 `modelConfig`。支持基于 API key 的 OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses、Anthropic 和 Gemini 连接，无需在 Harness 中登记模型或凭据。

连接按租户/Session 身份绑定加密，与 Session 原子准入。私有挂接和恢复只携带配置摘要，只有当前获授权的 writer 能读取完整连接。每次执行使用独立配置，子 Session 继承后按自身身份重新加密，省略配置时保持已有行为。Gemini 显式固定为 Developer API 模式，不受宿主云模式标志影响，并传递配置的 seed。

普通非托管 provider 调用也会传递配置的 seed；通用采样设置中已有的 seed 此前会被忽略。

## 为什么需要

目前应用需要在 Harness 部署侧配置模型连接，会话模型选择也只能使用已登记的目录 ID。服务多个租户的业务应用需要为并发 Session 提供不同地址、凭据和生成参数，同时避免修改共享进程配置。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 启用 Session Store、凭据加密和匹配的 Harness 能力，并允许目标 API 地址。创建两个模型 ID 相同、地址、密钥和生成参数不同的 Session。它们应各自调用指定 provider；未提供完整配置的 Session 应继续使用部署默认值。
2. 使用相同幂等键和内容重放创建请求，再保留幂等键但改变配置。前者应返回原准入结果，后者应冲突。无效配置、未允许的端点以及同时选择宿主目录模型的请求必须被拒绝。
3. 在一轮完成后 detach Session，重启 Harness 再挂接，确认仍使用原连接。不同摘要、未授权的配置读取或配置不可用必须阻止执行，不能选用宿主回退模型。子会话准入应保留配置，并按子会话身份重新加密。公共扩展子会话显式选择 `inherit` 或当前同名模型时，也应使用该连接执行；端点或 provider pin 漂移必须拒绝。
4. 宿主任一云模式标志为 true 时创建 `seed: 42` 的 Gemini Session。请求应使用 Gemini Developer API 路径、该 Session 的 API key 和指定 seed。确认公共响应及已提交日志资源不包含凭据，使用完整配置的 Session 不能切换到宿主模型目录。

### 证据（修改前后）

已安装的 CLI 0.25.2 未声明新能力；这是协商基线，不是源码执行行为的前后对照。实现后的 Harness 使用模拟 provider，通过了 OpenAI 并发连接隔离、省略配置、prompt 重放、摘要冲突拒绝以及干净 detach 后重启恢复。定向 Java/H2/MySQL 测试分别覆盖准入、加密、身份绑定和私有读取授权。

Gemini 进程复现最初观察到：宿主任一云模式标志开启时，请求走 Vertex Express 路径且缺少 seed。修复后两个场景都使用 Developer API 路径、正确的 Session key 和 `seed: 42`。构建、类型检查、bundle、定向 TypeScript/Java 检查、格式检查和变更文件 lint 均通过。独立评论记录详细证据及其边界。本次未修改浏览器 UI。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 定向单测、原生 MySQL 和模拟 provider 的 Harness 进程测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

Node 22.14.0、JDK 21.0.12.1+1、Maven 3.9.16，以及临时原生 MySQL 8.4.11。所有进程检查均使用隔离配置、loopback provider 和测试凭据。类型检查使用 6 GiB Node 堆并通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：凭据是每个 Session 内不可变的快照，更换 provider key 需要新建 Session。端点白名单作用于整个部署。可信调用方继续负责租户专属模型权限和参数策略；部署侧提供租户配额、出站网络限制及需要的进程隔离。
- 未验证或范围外：真实 Java→Harness→provider 完整链路、真实服务商验收、进程级审批继续执行/子会话/workflow/压缩/Hook 执行，以及 Turn 中途崩溃恢复。完整 Java verify/SpotBugs 和完整 MySQL/Hosted/fault CI profiles 仍是验收门槛。OAuth、任意请求头、凭据轮换、租户模型注册表及浏览器凭据编辑不在本次范围内。
- 兼容与迁移：按仓库规则原地更新未发布的共享 V1 schema，开发数据库需要重建。Server/Broker 与 Harness 应部署匹配版本，并在持久化 Session 仍引用加密密钥时保留对应密钥。省略新字段的请求保持既有语义。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-session-model-config/docs/design/managed-session-model-config.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-session-model-config/docs/design/managed-session-model-config.zh-CN.md)。两版包含一致的决策、约束、验收标准和多租户部署边界。

## 关联 Issue

无。

prs.title: feat(mods): run prompt.submit hooks in the Ink terminal
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is step 2 of the prompt submission design (`docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.md`): Mods' `prompt.submit` hooks now run in the Ink terminal, for each prompt the person types. Step 1 (#15905) added the event in headless runs; the OpenTUI terminal follows in step 3.

- **The hooks run before anything reads the prompt.** That is before the input history records it, before its row is added, before `@` references are read and before UserPromptSubmit. The hook receives the typed text with pasted text expanded, `wait: false` and `origin: {kind: 'composer'}`.
  - Slash commands, shell-mode commands, scheduled prompts, notifications, teammate messages and retries raise no event.
  - A prompt queued while a turn runs raises it when it is sent. While a Mod hooks `prompt.submit`, queued prompts are not steered into the running turn at a tool boundary: they wait for the turn to end, so steering cannot bypass the hooks.
- **A rewrite stands wherever the typed text would.** That covers the model's prompt, the prompt's row, the input history the Up key recalls, the restore after a cancel, workflow keywords and `turn.start`.
  - Attachment references and the one-shot notices the terminal adds ahead of a prompt for the model alone, such as a resumed worktree, stay ahead of the rewrite. The hooks never hear them.
  - A paste the rewrite keeps whole stays collapsed in the row and framed for the model. An answer that differs only in surrounding whitespace is no rewrite.
- **Context reaches the model the same way as in headless runs.** It goes in the hidden block after the prompt, through the `promptContext` send option from step 1.
- **A drop shows its reason as an error line, and the prompt is kept out of the transcript and the input history.**
  - The input history is written to disk and comes back in later sessions, and a guard usually drops a prompt for what it holds, such as a credential.
  - The prompt comes back to the input box with its paste placeholders, ahead of anything typed since, so the person can edit it and send it again.
- **Esc while the hooks run cancels the prompt.** It hands the prompt back the same way.
- **Only the Ink terminal opts in.** `InteractiveModSession.initialize` takes `{ prompts: true }`, and the terminal host passes it to the load request. The OpenTUI terminal still skips these hooks with the startup line, so a guard is never silently bypassed there.

## Why it's needed

After #15905, a `prompt.submit` guard ran in headless runs but was skipped in the interactive terminal. There the prompts it is meant to stop went to the model, and into the input history and the session transcript on disk.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Install a Mod with a `prompt.submit` hook that drops a prompt holding `AKIA` followed by 16 capitals or digits, and otherwise rewrites `prod` to `production` and adds the context `Mod context: be brief`. Start `qwen` and:
  - send `deploy prod now`: the row reads `deploy production now`, and the model receives that text with the context in the hidden block;
  - send `key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP`: an error line `Prompt dropped by a hook: …` appears, no request is sent, and the prompt is back in the input box;
  - clear the input box and press Up: it recalls `deploy production now`, not the dropped prompt.
- `npx vitest run src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/services/interactive-mod-session.test.ts` in `packages/cli`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Interactive Ink session in tmux (170×50), with the Mod above installed through `qwen extensions install` and a loopback OpenAI-compatible fixture that records each request. Before is `main` at `90eb13e4c6`, After is this PR. Both bundles were built locally.

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Startup | `Hooks for unsupported events will not run: prompt.submit` | no skip line |
| `deploy prod now`: row | `> deploy prod now` | `> deploy production now` |
| `deploy prod now`: model's text | `deploy prod now` | `deploy production now`, then `<qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>Mod context: be brief</qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>` |
| `key AKIA…`: screen | `> key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP`, then the answer | `✕ Prompt dropped by a hook: the prompt holds an AWS access key`, with the prompt back in the input box |
| `key AKIA…`: model requests | 3 | 0 |
| Up key after clearing the input box | `key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP` | `deploy production now` |
| Files under `HOME` that hold the key | `logs.json` (input history) and the session transcript | none |

Automated checks:

- New hook tests cover:
  - the rewritten prompt in the send, the row, the input history, the workflow input and `turn.start`;
  - notices kept ahead of a rewrite;
  - an attachment, a notice and a framed paste around a rewrite, and a whitespace-only answer;
  - a drop: error line, no row, no input history, no request, the prompt handed back;
  - a prompt cancelled while its hooks run;
  - no event for a slash command or a scheduled prompt.
- An AppContainer test covers the `prompts: true` opt-in, the steer drain held while hooks hear prompts, and handing a prompt back with its placeholders ahead of the box's text. Mod session tests cover a terminal that opts in, and an owner that lets prompts through once it closes.
- 22 of 23 mutants are caught by the tests. They cover which prompts raise the event, both hand-backs and their placeholders, the error line, finding the typed text, re-collapsing pastes, the input history, the context, the workflow input, `turn.start`, the display text, the opt-in links, the closed owner, prepending to the box and the held steer drain. The survivor, an untrimmed comparison, gives the same output now that pastes are re-collapsed.
- The touched test files pass: 5 files, 769 tests.
- The cli `tsc --noEmit`, and the scoped ESLint and Prettier checks pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 24.21.0, tmux, bundles built with `npm run bundle`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a slow hook delays the prompt by up to its budget, 10 seconds a hook, before its row appears. Sessions with a `prompt.submit` hook lose mid-turn steering: a prompt typed during a turn waits for it to end. A dropped prompt also uses up the one-shot notices the terminal had added to it.
- Not validated / out of scope: the OpenTUI terminal (step 3) and `$.prompt.submit` (step 4).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. A Mod with `prompt.submit` hooks now runs them in the Ink terminal instead of having them skipped.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13749.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这是提示提交设计（`docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.md`）的第 2 步：Mod 的 `prompt.submit` hook 现在在 Ink 终端中运行，覆盖用户输入的每个提示。第 1 步（#15905）在 headless 运行中加入了该事件；OpenTUI 终端在第 3 步跟进。

- **hook 在任何地方读取提示之前运行。** 即在输入历史记录它之前、添加它的消息行之前、读取 `@` 引用之前，以及 UserPromptSubmit 之前。hook 收到的是用户输入的文本（粘贴内容已展开）、`wait: false` 和 `origin: {kind: 'composer'}`。
  - 斜杠命令、shell 模式命令、定时提示、通知、队友消息和重试都不触发该事件。
  - 回合进行中排队的提示在真正发送时触发。有 Mod 挂了 `prompt.submit` 时，排队的提示不会在工具边界被插进运行中的回合，而是等回合结束，因此中途插话无法绕过 hook。
- **改写替换所有原本使用输入文本的地方。** 包括模型收到的提示、消息行、按上键调出的输入历史、取消后的恢复、工作流关键字和 `turn.start`。
  - 附件引用和终端为模型放在提示前面的一次性提醒（例如恢复的 worktree）仍保留在改写结果前面，hook 不会听到它们。
  - 改写后仍完整保留的粘贴内容在消息行中保持折叠，发给模型时仍被包裹。只差首尾空白的答复不算改写。
- **上下文与 headless 运行一样进入模型。** 通过第 1 步的 `promptContext` 发送选项，放在提示之后的隐藏块中。
- **丢弃时以一行错误显示原因，提示不进入 transcript，也不进入输入历史。**
  - 输入历史会写入磁盘并在之后的会话中恢复，而守卫丢弃提示通常正是因为其中的内容，例如凭据。
  - 提示会带着粘贴占位符回到输入框，放在之后输入的内容前面，方便修改后重新发送。
- **hook 运行时按 Esc 会取消该提示。** 提示以同样方式回到输入框。
- **只有 Ink 终端声明触发该事件。** `InteractiveModSession.initialize` 接收 `{ prompts: true }`，终端宿主再把它传给加载请求。OpenTUI 终端仍在启动时跳过这些 hook 并给出提示，守卫在那里不会被悄悄绕过。

## 为什么需要

#15905 之后，`prompt.submit` 守卫在 headless 运行中生效，但在交互式终端里被跳过。它本应拦下的提示仍会发给模型，并写入磁盘上的输入历史和会话 transcript。

## 评审验证

### 如何验证

- 安装一个带 `prompt.submit` hook 的 Mod：提示中含有 `AKIA` 加 16 位大写字母或数字时丢弃，否则把 `prod` 改写为 `production` 并加上上下文 `Mod context: be brief`。启动 `qwen`，然后：
  - 发送 `deploy prod now`：消息行显示 `deploy production now`，模型收到该文本，隐藏块中带有上下文；
  - 发送 `key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP`：出现错误行 `Prompt dropped by a hook: …`，没有发出请求，提示回到输入框；
  - 清空输入框后按上键：调出的是 `deploy production now`，而不是被丢弃的提示。
- 在 `packages/cli` 中运行 `npx vitest run src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/services/interactive-mod-session.test.ts`。

### 证据（前后对比）

tmux 中的交互式 Ink 会话（170×50），上面的 Mod 通过 `qwen extensions install` 安装，使用记录每个请求的本地回环 OpenAI 兼容 fixture。Before 为 `main` 的 `90eb13e4c6`，After 为本 PR。两个 bundle 都在本地构建。

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 启动 | `Hooks for unsupported events will not run: prompt.submit` | 无跳过提示 |
| `deploy prod now`：消息行 | `> deploy prod now` | `> deploy production now` |
| `deploy prod now`：模型收到的文本 | `deploy prod now` | `deploy production now`，之后是 `<qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>Mod context: be brief</qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>` |
| `key AKIA…`：屏幕 | `> key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP`，然后是回答 | `✕ Prompt dropped by a hook: the prompt holds an AWS access key`，提示回到输入框 |
| `key AKIA…`：模型请求数 | 3 | 0 |
| 清空输入框后按上键 | `key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP` | `deploy production now` |
| `HOME` 下含有该密钥的文件 | `logs.json`（输入历史）和会话 transcript | 无 |

自动化检查：

- 新增的 hook 测试覆盖：
  - 改写后的提示出现在发送内容、消息行、输入历史、工作流输入和 `turn.start` 中；
  - 改写时一次性提醒保持在前；
  - 改写时附件、提醒和包裹的粘贴内容保持原位，以及只差空白的答复；
  - 丢弃：显示错误行、没有消息行、不进输入历史、不发请求、提示交回；
  - hook 运行时被取消的提示；
  - 斜杠命令和定时提示不触发事件。
- AppContainer 测试覆盖 `prompts: true` 的声明、hook 听提示时暂停中途插话，以及带占位符把提示放在输入框原有内容前面。Mod session 测试覆盖声明触发该事件的终端，以及关闭后直接放行提示的 owner。
- 23 个变异中 22 个被测试捕获，覆盖触发范围、两处交回及其占位符、错误行、定位输入文本、重新折叠粘贴、输入历史、上下文、工作流输入、`turn.start`、显示文本、宿主声明、关闭后的放行、前置到输入框和暂停中途插话。存活的是不去首尾空白的比较，在重新折叠粘贴之后它的输出与现在相同。
- 改动涉及的测试文件全部通过：5 个文件共 769 个测试。
- cli 的 `tsc --noEmit`，以及限定范围的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查都通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：慢的 hook 会让提示晚出现，每个 hook 最多 10 秒的预算。挂了 `prompt.submit` hook 的会话不能在回合中途插话：回合中输入的提示要等回合结束。被丢弃的提示也会用掉终端为它添加的一次性提醒。
- 未验证或不在范围内：OpenTUI 终端（第 3 步）和 `$.prompt.submit`（第 4 步）。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。带 `prompt.submit` hook 的 Mod 现在会在 Ink 终端运行这些 hook，而不是被跳过。

## 关联 Issue

#13749 的一部分。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): make persisted session pagination safe for equal mtimes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persisted-session pagination now orders files by modification time **and** session file name, and the next-page cursor carries that full position instead of only the timestamp. A caller walking the cursor now sees every session exactly once even when many files share the same mtime.

## Why it's needed

`listSessions()` sorted by mtime alone and resumed the next page with a strict `mtime < cursor`. An mtime is not a unique key: bulk copies, backup restores and coarse-timestamp filesystems routinely produce whole groups of files with an identical `mtimeMs`. When such a group straddled a page boundary, every remaining file tied at the boundary was filtered out, the next page came back empty, and `hasMore` flipped to `false` — so the sessions were silently skipped and the caller reported the list as complete. With 25 session files at one mtime and `size: 5`, the whole history surfaced 5 sessions out of 25.

This is the same hazard the file already documents twice for its own workarounds (`listAllProjectSessionIds` and `findSessionsByTitle` both bypass `listSessions` and its strict `<` cursor precisely for this reason, and both already sort with a filename tie-break). This PR fixes the root cause instead of working around it a third time.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the new colocated test, which builds 25 session files that all share one `mtimeMs`, pages through them with `size: 5`, and asserts every id appears exactly once:

```
cd packages/core && pnpm vitest run src/services/sessionService.test.ts -t "should return every session once when all files share an mtime"
```

Expected: 25 ids, all distinct. Observed before the fix: `expected [ …(5) ] to have a length of 25 but got 5` — page 1 returned 5 items with `hasMore: true`, page 2 returned nothing, and the walk stopped at 5 of 25.

Then run the whole file to confirm existing pagination behaviour is untouched:

```
cd packages/core && pnpm vitest run src/services/sessionService.test.ts
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Red, on unmodified `main` (commit `06c1f989`):

```
FAIL  src/services/sessionService.test.ts > SessionService > listSessions > should return every session once when all files share an mtime
AssertionError: expected [ …(5) ] to have a length of 25 but got 5
- Expected
+ Received
- 25
+ 5
 ❯ src/services/sessionService.test.ts:1088:20
```

Green, with this PR applied (whole file, not `-t`):

```
✓ src/services/sessionService.test.ts (268 tests) 1210ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  268 passed (268)
```

N/A for screenshots: this is not user-visible UI, the change is in the session-list read path.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local `pnpm vitest` in a worktree; no sandbox or container.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `ListSessionsResult.nextCursor` widens from `number` to `number | string`. A numeric cursor is still accepted and keeps its exact previous meaning (strict `mtime < cursor`), so cursors already in flight keep working; only the *emitted* form changes, to `"<mtime>|<name>"`. The daemon's cursor is already an opaque string on the wire, so the one place that parsed it (`parseSessionCursor` in `packages/cli/src/serve/server/session-list.ts`) now passes the composite form through instead of rejecting it as invalid — without that, session pagination over the daemon API would have thrown `InvalidCursorError` on page 2. Page size, `hasMore`, the on-disk JSONL format and `getSessionListItem` are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: the daemon's own suite (`packages/cli/src/serve/server/session-list.test.ts`) could not run in this environment — the CLI package's vitest precheck requires the whole workspace to be built (all `packages/channels/*` `dist` plus generated files), which is unrelated to this change. The daemon edit is strictly additive by inspection: every previously-valid cursor still parses to the same value, and no test in that file asserts that a `|`-bearing cursor throws. `packages/core` typecheck is also not clean on this machine for pre-existing reasons (`mime/lite`, `ignore` resolution in a reused `node_modules`); eslint on all three touched files is clean.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for on-disk data. Consumers that treated `nextCursor` as a number need to treat it as opaque — the daemon already did.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #11706

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

持久化会话分页现在按「修改时间 + 会话文件名」排序，下一页游标携带完整位置，而不只是一个时间戳。调用方沿着游标翻页时，即使大量文件共享同一个 mtime，也能把每个会话恰好返回一次。

## 为什么需要

`listSessions()` 只按 mtime 排序，下一页用严格的 `mtime < cursor` 过滤。mtime 不是唯一键：批量拷贝、备份恢复和粗粒度时间戳的文件系统都会产生一整组 `mtimeMs` 完全相同的文件。当这样一组文件横跨分页边界时，边界上所有并列的文件都被过滤掉，下一页返回空、`hasMore` 变 `false`，这些会话就被静默跳过，而调用方会认为列表已经取完。25 个同 mtime 的会话文件、`size: 5` 时，整个过程只露出 25 个中的 5 个。

这个隐患该文件自己已经记录过两次（`listAllProjectSessionIds` 与 `findSessionsByTitle` 都因此绕开 `listSessions` 及其严格 `<` 游标，并且都已用文件名做 tie-break）。这个 PR 修的是根因，而不是再加第三处绕行。

## 复核方式

新增的测试在 `packages/core/src/services/sessionService.test.ts` 里：造 25 个 mtime 相同的会话文件，用 `size: 5` 翻页，断言每个 id 恰好出现一次。修复前见红为 `expected [ …(5) ] to have a length of 25 but got 5`；修复后整文件 268 个用例全绿。

## 风险与范围

`nextCursor` 类型从 `number` 放宽为 `number | string`。数字游标仍被接受且语义完全不变（严格 `mtime < cursor`），在途游标不受影响；只有输出的形态变成 `"<mtime>|<name>"`。daemon 的游标本来就是不透明字符串，唯一解析它的 `parseSessionCursor` 现在把复合形态原样透传，否则 daemon 会话分页在第 2 页会抛 `InvalidCursorError`。分页大小、`hasMore`、磁盘上的 JSONL 格式与 `getSessionListItem` 均未改动。本机未能运行 daemon 自身的测试套件（需要整仓构建所有 channels 包），这一点已在上面如实说明。

</details>
