prs.title: fix(permissions): report malformed rules instead of dropping them silently
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A permission rule whose parentheses do not balance is parsed as inert: it matches nothing. On the current base (#15794) such a rule already produces one generic warning, but that line cannot say which list owns it — the same malformed rule in `allow` and `deny` prints two identical lines — it repeats for every manager the hosted path builds, and `/permissions` still filters the rule out, so it cannot be seen or deleted there. This PR makes the drop visible: the permission manager warns on the console, naming the list, the raw rule and the consequence, using the same operator-facing breadcrumb `tools.eager` already prints from the same initializer; and `/permissions` keeps the unparsable rule in the listing, marked `(unparsable)`, so it can be seen and deleted instead of being filtered out. Matching semantics are unchanged — a malformed rule still matches nothing, so no allow/deny decision moves.

## Why it's needed

The asymmetry is what makes this a security problem rather than a logging nit: a malformed allow rule fails closed (nothing gets auto-approved), but a malformed deny/ask rule fails open — the restriction the operator wrote does not exist, and neither startup output nor `/permissions` mentioned it. The operator's mental model is "docker is blocked"; the runtime's behaviour is "no such rule". Turning silent fail-open into visible fail-open is the minimal, semantics-preserving step the issue asks for first: the operator still has to fix the configuration, but now they know there is something to fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Write a malformed deny rule into a settings file:

```json
{ "permissions": { "deny": ["Bash(docker *"] } }
```

Start the CLI. Before any prompt, stderr shows:

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)" so it ends at the closing ")" of the specifier.
```

Open `/permissions`, switch to the Deny tab: the rule is listed as `(unparsable) Bash(docker *`. Select it and delete it — the row disappears and stays gone on the next open. Then fix the rule to `Bash(docker *)` and restart: no warning, no marker, and a denied command prompts as before.

Focused suites:

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/permissions
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialog-data.test.ts src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.tsx src/i18n
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: starting with `deny: ["Bash(docker *"]` printed a generic line with no list name — `[permissions] ignoring malformed rule (unbalanced parentheses): Bash(docker *` — emitted by `packages/core/src/permissions/permission-rules.ts`, once per manager the hosted path builds; and `/permissions` simply did not list the rule.

After, from the built CLI with that settings file:

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)" so it ends at the closing ")" of the specifier.
```

With the corrected rule `Bash(docker *)` the same run prints no warning — the negative control.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

macOS: Node 22.23.4, `npm run build`, all focused suites green, plus the headless run quoted above. Linux: Docker `node:22-bookworm`, same suites green, and `tsc --noEmit` clean for both packages. Windows was not run.

### Environment (optional)

Focused unit suites and a headless `dist/index.js` run with a temporary `HOME`; the Linux pass used a Docker volume workspace because a bind-mounted tree trips `rimraf` with `ENOTEMPTY`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a configuration that keeps a malformed rule now prints one line per bad rule from the permission manager at startup (the pre-existing `permission-rules.ts` line can still fire for the same configuration, so a single run may show both shapes), and `/permissions` shows an extra row. No permission decision changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: the issue's other two asks — failing closed (rejecting a malformed deny/ask at load, or denying the tool it names) and the analogous `tools.disabled` typo check — are deliberately left out. The first changes runtime matching semantics, the second is a separate registry check; both fit a follow-up.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `parseRules` no longer writes to the debug log; reporting moved into the permission manager, its only caller.
- Coordination: #15775 implements the same fix for the same issue, so only one of the two can land; whoever merges second will conflict on the dialog, data and parser files.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15752 (closed by #15794, which landed the generic warning). The deferred shapes — `Bash(rm -rf /))`, `Bash)` and the `tools.disabled` typo check — are tracked in #16078.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

括号不配对的权限规则会被解析成惰性规则：它不匹配任何调用。在当前 base（#15794）上，这类规则已经会打一行通用告警，但那一行说不清规则属于哪张列表（同一条畸形规则同时出现在 `allow` 和 `deny` 时会打两行完全相同的日志）、会随 hosted 路径每次新建 manager 重复打印，而且 `/permissions` 仍然把它过滤掉，既看不到也删不掉。这个 PR 把"被丢弃"变成可见：权限管理器在控制台告警，点明所在的列表、原始规则和后果，写法沿用同一个初始化流程里 `tools.eager` 已经在用的"面向操作者"面包屑；同时 `/permissions` 不再过滤掉无法解析的规则，而是把它列出来并标注 `(unparsable)`，让操作者能看到并删除。匹配语义完全没有变——畸形规则依旧不匹配任何东西，所以没有任何 allow/deny 判定会因此改变。

## 为什么需要它

这种不对称正是它属于安全问题而不只是日志问题的原因：畸形 allow 规则是 fail-closed（不会自动放行任何东西），但畸形 deny/ask 规则是 fail-open——操作者写下的限制并不存在，而且启动输出和 `/permissions` 都不会提到它。操作者的心智模型是"docker 被拦住了"，运行时的事实是"根本没有这条规则"。把静默的 fail-open 变成可见的 fail-open，是这个 issue 要求的第一步，也是改动最小、不触碰语义的一步：配置仍然要由操作者自己修，但现在他知道有东西要修。

## Reviewer Test Plan（评审验证计划）

### 如何验证

把一条畸形 deny 规则写进配置文件：

```json
{ "permissions": { "deny": ["Bash(docker *"] } }
```

启动 CLI。在任何提示词之前，stderr 会打印：

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)" so it ends at the closing ")" of the specifier.
```

打开 `/permissions`，切到 Deny 标签页：该规则显示为 `(unparsable) Bash(docker *`。选中它并删除，这一行会消失，下次打开也不再出现。再把规则改成 `Bash(docker *)` 重启：没有告警、没有标记，被拒绝的命令照旧弹确认。

定向测试：

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/permissions
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialog-data.test.ts src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.tsx src/i18n
```

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：用 `deny: ["Bash(docker *"]` 启动只打印一行不带列表名的通用告警 `[permissions] ignoring malformed rule (unbalanced parentheses): Bash(docker *`（来自 `packages/core/src/permissions/permission-rules.ts`，hosted 路径每新建一个 manager 就重复一次），`/permissions` 也完全不列出这条规则。

改动后，用该配置文件运行构建产物：

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)" so it ends at the closing ")" of the specifier.
```

把规则改成 `Bash(docker *)` 后同样运行不再打印任何告警——反向对照。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

macOS：Node 22.23.4，`npm run build`，上述定向测试全部通过，并做了上文引用的 headless 运行。Linux：Docker `node:22-bookworm`，同样的测试全部通过，两个包的 `tsc --noEmit` 也干净。Windows 未运行。

### 运行环境（可选）

定向单元测试，加上用临时 `HOME` 跑的 `dist/index.js` headless 运行；Linux 那轮用 Docker volume 作工作区，因为 bind mount 的目录会让 `rimraf` 报 `ENOTEMPTY`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：如果配置里保留了畸形规则，启动时权限管理器会按每条坏规则打印一行（原有的 `permission-rules.ts` 那行仍可能对同一份配置触发，所以一次运行可能同时看到两种文案），`/permissions` 也会多出一行。没有任何权限判定发生变化。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：issue 提出的另外两项——fail-closed（加载时拒绝畸形 deny/ask，或直接拒绝它点名的工具）以及 `tools.disabled` 拼写错误的同类校验——有意未包含。前者会改变运行时匹配语义，后者是另一条注册表校验路径，都更适合作为后续 PR。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。`parseRules` 不再写 debug 日志，告警移到了权限管理器里，而它是唯一的调用方。
- 协作：同样修复这个 issue 的 #15775 仍然开着，两者只能落一个；后合的那个会在对话框、数据与 parser 文件上冲突。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #15752（已由 #15794 关闭，后者落了通用告警）。被推迟的形态——`Bash(rm -rf /))`、`Bash)` 和 `tools.disabled` 拼写校验——记录在 #16078。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): resume linter archive downloads
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR makes the cold-cache linter install survive a throttled release-asset download. Before this change, every curl attempt restarted at byte zero with the same 90-second ceiling; three stalls in a row failed the required lint gate. After this change, up to five attempts resume from the bytes already received, with increasing delays between them.

It does not change which archives are downloaded or which versions are pinned. The archive still has to pass the existing SHA-256 verification before extraction or caching.

## Why it's needed

The failing jobs in #16005 were diagnosed as a missing Node runtime, but the `Node.js is not on PATH` text is echoed script source from the preflight action. On `ecs-qwen-hz5-2` and `ecs-qwen-hz6-20`, Node 22.23.4 was found and that preflight step succeeded. The actual failure was `Install linters`:

- `actionlint`: three timeouts, each receiving roughly 1.2-1.5 MB of 2.1 MB.
- `shellcheck`: three timeouts, each receiving roughly 2.4-2.6 MB of 6.8 MB.

The same cold-cache plus degraded-egress pattern made unrelated commits fail the only required status context. Starting over on each retry discards the useful progress from the prior attempt.

The more durable infrastructure fix is still to pre-warm these pinned archives on the runner pool or serve them from an internal mirror. This PR only removes one repository-side failure mode until that lands.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the generated installer retries with `--continue-at -` and that the focused suite exercises a truncated first transfer followed by a completed resume.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a timeout on attempt 1 was followed by an unrelated request from byte zero. After: the failed partial file is retained and the next attempt resumes at that offset. The fake curl in the new regression writes a partial archive on the first request and appends the remainder on the resumed request; the SHA-256 check then accepts the complete file.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Per the standing local-execution constraint for this task, no tests, formatting, lint, build, or typecheck were run locally. The new focused regression is left to CI. The regression is skip-gated on Windows because the installer's POSIX shell path is not exercised there.

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a server that does not support range requests makes a resumed attempt fail with curl exit 33 or 36; the loop then discards the partial file and starts cleanly on the next attempt. The bounded attempt count prevents an indefinite retry loop.
- Not validated / out of scope: runner-pool pre-warming and an internal mirror are not included; that is the durable infrastructure fix. The retry path was not executed locally under this task's no-test constraint.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

References #16005. This PR hardens the repository-side cold-cache download path but does not prove the runner-pool infrastructure issue is fully resolved, so it intentionally does not auto-close the issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这个 PR 让冷缓存下的 linter 安装能扛住发布资源下载被限速的情况。修改前，每次 curl 尝试都从 0 字节重新开始，且都是 90 秒上限；连续三次卡住就会让必需的 lint 门禁变红。修改后最多尝试五次，每次从已经收到的字节处续传，并在两次尝试之间逐步增加等待时间。

它不改变下载哪些压缩包，也不改变固定版本。压缩包仍必须先通过现有的 SHA-256 校验，之后才能解压或写入缓存。

## 为什么需要

#16005 中失败的 job 被诊断为缺少 Node 运行时，但 `Node.js is not on PATH` 这段文字是 preflight action 回显的脚本源码。在 `ecs-qwen-hz5-2` 和 `ecs-qwen-hz6-20` 上，Node 22.23.4 被找到，该 preflight 步骤成功。实际失败的是 `Install linters`：

- `actionlint`：三次超时，每次大约收到 2.1 MB 中的 1.2-1.5 MB。
- `shellcheck`：三次超时，每次大约收到 6.8 MB 中的 2.4-2.6 MB。

同样的冷缓存加上劣化的出网，使不相关的提交也会让唯一必需的状态检查变红。每次重试都从头开始，会丢掉上一次已经取得的进度。

更持久的修复仍然是在 runner 池上预热这些固定版本的压缩包，或用内网镜像提供它们。这个 PR 只移除仓库侧的一种失败方式，直到那个修复落地。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

确认生成的 installer 使用 `--continue-at -` 续传，并确认聚焦测试覆盖了第一次传输被截断、第二次续传后完成的情况。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

修改前：第一次尝试超时后，下一次请求从 0 字节重新开始。修改后：失败的部分文件会保留，下一次尝试从该偏移续传。新增回归测试里的假 curl 第一次写入部分压缩包，续传请求追加剩余内容；随后 SHA-256 校验接受完整文件。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

按照本任务现行的本机执行约束，没有在本地运行测试、格式化、lint、build 或 typecheck。新的聚焦回归留给 CI。该回归在 Windows 上跳过，因为 installer 的 POSIX shell 路径不会在那里执行。

### 环境（可选）

N/A

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：如果服务器不支持 range 请求，续传会以 curl exit 33 或 36 失败；循环随后会丢弃部分文件，并在下一次尝试时从头开始。尝试次数有上限，不会无限重试。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：runner 池预热和内网镜像不包含在内；那才是持久的基础设施修复。受本任务不跑本地测试的约束，续传路径未在本地执行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

引用 #16005。这个 PR 加强了仓库侧冷缓存下载路径，但不能证明 runner 池的基础设施问题已完全解决，因此有意不自动关闭该 issue。

</details>

prs.title: feat(hooks): add FileChanged notifications for local sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `FileChanged` hooks for local, non-managed sessions. Hooks can observe literal filenames in the working directory or register absolute files and recursive directories through successful synchronous `SessionStart` and `FileChanged` output. Notifications carry the listening session, configured absolute path and `add`, `change` or `unlink`, including changes made by external processes.

Registrations follow session ownership, working-directory changes and hook reloads. Initially missing paths and deleted/recreated roots can recover. Explicit symbolic-link files and directory roots observe their targets while preserving the configured alias in notifications; recursive discovery keeps implicit symbolic links, `.git` and `node_modules` subtrees excluded unless explicitly registered.

CI compatibility repairs retain the complete gates while using fresh verification directories and runner-local Java dependency caches. Hosted workflow fault checks distinguish live consumption from a delivery-classification snapshot, and the digest-tamper probe updates its exact resource row by primary key. Attestation-loss injection covers both attempts of the existing bounded read-only EOF retry while preserving recovery-blocking assertions. RocketMQ downloads have bounded connection/transfer/retry windows. The hard-pinned 5.5.1 release first uses a public Apache mirror and falls back to the two official Apache sources; its independent SHA-512 check remains mandatory before extraction. Other versions retain the official-source checksum chain. Cold-resume TUI verification waits for the original assistant reply, then checks the typed user text in the same frame within the existing deadline. The branch also contains the upstream CI history and hosted macOS Intel startup-budget fixes. The self-hosted browser gate prepares missing DejaVu font data in the runner user's font directory, then rechecks that user. Preparation uses private APT lists and package extraction at the runner's existing privilege level; it never elevates or executes the PR-provided host installer.

Commit `be264d0c9f9f9662702f7c7a1a7c4d2a84311441` fixes a CI test that assumed an ordering Git does not guarantee. The preceding Linux run recorded 117,400 passes, one order-only failure and 152 skips: both expected worktree-prune entries were present, but reversed in all three attempts. The assertion now requires exactly the same two complete records without ordering. Production behavior, the 20-second deadline and test selection are unchanged. The original file passes 48/48; a controlled reversal of real Git announcement lines also passes the original case, and ten missing/extra/duplicate/wrong-object controls are rejected.

Commit `1a8b2591` integrates upstream main `4dd7ac7` and resolves the overlapping prune-test repair using the upstream order-normalized, exact two-record assertion. Commit `16a439b6` corrects cache-repair eligibility: only default `_tool` cache candidates invoke the unchanged canonical-path and symlink safeguards. Other configured cache roots retain their provisioned permissions and continue through the original Java installation and tests. No new privileges, test selectors, coverage guards or deadlines were introduced. Commit `16ef4bb269` qualifies the Managed database template in two unit-test fixtures. This preserves their original binding on the branch and selects the same named private template after newer main is integrated; SQL, transaction fields, assertions and test selection are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Memory and other integrations need notifications from editors, shells and external writers, including files outside the working directory. This supplies a general filesystem event while leaving initial reconciliation and durable synchronization to the integration.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Register initially missing literal filenames, then create, atomically replace and delete them. Expect file notifications while unrelated siblings stay silent.
- Register an external directory, add nested files, delete and recreate the root, then write again. Notifications should continue; replacing or clearing dynamic registrations should retain static registrations.
- Register a symbolic-link file or directory, modify its target through the real path, and confirm the hook receives the configured alias. Multiple aliases should each notify. Refresh registration after retargeting a link; implicit child links should remain silent.
- Change the working directory or rotate the session and reload hooks. Only the current owning session should notify; temporary ACP/MCP configurations and managed, remote or sandbox sessions should remain disarmed.
- On a runner with font drift, expect DejaVu font data to be prepared under that runner's XDG/HOME directory, followed by the unchanged font check. Package or remaining-font failures must stop the gate; healthy runners make no preparation requests and PR-provided scripts never gain new privileges.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before the explicit-link repair, real CLI probes on the earlier source received zero notifications for static file links, dynamic file links and dynamic directory links, while the regular-file control notified. The d38 bundle passed all three configured aliases plus the control, preserving exact paths and session identity. Directory recreation produced `change → unlink → add → change`; both probes exited naturally with code 0 and empty stderr. These are historical source-scoped probes. The later main integration changes production Java, schema, SQL and other upstream inputs, so earlier SDK results are not current-tree runtime-equivalence evidence.

The resolved main-integration tree passed a complete build and typecheck, 1,714 core regressions, 912 ACP regressions, 50 Web Shell regressions and the complete 48-case prune file, all without test skips. Twelve strict assertion controls accept both valid report orders and reject missing, duplicate, extra or misattributed records. The subsequent two-file cache fix leaves the entire application package tree, dependency lock and manifests unchanged. Its workflow-contract checks pass 121/121, original cache-safety checks 8/8 and routing checks 92/92. The test engineer also verified 45 cache contexts and nine controlled flows without executing Java or modifying shared directories. Both source audits were clean; normal commit hooks preserved the verified trees.

Local workflow-reader runs retain their failures: the integration run recorded 1,235 passes, 23 failures and 25 conditional skips; the cache-fix reader run recorded 645 passes, 22 failures and 15 conditional skips. The 22 repeated failures reproduce with identical diagnostics on untouched main4dd under macOS Bash 3.2. The other original 90-second autofix timeout has no proven cause; isolated main/candidate controls passed without extending the deadline. The actual [1a8b Linux test job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40664712936/job/122736421859) passed 117,940 test executions with zero failures and 152 existing skips, including the complete 150-case failure-reporter file, 339-case autofix file and original timed-out case. Initial local coverage-directory and linter-PATH failures remain recorded; serialization and the correct tool paths subsequently passed. Workflow-size validation also passed with the actual script under isolated Linux Bash 5, and the CI budget check passed.

### Current verification

Verification snapshot: 2026-11-03 11:57 Asia/Shanghai. Current head is `ddfae3f582aa9e75079e2b2009857035a8da2d03`, integrating main `c26a32006a` through an automatic merge whose tree matches the independent merge preview. GitHub reports MERGEABLE; the previous conflict state is cleared. The existing FileChanged changes and review fixes remain intact, including all five missing-helper guards for resumed Java releases. Two merge audits found no new confirmed mandatory defect.

All eight current product workflows succeeded. [Main CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41569906844) actually checked out ddf: required Lint passed749/749 helper checks plus actionlint and shellcheck; Linux recorded120306 test executions passed, zero failures and151 existing skips; no-AK integration passed373/373. Actual Core JUnit confirms the complete watcher file28/28 with zero failures/errors/skips, including the missing-ancestor and non-directory-parent retry cases. Browser smoke recorded433 passed and1 flaky case that passed built-in retry#1; it was not434 first-attempt passes. The first failure waited20 seconds for the mobile composer textarea to appear, before the attachment-width assertion; its cause is unknown. Transcript checks passed6/6. No manual CI rerun or timeout increase was used.

The [Managed fast gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41569906869) succeeded on actual integration8865, whose tree equals ddf: SDK412 passed/9 existing skips, Managed H2 verification6134 passed/17 existing skips, zero failures/errors, Java11 real-daemon4/4 and actual Checkstyle goals successful. Fast runs test/package; it does not certify SpotBugs or full SQL/Hosted profiles. Live Host passed374/374 plus build, ARM64 packaging and strict ad-hoc signature verification. Reference distribution passed96 checks/1 existing skip and built/booted the experimental archive. Landlock passed all four jobs, including Windows6 and Linux12 cases. Serve A/B completed both original head/base build-and-drive arms and artifact upload.

TUI passed20 component cases; its three original product legs recorded47 passed/1 skip,47 passed/1 skip and48 passed, with H02a/H02b/acquisition and all three cold checkpoints successful under the original retry0 setting. Skipped installed-npm acceptance jobs are not new96-case results. Visuals rendered successfully, with head/base checks89/85 passed:125 of126 screenshot pairs had zero differences. One collaboration snapshot differed6.58% because the captures showed different connection/scroll states; the relevant scenario, harness and collaboration components are identical in base/head. Its exact transient cause is unknown, and the image alone did not establish a production regression. The PNG is retained; this is not a zero-difference claim.

Local Node22 build, bundle and typecheck passed, along with selected CLI958/958, ACP status18/18 plus the built FileChanged mapping smoke, Web Shell61/61 and workflow525 checks. Workflow verification retained28 platform skips and403 unselected cases. Two original11-file Core runs each recorded2370 passes/1 failure, in adjacent real-file watcher cases under the unchanged five-second waits. The whole watcher file later passed28/28, five bounded native scenarios passed, and one observer-environment run passed2371/2371, but that observer captured no actual worker trace. These passes do not explain or erase the two plain local failures. Both raw logs/JUnit remain preserved; successful Linux CI is separate evidence and does not establish that the macOS behavior is fixed. No speculative source patch was added.

The [new automatic CR](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41569899645) is still pending, with no published current-head review or approval. The latest published review is a partial COMMENTED review on a820, not an exhaustive C=0. The [preceding review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41338368330) exhausted its21600-second budget amid provider429 retries; that failure remains recorded and was not rerun. The repository still requires two formal approvals. Upstream Java production modules and verification inputs changed, so the historical13-lane SDK result below is not full acceptance of this revision; current full-profile acceptance follows the repository's maintainer-approval gate. No local Java, Maven, SQL or installation was run after the shared local budget was exhausted.

### Historical verification — October29

Verification snapshot: 2026-10-29 09:16 Asia/Shanghai.

Current head is `16ef4bb269b146069d844d6df86cd6bd1cc45957`. The [Managed Agent fast gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250613), TUI, Landlock and reference-distribution workflows have succeeded. [Main CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250502) has also succeeded: required Lint & Static passed all 731 helper checks, Linux passed 117,940 test executions with 152 existing skips, no-AK integration passed 369/369, and browser smoke passed 403/403 plus six transcript cases. Its actual font probe selected DejaVu Sans on the healthy path; this run did not exercise cold font preparation. Serve A/B attempt1 hit the original 60-minute limit during official Node22.23.4 acquisition after a socket hang-up and stalled retry; both product builds/captures and the diff were unexecuted. Its complete failure logs remain preserved. The one same-source job rerun has now succeeded in all 16 workflow steps, including both original build/capture arms, the diff and artifact upload, with unchanged tests and deadlines. It used cached Node22.23.2-x64 under the original22.x setting; this cache-hit result does not verify the failed cold22.23.4-arm64 transfer. Visuals has also succeeded: head/base checks passed85/81, the render outcome and uploaded render-status both report success, and all118 screenshot pairs have zero pixel differences. Zero composed changes therefore produced no published PNG previews. Two raw videos were uploaded; optional GIF conversion was skipped because the host lacked ffmpeg. All eight product workflows have now succeeded. The new Live Host run actually checked out b616 on macOS26.6.2 ARM64 with Node22.23.3:374/374 tests passed without skips, followed by a successful build, ARM64 package, explicit ad-hoc signing and strict verification. These checks do not represent identity signing or notarization. The new-head automatic CR has now completed successfully and published a partial COMMENT review; formal approval remains separate from these completed product checks.

The preceding [Managed fast gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40669147407) recorded two SQL type errors after newer main made the Managed JDBC template private: two unit fixtures selected the unqualified host template. Commit `16ef4bb269` changes only those two field qualifiers and imports. The new fast job actually checked out `b61688f5` (main `11ef1988` + `16ef4bb2`) and recorded 5,834 Managed tests: 5,815 passed, 19 existing skips, and zero failures/errors. The two changed fixture classes executed all 57 integration and nine creation-skills cases with zero skips/errors, preserving the original SQL and transaction assertions. SDK tests recorded 421 total with nine existing skips; Java 11 daemon checks passed 4/4. Actual SDK, Managed and Broker Checkstyle goals reported zero violations. Fast runs test/package rather than verify, so it does not itself certify SpotBugs. The [complete SDK run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40669464577) has succeeded in all13 original lanes at immutable source `16a439b6`; all13 terminal consoles confirm that checkout. <summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

为本地非托管会话添加 `FileChanged` hook。Hook 可观察工作目录中的字面文件名，也可通过执行成功的同步 `SessionStart` 和 `FileChanged` 输出注册绝对文件或递归目录。通知携带监听会话、配置中的绝对路径及 `add`、`change` 或 `unlink`，覆盖外部进程的写入。

注册跟随会话归属、工作目录变化和 hook 重载；初始缺失路径和删除后重建的根可以恢复。显式符号链接文件和目录根观察其目标，通知保留配置中的别名；递归发现仍排除未显式注册的符号链接、`.git` 和 `node_modules` 子树。

CI 兼容修复保留完整门禁，并使用新的验证目录和 runner 本地 Java 依赖缓存。Hosted workflow 故障检查分别验证实时消费与投递分类快照，digest 篡改探针按资源主键更新精确一行。Attestation 丢失注入覆盖既有有界只读 EOF 重试的两次尝试，同时保留恢复阻断断言。RocketMQ 下载有连接、传输和重试时限。已固定摘要的 5.5.1 优先使用公共 Apache 镜像，并回退到原两个 Apache 官方来源；解包前仍必须通过独立固定 SHA-512 校验，其他版本保留官方来源的摘要链。冷恢复 TUI 验证在原时限内等待原助手回答，再检查同一帧中的用户原文。分支也已同步上游 CI 历史处理和托管 macOS Intel 启动预算修复。 自托管浏览器检查现在会在 runner 用户自己的字体目录准备缺失的 DejaVu 字体数据，并以同一用户重新校验。准备过程使用私有 APT 索引和软件包解包，保持 runner 原有权限，不提权，也不执行 PR 中的宿主安装脚本。

提交 `be264d0c9f9f9662702f7c7a1a7c4d2a84311441` 修复一条假定 Git 返回固定顺序的 CI 测试。此前 Linux 记录为 117400 项通过、一项仅顺序不同的失败及 152 项跳过；三次尝试均完整返回原两条 worktree-prune 记录，但顺序相反。新断言仍严格要求相同的两条完整记录和精确总数，仅不约束顺序；生产行为、20 秒时限和测试选择均未变。原文件 48/48 通过，真实 Git 公告行的受控反序也通过原用例，十项缺失、额外、重复或错误对象负控均被拒绝。

提交 `1a8b2591` 同步上游 main `4dd7ac7`，用上游排序后精确匹配原两条记录的等价断言解决测试修复重叠。提交 `16a439b6` 修正缓存权限修复的适用范围：只有默认 `_tool` 候选目录进入原有规范路径和符号链接检查；其他配置缓存保留部署时的权限，继续原 Java 安装与测试。未新增权限，也未改变测试选择、覆盖守卫或时限。

提交 `16ef4bb269` 为两个单元测试 fixture 明确限定 Managed 数据库模板：当前分支保持原绑定，集成新版 main 后选择同名私有模板。SQL、事务字段、断言和测试筛选均未改变。

## 原因

Memory 等集成需要观察编辑器、shell 和外部进程的写入，包括工作目录之外的文件。本改动提供通用文件系统事件，初始对账和持久同步仍由集成负责。

## 评审验证

- 注册初始缺失的字面文件名，再创建、原子替换和删除；应收到文件通知，无关兄弟路径保持静默。
- 注册外部目录，新增嵌套文件，删除并重建根后再次写入；通知应持续。替换或清空动态注册时保留静态注册。
- 注册符号链接文件或目录，通过真实路径修改目标；hook 应收到配置的别名。多个别名各自通知，链接改指后刷新注册；隐式子链接保持静默。
- 改变工作目录，或轮换会话后重载 hook；只有当前归属会话收到通知，ACP/MCP 临时配置及托管、远程、沙箱会话保持禁用。
- runner 字体漂移时，应在其 XDG/HOME 目录准备 DejaVu 字体数据，再执行原字体校验；包获取或字体仍异常时必须停止门禁。健康 runner 不发起准备请求，PR 脚本不获得新增权限。

## 修前与修后证据

prs.title: fix(cli): accept explicitly named Local Control addresses outside RFC 1918/3927
prs.body:
## What this PR does

An explicitly passed `--local-control-address` is now treated as operator intent: Local Control accepts any non-internal, non-loopback IPv4 the host actually has — including addresses outside RFC 1918/3927 space (some enterprise intranets number their LANs from public ranges) and addresses on VPN/tunnel interfaces (phone and laptop on the same corporate VPN). Automatic advertisement stays RFC 1918/3927-only and untouched; the escape hatch opens only when the operator names the address, and out-of-private-space picks are logged with a loud warning on enable. The explicit pick is also resolved before the no-candidate failure, so a host with zero automatic candidates can still opt in.

## Why it's needed

On a host whose only non-loopback IPv4 is a public-range corporate-intranet address, Local Control was completely unusable: `qwen serve --local-control` exited with "No private IPv4 address is available", and `--local-control-address` could not help because it only disambiguated among candidates that had already passed the RFC 1918 filter. The same dead end hit hosts whose only usable address sits on a VPN/tunnel interface. Refuse-by-default remains the right posture for automatic advertising — the missing piece was a way for an operator to say "yes, this one, I mean it."

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a host whose address is outside RFC 1918/3927 (or on a VPN/tunnel interface), run `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <that-address>`. Expected: a WARNING that the address is outside private/link-local space, then the pairing QR/URL bound to that address; the LAN listener enforces the pairing token (401 without it, 200 with it). Naming an address the host does not have still fails with `unknown_lan_interface`; naming loopback still fails. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged: automatic selection stays RFC 1918/3927-only, and multiple candidates still surface the explicit-choice error. Unit tests cover the full selection matrix (public-range, tunnel interface, loopback, unknown address, ambiguity, no-candidate ordering).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (released 0.25.1, host's only address on a public-range corporate intranet):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control
qwen serve: No private IPv4 address is available. Local Control needs the host to be on a local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet).
(exit code 1)
```

After (this branch, same host):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <public-range-address> --port 4399
qwen serve: WARNING: Local Control address <public-range-address> is outside RFC 1918 private / RFC 3927 link-local space. It was accepted only because it was named explicitly — advertise it only on a network you trust.

Local Control is on. Scan this QR code from the same network:
en0: http://<public-range-address>:4399/#token=<pairing-token>
```

LAN listener auth boundary on that address: `GET /` → 200 (Web Shell), `GET /capabilities` → 401 without the pairing token, 200 with it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Dev CLI (`npm run dev`) on the affected host; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, ESLint, and Prettier all pass on the change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the explicit opt-in deliberately widens what `--local-control-address` accepts; automatic (no-flag) behavior is unchanged, and out-of-private-space picks always log a warning. Acceptance requires the address to exist on a live interface, so wildcards, multicast, and typos stay refused.
- Not validated / out of scope: adding CGNAT (100.64/10) to the default allowlist, and a Web Shell settings-card affordance for the opt-in — both deliberately deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14136

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

显式传入的 `--local-control-address` 现在被视为操作员意图：只要主机真实持有该地址，Local Control 就接受任意非 internal、非 loopback 的 IPv4——包括 RFC 1918/3927 范围之外的地址（一些企业内网用公网段给内网编号），以及 VPN/隧道接口上的地址（手机与电脑同挂一个企业 VPN 的场景）。自动 advertise 路径保持 RFC 1918/3927-only 不变；逃生舱只在操作员显式点名地址时开启，且超出私有段的选取会在 enable 时打出醒目警告。显式选取还先于"无候选"报错解析，因此一个没有任何自动候选的主机也能通过显式指定完成配对。

## 为什么需要

当主机唯一的非 loopback IPv4 是企业内网的公网段地址时，Local Control 完全不可用：`qwen serve --local-control` 直接以 "No private IPv4 address is available" 退出，而 `--local-control-address` 也帮不上忙——它此前只能在已通过 RFC 1918 过滤的候选里消歧。唯一可用地址在 VPN/隧道接口上的主机同样无路可走。对自动 advertise 保持默认拒绝仍是正确姿态，缺的是一条让操作员明确表达"就要这个"的通道。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在地址超出 RFC 1918/3927（或位于 VPN/隧道接口）的主机上运行 `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <该地址>`。预期：先打印地址超出私有段的 WARNING，然后输出绑定该地址的配对二维码/URL；LAN listener 强制 pairing token（无 token 401，有 token 200）。指定主机没有的地址仍以 `unknown_lan_interface` 失败；指定 loopback 仍然失败。不带该 flag 时行为不变：自动选取保持 RFC 1918/3927-only，多候选仍然报"需要显式选择"。单元测试覆盖完整选取矩阵（公网段、隧道接口、loopback、未知地址、歧义、无候选顺序）。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before（已发布 0.25.1，主机唯一地址在企业内网公网段）：`qwen serve --local-control` 以 exit 1 退出，报 "No private IPv4 address is available"。After（本分支，同主机）：WARNING 之后正常打印二维码与 URL，LAN listener 鉴权边界实测通过（无 token 401 / 有 token 200）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows / Linux ⚠️ 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：显式 opt-in 是有意放宽 `--local-control-address` 的接受范围；无 flag 的自动行为完全不变，超出私有段的选取必打警告。接受以"主机真实持有该地址"为前提，通配、组播、笔误依旧拒绝。
- 未覆盖/刻意排除：CGNAT（100.64/10）进默认白名单、Web Shell 设置卡片的 opt-in 入口——均有意延后。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): scope file changes to the session workspace
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Limits edited-file cards and their reviews to the session working directory and excludes Git-ignored untracked paths. Git-tracked files and non-ignored new files remain visible, including temporary scripts. Managed worktrees use their own execution directory and real parent session owner for virtual subagents. Main chat, split panes, subagent details and restored reviews apply the same policy.

The read-only workspace query is bounded, capability-gated and stays on the selected local or SSH runtime. Missing or failed Git classification falls back to directory containment and retries after connection recovery. Existing transcript and explicit artifact presentation is preserved.

## Why it's needed

Edits to global memory, other projects and ignored helper files currently inflate the file count and line totals. Users need the summary and review to describe the work relevant to the current workspace without guessing whether a filename means “temporary”.

### Summary evidence

Browser E2E uses the merged compiled Web Shell, simulated session metadata/transcript/SSE/bridge state, and the actual Git route with real temporary repositories, indexes, ignore rules and managed-worktree ownership files. No model-generated writes or full daemon authentication/permission middleware are claimed.

Card and review agree on three visible files and +5/-1: source, a tracked `.log`, and a non-ignored temporary script. Ignored helpers/cache and external paths are excluded.

![Workspace file card and review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f9a5ec02f348617c3d2f7ec657857d6f09624543/root-parent-review.png)

A virtual subagent opened in the main view uses its parent owner and managed cwd. Real HTTP 200 leaves one source file; a direct virtual-ID ownership request remains HTTP 400.

![Virtual managed session file card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f9a5ec02f348617c3d2f7ec657857d6f09624543/managed-virtual-fixed.png)

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- In one turn, edit a source file, a tracked file matching an ignore rule, a non-ignored temporary script, ignored helpers and an external file. The card and opened review should show only the first three, with matching file and line totals. An all-noise turn should show no file card.
- Open the same session in a split pane or a subagent detail, including a managed worktree. Confirm the execution directory determines containment and Git rules even when session details are hidden.
- Reload a saved review and reconnect after a failed classification. The review should preserve its original diff snapshots, recover visibility, and avoid showing unclassified files on a cold load. Non-Git directories and older/unavailable daemons retain contained edits.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: successful edit calls from external folders and ignored helper files contribute to cards and reviews. After: the screenshots above show only three relevant files, and the virtual managed entry shows only one. A separate noise-only browser case confirms no file card. Images were visually checked and live on an independent assets branch at a fixed commit.

Validation: full build, typecheck and bundle; 2,562 unit tests across Web Shell, CLI and SDK; the real-daemon capabilities integration case; two Playwright cases; four additional browser/Git fixture groups; changed-file ESLint and Prettier. The integration baseline also tolerates the runtime-mounted `channel_reload` tag, matching the existing treatment of other bootstrap/runtime differences.

CI follow-up: Git-ignore probes now require an explicit workspace environment; a missing runtime snapshot uses an empty environment. The original process-environment guard passes without a new exception. All 58 focused tests and the full build, typecheck and bundle passed; the browser evidence above was refreshed after this fix. Hosted CI is rerunning.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22, built CLI and Chromium. Browser fixtures use simulated session state with real qualified Git routes; SSH is covered by automated boundary tests, without a live SSH host.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: unknown Git status preserves contained edits, so ignored noise can remain during an outage. Path comparisons preserve case and do not resolve filesystem aliases. This is a cross-package daemon/SDK/UI change; no new dependency is added.
- Not validated / out of scope: full repository suite, Windows/Linux hosts, live SSH, and real model file writes. Frozen installation did not complete because registry metadata requests repeatedly failed; validation used the available dependency tree. Supply-chain checks were not disabled.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive capability and REST endpoint; older daemons use containment-only behavior. No migration required.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.zh-CN.md). Both versions are synchronized.

## Linked Issues

No linked issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

已编辑文件卡片及其评审只展示会话工作目录内的文件，并排除 Git 忽略且未跟踪的路径。已跟踪文件、未被忽略的新文件继续展示，包括临时脚本。受管 worktree 使用自己的执行目录，虚拟子代理使用真实父会话 owner。主聊天、分栏、子代理详情和恢复的评审统一使用该规则。

新增只读工作区查询有数量、时间和执行次数上限，按能力标记启用，仅在所属本地或 SSH runtime 执行。Git 分类缺失或失败时降级为按目录范围筛选，连接恢复后重试。完整转录和显式 artifact 展示保持原有行为。

## 为什么需要

全局记忆、其他项目和被忽略的辅助文件会增加当前文件数及增删行统计。卡片和评审应反映当前工作区相关工作，不根据文件名猜测“临时”用途。

### 摘要证据

浏览器 E2E 使用合并后的实际 Web Shell 构建产物，会话 metadata、转录、SSE 和 bridge 为模拟数据；Git 查询通过实际路由执行，使用真实临时仓库、索引、忽略规则及受管 worktree 所属文件。不代表模型实际写入文件，也未覆盖完整 daemon 认证/权限中间件。

上方主图中卡片和评审均为三个文件、+5/-1：源码、已跟踪 `.log` 和未忽略临时脚本。被忽略的辅助文件、缓存和外部路径均被排除。第二张图的虚拟子代理主入口使用父会话 owner/受管 cwd，真实 HTTP 200 后仅展示一个源码文件；直接携带虚拟 ID 的所属请求仍返回 HTTP 400。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 同一轮编辑源码、匹配 ignore 的已跟踪文件、未忽略临时脚本、被忽略辅助文件和外部文件。卡片和评审仅显示前三项，文件数及行数一致。全部为噪音时没有文件卡片。
- 在分栏和子代理详情打开同一会话，包含受管 worktree。即使隐藏会话详情，仍按执行目录筛选范围和 Git 规则。
- 重载已保存评审，并在分类失败后重连。评审保留原始 diff 快照并恢复可见性，冷加载不提前展示未分类文件。非 Git 目录、旧版或不可用 daemon 保留范围内编辑。

### 前后对比证据

改前，外部目录及被忽略文件的成功编辑会进入卡片和评审；改后，上图仅保留三个相关文件，虚拟受管入口仅保留一个。另有纯噪音浏览器用例确认无卡片。截图均已目视检查，放在独立素材分支，链接固定 commit。

验证通过：完整构建、类型检查和打包；Web Shell/CLI/SDK 共 2562 项单元测试；真实 daemon 能力集成用例；两项 Playwright 用例；四组额外浏览器/Git fixture；改动文件 ESLint 和 Prettier。集成基线同时按其他 bootstrap/runtime 差异的方式，容忍 runtime 挂载后的 `channel_reload` 动态标签。

CI 后续修复：Git 忽略查询必须显式传入所属工作区环境，缺失 runtime 快照时传空环境。原进程环境 guard 已通过，未新增白名单。58 项相关测试及完整构建、类型检查、打包通过；上方浏览器证据已基于本次修复更新。远程 CI 正在重跑。

### 测试平台

macOS 已测试；Windows 和 Linux 未测试。

### 环境

本地 Node 22、构建后的 CLI 和 Chromium。浏览器会话状态模拟，Git 路由为真实实现；SSH 通过自动边界测试覆盖，未连接真实 SSH 主机。

## 风险与范围

- Git 状态未知时保留范围内编辑，因此故障期间仍可能显示忽略噪音。路径比较保留大小写且不解析文件系统别名。本次跨 daemon、SDK、UI，未添加依赖。
- 未验证全仓库测试、Windows/Linux、真实 SSH 和模型写入。registry 元数据请求反复失败，冻结安装未完整完成；验证使用当前可用依赖，未关闭供应链校验。
- 能力和 REST 接口为增量扩展；旧 daemon 退化为仅按范围筛选，无迁移要求。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.zh-CN.md)，两版已同步。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

This PR pins the existing error-text redaction guarantee for hook telemetry with value-level assertions, so future properties carrying raw text fail loudly instead of slipping through green tests.

prs.title: test(permissions): cover persistent rule removal
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds five regression cases for removal of active persistent permission rules. The tests exercise the real permission manager with Agent calls, cover allow/ask/deny decisions after removal, preserve unrelated targets and session rules, and verify that an exact raw-string/type mismatch leaves the rule active.

## Why it's needed

Item 3 of #10235 tracks missing coverage for this deletion operation. The existing UI/ACP caller tests mock the manager, so they cannot detect a deletion that reports success while leaving the permission active. Removing the actual deletion action preserves the baseline suite's 555 passing cases; these new tests expose four additional failures under the same mutation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Verify that removing each active persistent rule changes the affected Agent permission decision to default while another target retains its original decision. Repeated or unmatched removal must return false. Removing persistent deny, ask, and allow rules in sequence must retain the other rule types until they are separately removed and must preserve a matching session allow rule. Temporarily suppressing the actual deletion should fail four new cases; treating an unmatched lookup as the first rule should also fail four new cases. Restore production code after either probe.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-facing change. Focused tests: 5 passed. Complete file before: 555 passed / 12 failed / 567 total; after: 560 passed / 12 failed / 572 total. The failure-name sets are identical; all 12 failures are Windows symlink EPERM from the baseline. With deletion suppressed, the final file has 556 passed / 16 failed, including four new failures. The independent test engineer reproduced the baseline and final counts. All temporary production mutations were restored. The initial root build passed at ad91df5. At the tested base 9e9d1c0, root typecheck passed; the root build log confirmed package completion through CLI, and the final VS Code build and settings-schema steps passed when rerun separately. The combined latest root-build exit code was not captured. Whole-repository format and lint:ci passed during preflight at ad91df5; changed-file ESLint, Prettier, and diff whitespace checks passed. The complete preflight was interrupted during build; workspace-wide test:ci and the serve fast-path bundle gate were not completed, so no overall preflight pass is claimed. Originally opened as a draft; now ready for review.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not tested |
| Windows | Focused tests passed; complete-file limitations recorded above |
| Linux | Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 24.19.0, npm 11.17.0, pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Unit tests against local source; no live model API call or CLI E2E acceptance is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: test-only coverage of the existing in-memory removal contract; no production changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: settings-file persistence, UI/ACP E2E flows, AUTO-stashed rules, and the other items in #10235.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #10235, item 3 only. The remaining items are intentionally left open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为有效的持久化权限规则移除操作补充五项回归测试。测试通过真实权限管理器和 Agent 调用上下文，检查移除后的 allow/ask/deny 判定，保留其他目标及会话规则，并验证原始规则字符串或规则类型不匹配时已有规则仍然有效。

## 为什么需要

#10235 第 3 项记录了该删除操作缺少覆盖。现有 UI/ACP 调用方测试 mock 了权限管理器，无法发现“返回删除成功但权限仍然有效”的回归。临时去掉真正的删除动作后，基线仍保留 555 项通过；新增测试在相同变异下额外发现四项失败。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

逐一移除有效持久化规则后，对应 Agent 权限应回到 default，另一个目标仍保持原判定。重复删除或未匹配删除应返回 false。依次移除持久化 deny、ask、allow 规则时，应保留尚未单独移除的其他规则类型，并保留匹配的会话 allow 规则。临时停用真正的删除动作应使四项新测试失败；把未匹配查找误当成第一条规则也应使四项新测试失败。每次探测后恢复生产代码。

Windows，Node.js 24.19.0、npm 11.17.0、仓库固定的 pnpm 11.24.0。单元测试直接使用本地源码；不声称执行了真实模型 API 调用或 CLI 端到端验收。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：只增加现有内存规则移除契约的测试覆盖，不修改生产代码。

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): narrow the four deferred store consumers to their role interfaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Completes the four deferred consumer migrations from the `AgentStateStore` role split (#15962). `ChildWorkspaceService`, `WorkspaceRuntimeResolver` and `ManagedAutomationService` now inject `SessionQueryStore` instead of the full composite, and `TaskCancelCoordinator` injects `SessionLifecycleStore`. Each consumer's calls were checked against the target role first: the three query consumers only call `requireSession` / `findSessionById` / `findSession`, and the cancel coordinator only calls `claimOperation`, `findOperation`, `findDeliverableTaskCancels`, `renewLifecycleOperation`, `retryOperation` and `settleTaskCancel` — all members of the respective role. The structure-review ledger's deferred-migration note is updated to record the completion, in both languages.

## Why it's needed

Interface segregation: a consumer should see only the role it actually uses, not every capability of the store. These four were single-role from the start but were left on the composite during #15962 because the automated pass-through detector misreads their `this(...)` constructor delegation as forwarding and could not narrow them safely by machine. Narrowing them by hand removes the last single-role consumers from the composite, so the remaining wide injections are genuinely multi-role (Harness and broker wiring), and the ledger no longer lists migrations that are in fact done.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Type-only change — no method body, behavior, SQL or wire format changes. Confirm each consumer's store calls are a subset of its new role, and that the focused build is green:

```
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -Dmaven.repo.local=<isolated> \
  -Dtest=ChildWorkspaceServiceTest,ManagedAutomationServiceTest,TaskCancelCoordinatorTest,ModuleArchitectureTest \
  -DfailIfNoTests=false test checkstyle:check
```

Local result (JDK 21.0.9, isolated task repository):

```
Tests run: 84, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
[INFO] You have 0 Checkstyle violations.
[INFO] BUILD SUCCESS   (all 7 modules)
```

`ChildWorkspaceServiceTest` boots a real Spring context (Flyway migration runs). A full-context `@SpringBootTest` (`ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest`, H2 in MySQL mode) boots every bean and passes 57 tests, so all four narrowed `@Autowired` role injections are proven to resolve in a real application context — not just a mock compile:

```
mvn -Dmaven.repo.local=<isolated> -Dtest=ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest -DfailIfNoTests=false test
# Started ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest ... Tests run: 57, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
```

Only `ManagedAgentStore` implements these roles (no second bean, no `@Bean` of a role type), so narrowing introduces no injection ambiguity. `ModuleArchitectureTest` (ArchUnit) keeps the module boundaries intact. `WorkspaceRuntimeResolver` calls `findSessionById` at two sites and is exercised by `WorkspaceRuntimeTest`, which constructs it in seven places; the role-membership check and the full-context boot cover the narrowing.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal injection types, no user-visible change.

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21.0.9, Maven 3.9.11, task-isolated local repository seeded from `~/.m2`. Focused unit + ArchUnit + Checkstyle; the full unit/H2 and MySQL/Hosted profiles remain CI-owned.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none functional — static injection types only. Spring resolves the same `ManagedAgentStore` bean through the role interface (it implements the composite, which extends every role); a full-context integration test boots all beans and confirms wiring, and `ManagedAgentStore` is the sole implementor so there is no ambiguity. Callers that pass an `AgentStateStore` still compile, since it is assignable to each role.
- Not validated / out of scope: the genuinely multi-role consumers keep the composite by design; the physical aggregate split of `ManagedAgentStore` is a separate future slice. Full CI suites are CI-owned.

prs.title: fix(verify-pr): post flaky demotions on closed PRs and pin the blank class
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Four small points raised after #16050 merged, in its stage-2 review and in the [verify-pr round](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16050#issuecomment-6554773872) on it, plus two from the [verify-pr round](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16135#issuecomment-6590919292) on this PR.

- **Flaky demotions post on a closed PR.** The closed-PR skip from #16050 also caught four bodies that carry a flaky demotion but no substantive marker: the flaky variants of the cancelled, job-failed-before-report and results-unavailable notices, and the report body of a round whose agent wrote no `report.md`. They render "❌ not passed — non-deterministic tests (flakiness gate)". On a merged PR that ❌ names tests now on `main`, so it is a finding, not noise. The skip now leaves `FLAKE_VERDICT=flaky` alone, except beside this run's own report when that report already carries the demotion. A flaky verdict writes a `verify-flaky` marker into the header, so the publisher can tell: a re-run attempt with no live status of its own posts its ❌ beside an earlier attempt's report that predates the verdict, instead of losing it to the run log.
- **The gates line no longer says "not counted above".** Since #16050 each suite run counts as one assertion, so the line now reads "Targeted gates (existing tests, not counted individually above)". The Chinese line becomes "不逐条计入上面的断言".
- **The checker's own tests pin the blank rule.** Before, reverting the checker to `trim()` passed `verify-pr-check.test.js` on its own; only the shared parity table in the workflow suite caught it. A checker test now refuses a whitespace-only suite and accepts `"\u0085"` and `"\ufeff"`.
- **One SKILL.md line rewrapped.** My edit in #16050 left the local-path sentence at 125 characters.
- **Re-run advice is scoped to an open PR.** Both variants of the results-unavailable notice ended with "re-run `@qwen-code /verify` for a fresh report". The verify lane runs only while the PR is open, and a merged PR is where the flaky variant now lands, so both say "while the PR is open" (zh: "PR 未关闭时").
- **The gate condition the exemption relies on is pinned.** The flaky exemption is safe only because the gate step runs on a prepared round the resolver chose to verify. A test now pins that step's `if:`, so loosening it fails beside the exemption it would break.

## Why it's needed

The flaky case is the one behavior change. The window is narrow, because a round that got as far as the flakiness gate has usually posted its live status, and that status is still PATCHed. But when it is hit, a ❌ about non-deterministic tests that just merged is exactly what should not be dropped.

The other three are wording, coverage and formatting.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js` and `scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js`. The nine test files that cover the workflow or the verify-pr scripts pass locally: 592 passed, 2 skipped.

- **Publisher on a closed PR:**
  - With no own comment and `FLAKE_VERDICT=flaky`, each of the three notice branches POSTs, and the body carries that branch's own ❌ flaky headline.
  - Beside this run's own report carrying the `verify-flaky` marker in its header, the flaky notice is still skipped. Beside one without it, or with the marker only below the header, it posts. With this attempt's own live status present, that status is PATCHed instead.
  - Without `report.md`, the report body is skipped, and with a flaky verdict it posts.
  - Each of the four notice kinds is still skipped with no gate verdict and with `FLAKE_VERDICT=pass`. The job-failed-before-report branch (`VERIFY_RESULT=failure`) is newly in that list; before, only cancelled, results unavailable and infrastructure failure were exercised.
  - Both results-unavailable variants, the flaky one posted and the plain one PATCHed into this run's live status, scope the re-run advice to an open PR, in both languages.
  - The gate step's `if:` is pinned in the same test.
- **Header:** every flaky body carries `verify-flaky` after the run marker (ahead of `verify-substantive` on a report), the report body without `report.md` included; no other body does.
- **Gates line:** the four pinned English lines and three Chinese lines carry the new wording.
- **Checker:** `" \t\n\r"` is refused; `"\u0085"` and `"\ufeff"` are accepted.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Mutation sweep.** 14 mutants were applied one at a time. Each was run against the test file aimed at it, and the tree was restored and compared after each.

| Mutant | Change | Killed by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | flaky exemption removed | upsert test (flaky case on a closed PR) |
| F2 | exemption compares against `flake` | upsert test (flaky case) |
| F3 | exemption inverted | upsert test (non-flaky closed cases) |
| F4 | any non-empty gate verdict exempt | upsert test (`FLAKE_VERDICT=pass` case) |
| F5 | "beside own report" clause removed | upsert test (flaky notice beside own report) |
| F6 | "beside own report" clause inverted | upsert test (flaky case) |
| W1 | English gates line reverted | gates-line test |
| W2 | Chinese gates line reverted | gates-line test |
| B1 | checker back to `trim()` | new checker blank-class test, alone |
| B2 | checker uses `\S` | new checker blank-class test, alone |
| B3 | checker treats only space as blank | new checker blank-class test, alone |
| B4 | checker treats U+0085 as blank | new checker blank-class test, alone |
| B5 | checker drops `\r` from the class | new checker blank-class test, alone |
| S1a–S1d | each re-run sentence (EN/ZH, flaky/plain) reverted | upsert test (re-run advice) |
| S2a | gate step's `if:` loses the prepare condition | upsert test (gate condition pin) |
| K1 | flaky marker never written | header test |
| K2 | flaky marker written on every verdict | header test |
| K3 | lookup's flaky field always false | upsert test (beside a flaky report) |
| K4 | guard back to "any own report" | upsert test (beside an earlier attempt's report) |
| K5 | flaky field parsed from the substantive field | upsert test (beside an earlier attempt's report) |
| K6 | flaky marker matched anywhere in the body | upsert test (marker below the header) |

24 of 24 killed, each at the assertion aimed at it. (Earlier revisions of this description said 14 and 19; those sweeps had 13 and 18 rows. I miscounted.) F4 is a gap an independent review found in the first draft, where no skipped case set a gate verdict. B1–B5 now fail `verify-pr-check.test.js` without the workflow suite.

**Publish step.** The script extracted from the YAML differs from `main` only in the two gates-line assignments, the four re-run sentences, the flaky marker (its write, its lookup field and the guard) and their comments. Shellcheck's findings on it are the same as on `main` (17 each). actionlint is clean.

**Real runners.** Each arm's `publish-verify` job was copied verbatim from its `qwen-triage.yml` into orphan probe branches on my fork. Two substitutions were made: `GH_TOKEN` became `github.token`, and the bot login became `github-actions[bot]`. The job ran behind a fake verify job with the real step order, outputs and upload name, on hosted `ubuntu-latest`, against three throwaway fork PRs (merged, closed unmerged, open). The oracle is what landed on those PRs. `main` is a6f1885833. The head column ran on the first revision of the marker fix (e27c390a84), whose publish job differs from the final head only in comments; the last row ran on the final head.

| Scenario (merged PR unless noted) | `main` | this PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| flaky, verify cancelled | nothing posted | ❌ "job cancelled before the report" |
| flaky, verify failed | nothing | ❌ "the job then failed before the report" |
| flaky, verify job timed out | nothing | ❌ "job cancelled before the report" |
| flaky, no artifact | nothing | ❌ "result artifact unavailable", "while the PR is open" |
| flaky, no `report.md` | nothing | ❌ report body |
| flaky, cancelled, closed unmerged PR | nothing | ❌ |
| `pass`, cancelled | nothing | nothing |
| flaky, own live status, cancelled | status PATCHed to ❌ | same |
| plain results unavailable, own live status | PATCHed, old re-run sentence | PATCHed, "while the PR is open" |
| flaky, open PR, no artifact | ❌ posted | ❌ posted |
| flaky report, then `publish-verify` re-run alone | report only | report only |
| `pass` report, then a full re-run turning `flaky`, its live status missing | report only: the ❌ is lost | ❌ posted beside the report |
| the same full re-run with its live status present | that status PATCHed to ❌ | same |

Platform facts measured on the way:
- `needs.verify.outputs` survive both a cancel and a job timeout: the publisher saw `FLAKE_VERDICT=flaky` in each.
- A job timeout reaches the publisher as `cancelled`, so its notice says "cancelled". That wording predates this PR.
- A single-job re-run's download looks for `…-<run>-2` and finds nothing.

The second-to-last row is what the previous revision listed as not handled. It reproduced on `main` and on that revision. The last row shows how narrow it is: a full re-run posts its own live status first, and that status takes the ❌.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

The publish job runs only on `ubuntu-latest`, and the checker runs there and on local rounds. macOS and Windows are covered by CI only.

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux worktree. The publish step was extracted from the YAML and run with a stubbed `gh`, as the meta-tests do. The real-runner table ran on hosted `ubuntu-latest` on my fork, 38 workflow runs plus 8 re-runs.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** the exemption keys on the gate's verdict, not on the rendered body. The bodies that would stay ⚠️ with `flaky` set are skipped, n/a and prepare failure, and none can follow a gate run: the gate step runs only after a successful prepare of a PR it decided to verify. The workflow already requires every terminal branch to demote on `flaky`, which is what this relies on, and the gate step's condition is now pinned by a test.
- **Closed is not merged.** The code checks `.state == closed`, so an unmerged closed PR also gets a flaky ❌ when the round has no comment of its own. That is the pre-#16050 behavior for that case, and rare.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - No real-model round was run. The skill change is a line wrap only.
  - Reports published before this change carry no `verify-flaky` marker. A later flaky attempt of such a run, with no live status of its own, would post a second ❌ beside it: a duplicate, not a loss. A re-run executes the run's original workflow file, so this cannot mix versions within one run.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. The workflow is 377057 bytes, 1947 over the recorded baseline of 375110 and within the 4096-byte allowance, so the baseline is not bumped.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #16050. Part of the `/verify-pr` improvement plan.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

#16050 合入后，它的 stage-2 评审和其上的 [verify-pr 轮次](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16050#issuecomment-6554773872) 提出了四个小点，本 PR 上的 [verify-pr 轮次](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16135#issuecomment-6590919292) 又提出两点，这里一并处理。

- **PR 已关闭时 flaky 降级通知照常发出。** #16050 加的"已关闭就不发"把四种带 flaky 降级、但不带 substantive 标记的正文也拦掉了：已取消、作业在报告前失败、结果不可用这三种通知的 flaky 变体，以及 agent 没写出 `report.md` 时的报告正文。它们显示"❌ 不通过 · 测试结果不确定（抖动门）"。PR 已合入时，这个 ❌ 指的是已经进了 `main` 的测试，是发现，不是噪音。现在跳过规则不管 `FLAKE_VERDICT=flaky`，只有一个例外：本轮自己的报告已经在 PR 上、且它本身带着这个降级。flaky 判定会在 header 里写一个 `verify-flaky` 标记，发布端据此判断：重跑的 attempt 如果没有自己的 live 状态，旁边的早先报告又早于这个判定，那么它的 ❌ 会发在那份报告旁边，而不是只留在运行日志里。
- **门禁行不再写"不计入上面的断言"。** #16050 之后每次套件运行都算一条断言，所以英文改为 "Targeted gates (existing tests, not counted individually above)"，中文改为"不逐条计入上面的断言"。
- **checker 自己的测试钉住判空规则。** 之前把 checker 改回 `trim()`，单跑 `verify-pr-check.test.js` 是全绿的，只有 workflow 套件里的共用表能抓到。现在 checker 测试里拒收纯空白套件名，接受 `"\u0085"` 和 `"\ufeff"`。
- **SKILL.md 一行重新换行。** 我在 #16050 的改动把本地路径那句留成了 125 字符。
- **重跑建议限定在 PR 未关闭时。** 结果不可用通知的两个变体都以"重新运行 `@qwen-code /verify`"结尾。verify 车道只在 PR 开着时运行，而 flaky 变体现在恰恰会落到已合入的 PR 上，所以两处都改成"PR 未关闭时"（英文 "while the PR is open"）。
- **钉住豁免所依赖的抖动门条件。** flaky 豁免之所以安全，是因为抖动门步骤只在 prepare 成功、且 resolver 决定要验证的轮次上运行。现在有测试钉住该步骤的 `if:`，放宽它会在它所支撑的豁免旁边直接失败。

## 为什么需要

flaky 这条是唯一的行为变化。触发窗口很窄：走到抖动门的轮次通常已经发出 live 状态，而 live 状态仍会被 PATCH 收尾。但一旦碰上，"刚合入的测试结果不确定"这条 ❌ 恰恰不该被丢掉。

另外三条是措辞、覆盖和格式。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js` 和 `scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js`。覆盖该工作流或 verify-pr 脚本的 9 个测试文件本地全部通过：592 个通过，2 个跳过。

- **PR 已关闭时的发布端：**
  - 没有本轮评论且 `FLAKE_VERDICT=flaky` 时，三个通知分支都会 POST，正文带该分支自己的 ❌ flaky 标题。
  - 本轮已有报告且其 header 带 `verify-flaky` 标记时，flaky 通知仍然跳过；报告不带该标记、或标记只出现在 header 以下时，照常发出；本 attempt 自己的 live 状态在时，PATCH 这条状态。
  - 没有 `report.md` 时报告正文被跳过，flaky 时则发出。
  - 没有抖动门判定、以及 `FLAKE_VERDICT=pass` 时，四种通知仍然被跳过。其中作业在报告前失败（`VERIFY_RESULT=failure`）这一支是新加进列表的，之前只覆盖了已取消、结果不可用和基础设施故障。
  - 结果不可用的两个变体（发出的 flaky 版本，以及 PATCH 进本轮 live 状态的普通版本），中英文都把重跑建议限定在 PR 未关闭时。
  - 同一个测试里钉住了抖动门步骤的 `if:`。
- **header：** 每个 flaky 正文都在 run 标记之后带 `verify-flaky`（报告里排在 `verify-substantive` 之前），没有 `report.md` 的报告正文也一样；其他正文都不带。
- **门禁行：** 测试里钉住的 4 行英文、3 行中文都换成了新措辞。
- **checker：** `" \t\n\r"` 拒收；`"\u0085"`、`"\ufeff"` 接受。

### 证据（前后对比）

**变异测试。** 逐个施加 24 个变异，每个都只跑针对它的测试文件，每次之后恢复并比对工作树。24 个全部被杀，且都死在针对它的那条断言上（明细见英文部分的表格）。本说明之前的版本写过 14 个和 19 个，实际那两轮分别是 13 个和 18 个，是我数错了。F4 是一次独立评审在初稿里发现的缺口：当时跳过的用例都没设抖动门判定。B1–B5 现在不靠 workflow 套件，单跑 `verify-pr-check.test.js` 就会失败。

**发布步骤。** 从 YAML 抽出的脚本与 `main` 相比，只有两处门禁行赋值、四句重跑建议、flaky 标记（写入、查找字段和守卫）及其注释不同。shellcheck 结果与 `main` 相同（各 17 条），actionlint 干净。

**真实 runner。** 把两个臂各自 `qwen-triage.yml` 里的 `publish-verify` job 原样拷到我 fork 上的孤儿 probe 分支，只做两处替换：`GH_TOKEN` 改成 `github.token`，bot 登录名改成 `github-actions[bot]`。前面接一个假 verify job，步骤顺序、outputs 和上传名都和真实的一致。在托管 `ubuntu-latest` 上，对三个一次性 fork PR（已合入、未合入关闭、开着）运行。判定依据是最终落到这些 PR 上的内容。`main` 是 a6f1885833。本 PR 一栏跑在标记修复的第一版（e27c390a84）上，它的 publish job 与最终 head 只有注释不同；最后一行跑在最终 head 上。

| 场景（未注明即已合入 PR） | `main` | 本 PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| flaky，verify 被取消 | 不发 | ❌"作业在报告前被取消" |
| flaky，verify 失败 | 不发 | ❌"作业随后在报告前失败" |
| flaky，verify job 超时 | 不发 | ❌"作业在报告前被取消" |
| flaky，没有 artifact | 不发 | ❌"结果产物不可用"，带"PR 未关闭时" |
| flaky，没有 `report.md` | 不发 | ❌ 报告正文 |
| flaky，取消，未合入就关闭的 PR | 不发 | ❌ |
| `pass`，取消 | 不发 | 不发 |
| flaky，已有本轮 live 状态，取消 | 状态被 PATCH 为 ❌ | 相同 |
| 普通版结果不可用，已有本轮 live 状态 | PATCH，旧的重跑措辞 | PATCH，"PR 未关闭时" |
| flaky，开着的 PR，没有 artifact | 发 ❌ | 发 ❌ |
| flaky 报告，之后单独重跑 `publish-verify` | 只有报告 | 只有报告 |
| `pass` 报告，之后整轮重跑变成 `flaky`，且没有 live 状态 | 只有报告：❌ 丢了 | ❌ 发在报告旁边 |
| 同样的整轮重跑，但有 live 状态 | 该状态被 PATCH 为 ❌ | 相同 |

顺带实测到的平台事实：
- `needs.verify.outputs` 在取消和 job 超时之后都还在：两种情况下发布端拿到的都是 `FLAKE_VERDICT=flaky`。
- job 超时传到发布端是 `cancelled`，所以通知写的是"被取消"。这个措辞是本 PR 之前就有的。
- 单 job 重跑时，下载找的是 `…-<run>-2`，找不到。

倒数第二行就是上一版正文里写着"不处理"的情况，它在 `main` 和上一版上都复现了。最后一行说明它的范围有多窄：整轮重跑会先发自己的 live 状态，❌ 会落在那条状态里。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

发布 job 只在 `ubuntu-latest` 上运行，checker 在那里和本地轮次中运行。macOS 和 Windows 只由 CI 覆盖。

### 环境（可选）

本地 Linux worktree。发布步骤从 YAML 中抽出，用桩 `gh` 运行，与元测试的做法相同。真实 runner 那张表在我 fork 的托管 `ubuntu-latest` 上运行，共 38 个 workflow run 加 8 次重跑。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍：** 豁免看的是抖动门的判定，而不是渲染出的正文。`flaky` 时仍会是 ⚠️ 的正文只有 skipped、n/a 和 prepare 失败，而这三种都不可能跟在抖动门后面：抖动门只在 prepare 成功、且决定要验证的 PR 上运行。workflow 已经要求每个终态分支在 `flaky` 时都降级，这里依赖的就是这条约定；抖动门步骤的条件现在也有测试钉住。
- **已关闭不等于已合入。** 代码检查的是 `.state == closed`，所以未合入就关闭的 PR，在本轮没有自己评论时也会收到 flaky ❌。这和 #16050 之前在这种情况下的行为一样，而且很少见。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：**
  - 没有跑真实模型轮次。skill 的改动只是换行。
  - 本改动之前发布的报告没有 `verify-flaky` 标记。这样一个 run 之后的 flaky attempt，如果没有自己的 live 状态，会在旁边再发一条 ❌：是重复，不是丢失。重跑执行的是该 run 原来的 workflow 文件，所以同一个 run 内不会混用新旧版本。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。工作流现为 377057 字节，比记录的基线 375110 多 1947 字节，在 4096 字节额度内，不调基线。

## 关联 Issue

#16050 的 follow-up。属于 `/verify-pr` 改进计划。

</details>

prs.title: feat(config): add operator model catalog refresh switch
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds an operator-scoped `model.catalogRefresh` setting so managed installations can stop the daily models.dev catalog download from system settings instead of relying on environment variables in every launch path.

It also makes `privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled: false` stop the background catalog refresh. The existing `QWEN_CODE_MODELS_DEV_REFRESH=off` environment gate still wins, and the bundled or previously downloaded catalog remains available for local model metadata.

## Why it's needed

The catalog refresh is the remaining automatic third-party request that cannot be disabled from system settings. Managed installations often cannot guarantee the process environment across terminal, desktop, and service launch paths. A workspace value must not decide this behavior because the downloaded catalog is shared globally, so the new setting is honored only from User, System, and SystemDefaults scopes and is preserved in bare mode.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Put `"model": {"catalogRefresh": false}` in a User or System settings file and start a new session. Confirm no `https://models.dev/api.json` request is made while model metadata still loads from the bundled or existing cache.
2. Put the same key in Workspace settings and confirm startup warns that it is ignored, while the operator value or default behavior remains in effect.
3. Set `privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled` to `false` with refresh otherwise enabled and confirm the refresh is skipped.
4. Set `QWEN_CODE_MODELS_DEV_REFRESH=off` with `model.catalogRefresh: true` and confirm the environment variable still suppresses the request.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A. This changes startup configuration and outbound network behavior without a new UI surface. Narrow unit tests were added for schema metadata, workspace restriction, bare-mode resolution, CLI propagation, privacy gating, and core refresh gating; they were not run locally under the current no-local-test instruction.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

No local test, build, typecheck, lint, or dependency install was run. Validation is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Operators may have treated the usage-statistics flag as telemetry-only. Its expanded behavior is documented explicitly, while the dedicated `model.catalogRefresh` setting remains the precise control.
- Not validated / out of scope: No local runtime test or real network observation was performed. This changes catalog download behavior, not catalog lookup, cache selection, or `QWEN_CODE_MODELS_DEV=off`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None required. The setting defaults to enabled, so existing installations keep refreshing unless they opt out.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-01-model-catalog-refresh-setting.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-01-model-catalog-refresh-setting.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16006

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 增加运维作用域的 `model.catalogRefresh` 设置，使托管安装可以直接从系统设置停止每日 models.dev 模型目录下载，不必依赖每条启动路径都注入环境变量。

同时，`privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled: false` 会停止该后台目录刷新。原有 `QWEN_CODE_MODELS_DEV_REFRESH=off` 环境变量门禁仍然优先；内置或此前下载的目录继续用于本地模型元数据。

## 为什么需要

目录刷新是最后一个无法通过系统设置关闭的自动第三方请求。托管安装通常无法保证终端、桌面端和服务端启动环境一致。由于下载的目录会全局共享，工作区配置不能决定该行为，因此新设置只从 User、System 和 SystemDefaults 作用域读取，并在 bare 模式下保留。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 User 或 System 设置文件中写入 `"model": {"catalogRefresh": false}` 后启动新会话。确认不会请求 `https://models.dev/api.json`，同时仍可从内置或已有缓存加载模型元数据。
2. 将同一键写入 Workspace 设置，确认启动时提示该值被忽略，实际仍使用运维值或默认行为。
3. 在刷新仍开启时设置 `privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled` 为 `false`，确认刷新被跳过。
4. 在 `model.catalogRefresh: true` 时设置 `QWEN_CODE_MODELS_DEV_REFRESH=off`，确认环境变量仍然阻止请求。

### 证据（修改前后）

不适用。该改动影响启动配置和外发网络行为，没有新增 UI 表面。已补窄范围单元测试，覆盖 schema 元数据、工作区限制、bare 模式解析、CLI 透传、隐私门禁和 core 刷新门禁；按照当前不跑本地测试的要求，本次未在本地执行。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

本次未运行本地测试、构建、类型检查、lint，也未安装依赖；相关验证交由 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：运维者可能原先把使用统计开关理解为只影响遥测。该扩展行为已在文档中明确，同时保留专用 `model.catalogRefresh` 作为精确控制。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：未做本地运行时测试，也未观察真实网络请求。本改动只影响目录下载，不改变目录查找、缓存选择或 `QWEN_CODE_MODELS_DEV=off`。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无需迁移。设置默认开启，现有安装继续刷新，除非主动退出。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-01-model-catalog-refresh-setting.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-01-model-catalog-refresh-setting.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16006
