prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): simplify row locking and runtime verification
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #16090, merged as `d9d6fc4a4b8e654d405dbb1d01bf3404e6435a1c`, targeting `main` at `73474ef094ea1c6bb2a95a9a2a33a28b0ec58e9e`. The CSI replay contract separately verifies one journal head, one activation-authority head and two checkpoint identity reads; all four remain ordered after the root in one transaction.

Consolidates seven adjacent Session/Turn locking reads while preserving their SQL and validation order. Journal operations reuse a root lock only after CSI checks on the same datasource's transactional connection with autocommit disabled, and reuse an unchanged CSI head within one commit. Standalone calls and the two independent owner-read transactions retain their boundaries. Replaces the custom Java call-graph lock checker with an exact entry/transaction inventory, executed JDBC traces, and MySQL scenarios, including sibling stores and deliberately incorrect locking sequences.

The proposed UPDATE-first conversions for cancellation before admission and ordinary/recovery-blocked failure settlement are intentionally not applied. MySQL characterization demonstrates that they would change owner decisions under an existing REPEATABLE READ snapshot; their original reads and behavior remain intact.

## Why it's needed

Repeated root acquisition obscures the lock contract and adds queries. The selected ordinary journal operations reduce root locking reads from two to one, while the seven Agent pairs retain the same SQL sequence and existing single-row CAS paths retain their lock scope. Replacement verification code and inventories total 1,647 lines versus the original checker's 3,281 lines, including the 633 lines of registry data.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Confirm the optimization preserves errors, missing-row priority, replay receipts, writer fencing, transaction boundaries, and after-commit notifications. Verify query reduction separately from concurrency correctness.

### How to verify

1. Exercise successful, refused, empty-batch, missing-Session/Turn/stream, replay, rollback, and standalone calls through the real Spring proxies. The traces must enforce Session root → event stream → Turn and root-before-head for the same Session, connection, and transaction, and reject missing/reversed locks, another Session or connection, and early commit.
2. On MySQL 8.4, confirm old-snapshot owner refusals remain unchanged, competing workers cannot settle another owner's work, unrelated Sessions do not acquire new tenant-level waits, and publication/fencing races retain their existing outcomes. Inspect target root/head counts without conflating the preserved CSI authority probes.
3. Complete the full Maven, MySQL, native CSI, and Hosted/fault CI gates on the revision proposed for acceptance.

Local evidence includes 67 selected MySQL cases, 153 focused H2/MySQL cases, 46 subsequent transaction-boundary cases, and 15 final recorder cases. These runs overlap and must not be summed as unique tests. All selected test cases passed; the 153-case and 46-case commands subsequently failed Checkstyle on new test formatting, which was fixed. The final recorder run and reactor-wide Checkstyle passed. Baseline comparison runs also passed. No unchanged Java checks were rerun solely to create this commit.

The native producer CI case at `c6d83e08` exposed a test-classification error: a required CSI replay authority query shared the full head projection and was miscounted as a second optimized journal read. The classifier now matches the journal reader's fixed predicate shape; replay separately requires one journal head, one activation-authority head and two checkpoint identity reads while retaining all lock-order and transaction checks. A further 42 focused cases and reactor Checkstyle passed. Producer-backed verification on the corrected revision remains pending CI.

The next CI run at `d16d1b01` exposed a mistake in the added total-head assertion: the four actual accesses include two partial checkpoint reads. The test now pins journal → checkpoint → activation authority → checkpoint, preserving the original root and transaction assertions. The extended 16 recorder cases and reactor Checkstyle passed locally. The corrected producer-backed case remains pending CI; no production SQL was removed or changed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal persistence and verification refactor; no UI changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested (focused checks) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, JDK 21.0.8, Maven 3.9.14, a task-isolated Maven repository, and an owned loopback MySQL 8.4.11 instance with disposable test databases, `max_allowed_packet=134217728`, and binary logging disabled. The Linux native-AIO flag was not used on macOS. Local Java validation consumed 590.38/600 seconds, including setup, failed attempts, and cleanup; the owned MySQL instance was stopped and its data removed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: runtime scenarios cannot prove unexecuted branches. The exact-signature and SQL-owner inventories detect unclassified entries or protected SQL changes, but changed success, rejection, replay, and special branches still require executable coverage. Lock reuse must remain inside the same datasource transaction.
- Not validated / out of scope: full Maven `verify`, SpotBugs, the complete MySQL profile, producer-backed successful native CSI commit/replay, Hosted/fault consumers, and Linux/Windows. Local Core/CLI build artifacts were absent, so real-process cases remain pending rather than counted as passes. No CI coverage gate is weakened.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API, schema, transaction-manager, propagation, isolation, error-code, replay, or fencing-contract changes; no migration or deployment. The two non-equivalent CAS candidates keep their original implementations.

The complete synchronized design and validation record is available in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/bc6d54a925de953106d4f6f89b0220459d55d6c5/docs/design/2026-11-02-managed-agent-lock-simplification.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/bc6d54a925de953106d4f6f89b0220459d55d6c5/docs/design/2026-11-02-managed-agent-lock-simplification.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follows #16090 (merged). No issue is closed by this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

这是 #16090 的后续 PR，该依赖已以 `d9d6fc4a4b8e654d405dbb1d01bf3404e6435a1c` 合并，以 `main` 的 `73474ef094ea1c6bb2a95a9a2a33a28b0ec58e9e` 为基线。CSI replay 契约分别验证一次 journal head、一次 activation authority head 和两次 checkpoint 身份读取；四次访问仍在同一事务内位于 root 锁之后。

收拢七处相邻的 Session/Turn 锁定读取，保持原 SQL 和校验顺序。journal 仅在 CSI 检查已通过、同一数据源的事务连接且 autocommit 关闭时复用 root 锁，并在同一次 commit 内复用尚未修改的 CSI head。standalone 调用及 owner read 的两个独立事务保持原边界。以完整入口/事务清单、实际 JDBC 执行轨迹和 MySQL 场景替换自制 Java 调用图锁检查器，覆盖兄弟 Store 和受控错误锁序。

未应用两个候选的 UPDATE-first 转换，即 admission 前取消和普通/recovery-blocked 失败结算。MySQL 特征测试证明，它们会改变既有 REPEATABLE READ 快照下的 owner 判断，因此保留原读取和行为。

## 为什么需要

重复获取 root 使锁契约难以辨认，也增加查询。选定的普通 journal 路径将 root 锁定读取由两次降为一次，七处 Agent 成对读取保持原 SQL 序列，已有单行 CAS 路径保持原锁范围。替代验证代码与清单合计 1,647 行，原检查器为 3,281 行；该统计包含 633 行登记数据。

## 审阅者测试计划

确认优化保持错误、缺行判断优先级、幂等回执、writer fencing、事务边界及提交后通知。查询减少与并发正确性分别验收。

### 如何验证

1. 通过真实 Spring 代理执行成功、拒绝、空批次、缺失 Session/Turn/stream、重放、回滚和 standalone 调用。轨迹应要求同一 Session、连接和事务内按 Session root → event stream → Turn 以及 root 在 head 之前加锁，并拒绝漏锁、反序、其他 Session 或连接及提前提交。
2. 在 MySQL 8.4 上确认旧快照下的 owner 拒绝保持不变，竞争 worker 无法结算其他 owner 的工作，不同 Session 不新增租户级等待，publication/fencing 竞争保持原结果。检查目标 root/head 次数时，区分保留的 CSI authority 探测。
3. 在待验收修订上完成完整 Maven、MySQL、native CSI 及 Hosted/fault CI 门禁。

本地证据包括 67 个选定 MySQL 用例、153 个 H2/MySQL 聚焦用例、后续 46 个事务边界用例，以及最终 15 个记录器用例。各轮存在重叠，不能相加作为独立测试数量。选定测试用例均通过；153 和 46 用例的命令随后因新增测试格式未通过 Checkstyle，已修正。最终记录器运行和全 reactor Checkstyle 通过，基线对照运行也通过。未仅因创建本次提交而重复执行未变化的 Java 检查。

真实 producer 的 CI 用例在 `c6d83e08` 暴露了测试分类错误：必须保留的 CSI replay authority 查询使用相同的完整 head 投影，被误计为第二次优化 journal 读取。分类器现匹配 journal 读取器固定的谓词形式；replay 分别要求一次 journal head、一次 activation authority head 和两次 checkpoint 身份读取，同时保留全部锁序及事务检查。后续 42 个聚焦用例和全 reactor Checkstyle 通过，修正版本的真实 producer 验证仍待 CI。

下一轮 CI 在 `d16d1b01` 暴露了新增 head 总数断言的错误：实际四次访问包含两次部分投影的 checkpoint 读取。测试现固定 journal → checkpoint → activation authority → checkpoint 顺序，保留原有 root 及事务断言。扩展后的 16 个记录器用例与全 reactor Checkstyle 本地通过，修正版本的真实 producer 用例仍待 CI；未删除或修改生产 SQL。

### 证据（变更前后）

N/A — persistence 内部和验证体系重构，无 UI 改动。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :------: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试（聚焦检查） |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、JDK 21.0.8、Maven 3.9.14、任务隔离 Maven 仓库，以及本任务拥有的 loopback MySQL 8.4.11 实例和可丢弃测试库，设置 `max_allowed_packet=134217728` 并关闭 binary logging。macOS 未使用 Linux 的 native-AIO 参数。本地 Java 验证耗时 590.38/600 秒，包含准备、失败尝试和清理；任务 MySQL 实例已停止，数据已移除。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：运行时场景无法证明未执行分支。完整签名与 SQL 所属文件清单可发现未分类入口或受保护 SQL 的变化，但变更涉及的成功、拒绝、重放和特殊分支仍需可执行覆盖。锁复用必须限制在同一数据源事务内。
- 未验证或范围外：完整 Maven `verify`、SpotBugs、完整 MySQL profile、真实 producer 的 native CSI 成功提交/重放、Hosted/fault 消费者及 Linux/Windows。本地缺少 Core/CLI 构建产物，因此真实进程场景仍待验证，未记作通过。没有削弱任何 CI 覆盖门禁。
- 不兼容变化或迁移说明：公共 API、schema、事务管理器、传播、隔离级别、错误码、幂等重放和 fencing 契约均不变；无迁移或部署。两个不等价的 CAS 候选保留原实现。

完整且同步的设计与验证记录见[英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/bc6d54a925de953106d4f6f89b0220459d55d6c5/docs/design/2026-11-02-managed-agent-lock-simplification.md)及[中文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/bc6d54a925de953106d4f6f89b0220459d55d6c5/docs/design/2026-11-02-managed-agent-lock-simplification.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): bind config sync to the attachment, not the SSE stream
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A session's config-ordering domain is now established when the session becomes the current attachment, instead of being recreated later when the event stream is opened. Because the attachment is deliberately published before its metadata fetches settle, a config write issued by the first prompt could previously be in flight when that recreation happened; the recreation invalidated the write's ownership token, so a value the daemon had already confirmed was silently discarded and the reconciliation that would have restored it was skipped along with it. Establishing the domain once per attachment removes that window without changing when the attachment is published, so the early transcript paint and first-prompt latency are untouched. Every staleness guard is left exactly as it was.

The live-daemon settings inclusion/exclusion coverage is also split from one long test into one test per scenario, sharing a single daemon for the file. Each scenario now owns a full timeout budget and a failure names the scenario instead of reporting a bare timeout somewhere inside a twelve-navigation loop.

## Why it's needed

The browser smoke lane has been failing on runs whose diff contains no browser code, blocking unrelated pull requests whose authors cannot retrigger the checks. The visible symptom is that a reasoning effort chosen before the first prompt is lost when the session is created: the model chip keeps advertising the pre-choice value indefinitely rather than correcting itself.

This is not a timeout and not a request-ordering violation. In the failing run's own network trace the daemon receives and confirms the write, both configuration reads happen before it, no configuration read happens after it, and the client logs no warning — the confirmed value is dropped locally and never read back. The ordering machinery involved was introduced by the Workflow mode controls change, which is the upper bound of the main-branch window the report names, so this is a main-branch regression rather than anything the blocked pull requests did. Only one scenario forces a delayed providers response, which is why only that scenario widens the window enough to fail repeatedly.

The settings coverage was failing for an unrelated reason: six scenarios across two scopes, four full-page screenshots and a real daemon spawn all shared one sixty-second budget, and under runner contention the whole flow slowed until the budget ran out.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the two named browser scenarios on this branch and on its base, with retries enabled so the comparison matches CI semantics:

```
cd packages/web-shell
CI=1 npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts -g "live daemon settings honor host inclusion and exclusion lists|previews qwen3.8-max reasoning before lazy session creation" --workers=2
```

On the base, the lazy-session reasoning scenario fails at the model-chip assertion — expected `qwen3.8-max · Medium`, received `qwen3.8-max · Thinking Off` — identically on all three attempts, while the request-ordering assertions before it pass. Locally it failed 8 of 9 attempts without any added load. On this branch it passes, including the later assertion that the choice survives starting a new session.

To see the mechanism directly, capture a trace of the failing run and look at the request order: the delayed providers response lands shortly before the confirmed configuration write, and no configuration read follows that write. With the fix, a reconciliation read does follow it whenever the write's own application was superseded.

The settings scenarios are worth running under CPU contention, since that is how they failed in CI. With sixteen busy loops on a 32-core host the unsplit test timed out on two of three attempts; split, all six pass and the slowest scenario uses 22.1 s of its own 60 s budget.

One existing unit test changes its expectations, deliberately and in the strengthening direction. It asserted that the current mode was `undefined` *after* an approval-mode write had been confirmed by the daemon — which held only because the same mid-write recreation discarded that confirmed value. Its mock now reports the confirmed mode on later reads, as a real daemon would, and the assertion requires the confirmed value to survive both the stale snapshot and the reconciliation. The expected read count rises by one, accounting for the reconciliation that is no longer suppressed. The other three parameterisations of that test are unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before — the reasoning choice made before the first prompt is lost; the chip stays on the pre-choice value:

![Before: model chip reads Thinking Off after the session was created with Medium](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/issue-16065-config-sync/01-before-thinking-off.png)

After — the confirmed choice survives session creation:

![After: model chip reads Medium after the session was created](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/issue-16065-config-sync/02-after-medium.png)

Browser scenarios on this branch, final base: **7 passed (57.1 s)**, no retries. The lazy-session reasoning scenario repeated three times: **3 passed (59.3 s)**, no retries, and once more with retries disabled: **1 passed (27.6 s)**. With the fix reverted on the same base, that scenario failed its first attempt with the exact CI signature — the before screenshot above is that attempt — and passed on a later retry, i.e. flaky, which is what a timing race looks like; the dedicated reproduction round measured 8 of 9 attempts failing. The six split settings scenarios under sixteen-way CPU contention: **6 passed (1.3 m)**, no flakes, every one a first-attempt pass, per-scenario durations 22.1 / 8.7 / 10.0 / 8.9 / 10.0 / 10.0 s against a 60 s budget each.

Session unit suites: **1263 passed, 3 failed**; those three fail identically on the pristine base and are environmental to this host (Node 24 versus CI's 22). The package typecheck error list is **byte-identical** between the pristine base and this branch — 58 pre-existing errors from a stale installed SDK build, zero new. The new regression test was mutation-checked: it passes with the fix and fails without it. Formatting and lint are clean on every touched file.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Vite dev server plus Playwright 1.61.1 / Chromium 1228 on Alibaba Cloud Linux 3, Node 24, 32 cores. The live-daemon scenarios use the compiled CLI entry point. Unit runs were capped at three workers because this host has no swap.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the config-ordering domain is shared by every configuration action, so moving when it is established changes when in-flight reads are invalidated for all of them. Reads issued between the attachment bind and the stream opening now survive into the new stream instead of being discarded; they remain guarded by the read sequence and generation counters, and the load's own snapshot capture still post-dates the bind, so a stale snapshot still cannot publish. One traced flip in the other direction — a write captured during a reconnect availability gap and confirmed after the next bind — is now invalidated at that bind, and self-heals because the replay-complete signal triggers a fresh configuration read that includes the confirmed value. The exposure is a transient display during a disconnect, not a lost write.
- Not validated / out of scope: the load-dependent CI lane itself can only be confirmed by a run on hosted runners; local contention is an approximation. A third scenario listed as flaky in the report matrix has a different signature, passed on retry, and is untouched. Everything runs against the mock daemon, so this validates client state handling rather than real provider behaviour. The repository's automated review raised three Suggestions on the first round: two are fixed and one is declined with mutation evidence, each answered in its own thread (see the round-2 summary). A separate bounded adversarial review of the four risk areas above found no Critical. Round 2 (`cf773a3b8f`) changes tests and documentation only — the production fix is byte-identical to the round the evidence above was measured on, and both named browser scenarios were re-run after the fixture swap: 7 passed (52.7 s), no retries.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No public API, protocol field, or setting changes.

Design document: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/issue-16065-config-sync-attachment-lifetime/docs/design/2026-11-02-web-shell-config-sync-attachment-lifetime.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/issue-16065-config-sync-attachment-lifetime/docs/design/2026-11-02-web-shell-config-sync-attachment-lifetime.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16065

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

会话的配置排序域现在在「会话成为当前附件」时建立，而不是延后到「事件流打开」时再重建。由于附件是有意在其元数据请求落定之前就发布的，首条 prompt 发出的配置写入可能正好在那次重建发生时仍在途；重建会让该写入的所有权令牌失效，于是 daemon 已经确认的值被静默丢弃，而本可以把它读回来的那次 reconcile 也一并被跳过。改为每个附件只建立一次域，就消除了这个窗口，同时不改变附件的发布时机，因此提前绘制 transcript 与首 prompt 延迟都不受影响。所有陈旧性守卫原样保留。

真实 daemon 的设置包含/排除覆盖也从一条长测试拆成每个场景一条测试，整个文件共享一个 daemon。每个场景现在独享完整的超时预算，失败时能点名到具体场景，而不是在十二次导航的循环中某处报一个裸超时。

## 为什么需要

浏览器 smoke lane 一直在那些 diff 不含任何浏览器代码的运行上失败，阻塞了无关的 PR，而这些 PR 的作者无权重跑检查。可见症状是：首条 prompt 之前选择的 reasoning effort 在会话创建时丢失，模型 chip 会一直显示选择之前的值，而不会自我纠正。

这不是超时，也不是请求顺序违约。在失败运行自己的网络 trace 里，daemon 收到并确认了写入，两次配置读都发生在它之前，它之后没有任何配置读，客户端也没有打印任何警告——已确认的值是在本地被丢弃、且再也没被读回。涉及的排序机制由 Workflow mode 控件那次改动引入，正是报告所指 main 变更窗口的上界，因此这是 main 分支回归，而不是那些被阻塞的 PR 造成的。只有一个场景强制了延迟的 providers 响应，这也解释了为什么只有它把窗口撑大到反复失败。

设置覆盖的失败原因则互不相关：六个场景 × 两个 scope、四张整页截图、外加一次真实 daemon spawn，全部共用一个六十秒预算；在 runner 争用下整条流程变慢，直到预算耗尽。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在本分支与其 base 上分别运行这两个指名的浏览器场景，并开启重试以对齐 CI 语义：

```
cd packages/web-shell
CI=1 npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts -g "live daemon settings honor host inclusion and exclusion lists|previews qwen3.8-max reasoning before lazy session creation" --workers=2
```

在 base 上，lazy-session reasoning 场景会在模型 chip 断言处失败——期望 `qwen3.8-max · Medium`，实际 `qwen3.8-max · Thinking Off`——三次尝试签名完全一致，而它之前的请求顺序断言都通过。本地不加压时 9 个 attempt 失败了 8 个。在本分支上它通过，包括后面那条「新建会话后选择仍然保留」的断言。

想直接看到机制，可以抓一次失败运行的 trace 看请求顺序：延迟的 providers 响应落在已确认配置写入之前不久，而该写入之后没有任何配置读。修复后，只要写入自身的应用被取代，就会有一次 reconcile 读跟在它后面。

设置场景值得在 CPU 争用下跑，因为它们在 CI 上就是这样失败的。在 32 核宿主上起十六个忙循环时，未拆分的测试三次尝试有两次超时；拆分后六个全部通过，最慢的场景用掉自己 60 秒预算中的 22.1 秒。

有一条既有单测的期望值被有意改动，且方向是变强。它原本断言在 approval-mode 写入**已被 daemon 确认之后**当前模式为 `undefined`——而这之所以成立，只是因为同一次写入中途的域重建把那个已确认值丢弃了。现在它的 mock 会像真实 daemon 一样在后续读取中报告已确认的模式，断言则要求已确认值同时挺过陈旧快照与 reconcile。期望的读取次数增加一次，对应不再被误杀的那次 reconcile。该测试另外三个参数组合保持不变。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前——首条 prompt 之前做出的 reasoning 选择丢失，chip 停在选择前的值：

![改动前：会话以 Medium 创建后模型 chip 仍显示 Thinking Off](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/issue-16065-config-sync/01-before-thinking-off.png)

改动后——已确认的选择在会话创建后保留：

![改动后：会话创建后模型 chip 显示 Medium](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/issue-16065-config-sync/02-after-medium.png)

本分支、最终 base 上的浏览器场景：**7 passed（57.1 秒）**，无重试。lazy-session reasoning 场景重复三次：**3 passed（59.3 秒）**，无重试；另跑一次关闭重试（`--retries=0`，确保通过不是重试而来）：**1 passed（27.6 秒）**。在同一 base 上仅撤销产品修复后，该场景首次 attempt 即以与 CI 完全相同的签名失败——上方「改动前」截图正是该次 attempt——随后在一次重试中通过，即 flaky；这正是时序竞态应有的形态，因此专门的复现轮次测得的「9 个 attempt 失败 8 个」比任何单轮都更能代表基线失败率。六个拆分后的设置场景在十六路 CPU 争用下：**6 passed（1.3 分钟）**，无 flaky，且全部为首次 attempt 通过，各场景耗时 22.1 / 8.7 / 10.0 / 8.9 / 10.0 / 10.0 秒，各自预算 60 秒。

会话单测套件：**1263 通过，3 失败**；这三条在纯净 base 上以完全相同的方式失败，属本机环境问题（Node 24 对 CI 的 22）。包级 typecheck 的错误清单在纯净 base 与本分支之间**逐字节相同**——58 条既有错误来自本机安装的 SDK 构建过旧，零新增。新回归测试做过变异校验：有修复时通过、无修复时失败。所有改动文件的格式与 lint 均干净。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Vite dev server 加 Playwright 1.61.1 / Chromium 1228，Alibaba Cloud Linux 3，Node 24，32 核。真实 daemon 场景使用已编译的 CLI 入口。单测限制为三个 worker，因为本机没有 swap。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与权衡：配置排序域被所有配置动作共享，因此移动它的建立时机会改变所有这些动作的在途读何时失效。在附件绑定与流打开之间发出的读，现在会存活进入新流而不再被丢弃；它们仍受读序号与 generation 计数器守卫，且 load 自己的快照捕获仍晚于绑定，所以陈旧快照依旧无法发布。唯一一条被追踪到的、方向相反的翻转是：在重连可用性间隙捕获、并在下一次绑定之后才确认的写入，现在会在该绑定处被作废，但它会自愈——replay-complete 信号会触发一次新的配置读，其中包含那个已确认值。暴露面是断连期间的一次瞬态显示，而不是写入丢失。
- 未验证 / 范围外：与负载相关的 CI lane 本身只能由 hosted runner 上的运行确认，本地争用只是近似。报告矩阵中列为 flaky 的第三个场景签名不同、重试即通过，未作改动。全部运行都基于 mock daemon，因此验证的是客户端状态处理，而非真实 provider 行为。仓库的自动评审在第一轮提出三条 Suggestion：两条已修，一条附变异证据保留，均已在各自线程回复（见第 2 轮汇总）。另一次针对上述四个风险点的有界对抗评审未发现 Critical。第 2 轮（`cf773a3b8f`）只改动测试与文档——生产修复与上述证据所测的那一轮逐字节相同；换 fixture 后两个指名浏览器场景已重跑：7 passed（52.7 秒），无重试。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。不涉及公共 API、协议字段或设置项变更。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/issue-16065-config-sync-attachment-lifetime/docs/design/2026-11-02-web-shell-config-sync-attachment-lifetime.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/issue-16065-config-sync-attachment-lifetime/docs/design/2026-11-02-web-shell-config-sync-attachment-lifetime.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16065

</details>

prs.title: test(cli): pin same-turn shell notification delivery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds a Session-level regression test for same-turn background shell delivery. The test completes a shell notification while the registering turn's first model stream is active, then verifies that the result reaches the next model request without starting an automatic notification turn or leaving an active-work hold behind.

The production fix was merged in #16125. This test closes the remaining review gap by pinning the consumer-side wiring that makes that fix effective.

## Why it's needed

The existing registry tests verify that completed shells carry the registering turn in notification metadata. They do not exercise the Session callback that forwards that value or the current-turn consumer that decides when to deliver the result. Removing the one-line forwarding from Session restores the delayed-delivery bug while the registry tests remain green.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused Session test:

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts \
  -t 'consumes a same-turn shell result without an automatic rerun'
```

Expected: one test passes. The test observes two model calls, finds `SAME_TURN_SHELL_RESULT` in the second request, and confirms `_qwencode/start_turn` was not called.

### Evidence (Before & After)

With the current Session shell callback, the focused test passes:

```text
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       1 passed | 1380 skipped (1381)
```

As a bounded negative control, removing `sourceTurnId: meta.sourceTurnId` from the Session shell enqueue makes the same test fail at the intended assertion:

```text
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 2 times, but got 1 times
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Vitest 3.2.7, one focused test with coverage disabled. Existing workspace dependencies were reused; no install or build was run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none to runtime behavior; this PR changes tests only.
- Not validated / out of scope: local Windows/Linux execution. CI remains responsible for cross-platform coverage.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

References #16119 and follows up #16125.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这个 PR 为同 turn 后台 shell 结果送达补上 Session 层回归测试。用例在注册 shell 的 turn 第一次模型流仍运行时触发完成通知，然后确认结果进入下一次模型请求，同时没有启动自动通知 turn，也没有残留 active-work hold。

生产修复已经在 #16125 合入。这个测试补上合并前评审指出的另一半：锁定让修复真正生效的消费侧接线。

## 为什么需要

现有注册表测试只能证明 shell 完成通知携带了注册 turn，没有覆盖 Session 把该字段转发进通知队列的路径，也没有覆盖只消费当前 turn 通知的消费者。删除 Session 里的一行转发后，延迟送达缺陷会回来，但注册表测试仍然全绿。

## 验证方式

从 `packages/cli` 运行上面的单测命令。预期一个用例通过：测试观察到两次模型调用，第二次请求包含 `SAME_TURN_SHELL_RESULT`，并确认没有调用 `_qwencode/start_turn`。

当前代码上，聚焦用例 1/1 通过。作为有界的负向对照，在临时副本中删除 Session shell 入队时的 `sourceTurnId: meta.sourceTurnId`，同一用例会在预期断言处失败：期望 `spy` 被调用两次，实际一次。

本地只验证了 macOS；Windows 和 Linux 由 CI 覆盖。没有安装依赖或执行构建。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：没有运行时行为变化，本 PR 只改测试。
- 未验证 / 范围外：本地 Windows/Linux 执行。
- 破坏性变更：无。

关联 #16119，并跟进 #16125。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): deliver accepted cross-session messages at tool-round boundaries (opt-in)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in setting that lets an accepted cross-session message reach the model between tool rounds of a running turn instead of waiting for the receiving session to go idle, and gives those messages their own line in the terminal so they are not mistaken for the notices a session emits about itself. Today every accepted message from another Qwen Code session is parked until that session is idle, so a message sent to steer a busy agent — the main reason anyone sends one — is read only after the work it was meant to correct has finished. Delivery then requires two independent consents: the sending session must mark the message as immediate, and the receiving session must have the setting on. Neither alone is enough. A message sent without that mark still arrives at the end of the turn, exactly as it does today.

## Why it's needed

The wire protocol already carries a delivery-urgency field, documented as carried for a future interrupt path while today the receiver queues both priorities for the next turn. Nothing wrote or read that field, so this is that path built on the field rather than on a new parallel notion — which is what keeps the property the current design is protecting: urgency is a claim a sender makes about its own message, and only the receiver's settings decide whether it is honoured. #9638 already delivers teammate reports at these same boundaries, so the receiving session has one shape for "something arrived mid-turn that is not my user talking".

Peer-initiated work is not free for the receiving session. In a live two-session run, a peer question that nothing the receiving user had asked for still cost that session a long thought, a couple of shell calls and a reply — handled correctly, and billed to the party who never asked. That is why the widening gets its own ceiling rather than being unconditional, and why the defaults leave today's behaviour untouched.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run two sessions from source (`node scripts/dev.js` in two terminals, same machine). In `~/.qwen/settings.json` of the session that will receive, set `agents.crossSessionMessaging: true`, `agents.crossSessionInbound: "accept"`, `agents.crossSessionMidTurn: true`, and `agents.crossSessionMidTurnBudget: 3`, then start both sessions so the flags are picked up.

1. In the receiving session, run several **separate** shell tool calls that each take a few seconds (for example five individual `sleep 8` commands — one chained command gives a single boundary, and nothing appears to happen).
2. From the other session, send a message with the urgency mark. Expected: the receiving session shows an attributed line while its turn is still running, and addresses the instruction inside that same turn instead of after it.
3. Send a second message without the urgency mark. Expected: it waits and is read when the turn ends — the control case, and the old behaviour for both.
4. Send more than the budget allows inside five minutes. Expected: a notice that mid-turn delivery is paused for the window, and the excess still arriving when the turn ends rather than disappearing.
5. Queue a message in the receiving session, receive a peer message, queue another. Expected: the second prompt the user typed does not overtake the peer envelope that was waiting first.
6. Turn `agents.crossSessionMidTurn` off and repeat step 2. Expected: the marked message waits for the turn boundary like any other.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Both lines below are captured output — each item rendered through the real history component by the project's own test harness, with the peer text produced by the actual projection formatter rather than typed here (the two-space indent is the history gutter):

```
  ⇄︎ Message from another session (session-a): stop and re-check the lease
  ●︎ Background agent completed
```

The peer message is the first line. Before this change it rendered with the same filled-circle prefix as the ordinary notification on the second line, so the two were distinguishable only by reading the text — every notification shared one component. The second line is the unchanged control. Note the trailing variation selector on each glyph: that is the existing narrow-presentation convention in `ICON`, which keeps the prefix column one cell wide.

Behaviour is the other half of the evidence, and it is what the setting actually buys: with the setting on and the sender marking the message immediate, the first line appears while the receiving turn is still running and the agent addresses the instruction inside that same turn (steps 1-3 above), rather than after it. Verified in a live two-session run on macOS. Screenshots not attached.
Steps 1-6 above were verified in a live two-session run on macOS. Unit level: `useMessageQueue`, `use-llm-stream`, `AppContainer` (including a new `usePeerMidTurnDrain` block covering the setting gate, the stale-recipient case, budget deferral, the throttled notice and restore-then-refund), `peer-messaging`, `settingsSchema`, `settingsUtils`, `HistoryItemDisplay` — 831 tests in `packages/cli` and 199 in `packages/core` pass, with `tsc --noEmit`, eslint and prettier clean. A full `packages/cli` run reports 21 failures that are byte-identical on pristine `main` (same 12 files, same 21 tests), so pre-existing here rather than introduced.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment

Source checkout run with `node scripts/dev.js`; terminal UI (ink). No sandbox involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an accepted message can now redirect work already in flight, which bears on the agenda-control concern raised in #10925 more sharply than delivery at an idle boundary does. Two mitigations are load-bearing and worth reading together. First, whether a message is accepted at all is unchanged — this PR touches timing only, and the acceptance path never sees the urgency field. Second, the setting is off by default and a workspace settings file can only tighten either setting, never loosen it. One caveat that predates this PR and is made more visible by it: parity rests on a sender-declared review class that nothing authenticates, so two sessions running in a non-reviewing approval mode accept each other by default. With mid-turn delivery on, that pair can keep a machine busy with nobody reviewing the actions. Set `agents.crossSessionInbound` to `hold` if that is not what you want. The budget bounds interruptions, not cost: a deferred message costs the same once the turn ends, and a bound on peer-initiated work rather than on peer deliveries is the follow-up this really wants.
- Not validated / out of scope: only the terminal UI reads the new settings, so the other frontends ignore them (they do not accept inbound peer messages today either). Only the tool-round boundary is wired — a message arriving during a long generation with no tool calls still waits for the session to go idle. One envelope is taken per boundary. The survival of a mid-turn delivery across `/clear` or `/resume` follows the existing boundary path and is covered by that path's shape rather than by a test of its own. The urgency parameter is not yet documented in the commands reference.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no default changes and nothing is removed — both new settings ship off/at their conservative value, and a message sent without the urgency mark behaves exactly as it does today. Two changes are, though, live for anyone who has peer messaging on (which is the default) and are NOT gated behind the new setting: an accepted peer line now renders with its own prefix instead of the ordinary notification bullet, and the idle drain no longer lets text typed after a waiting peer message batch ahead of it. The second one fixes a real pre-existing ordering bug. Both are visual/ordering only; neither delivers a message that was not already being delivered, and neither reaches a session that has peer messaging off.

## Linked Issues

Relates to #9638 (teammate reports delivered at these boundaries), #9576 (the inbound gate this deliberately does not touch) and #10925 (control of the session's agenda).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增一个可选开启的设置，使已被接收的跨会话消息能够在某一轮次运行期间的两次工具调用之间送达模型，而不必等到接收会话空闲；同时让这类消息在终端中拥有自己独立的行样式，以免与会话自身发出的通知混淆。目前，来自其他 Qwen Code 会话且已被接收的消息会一直保留到该会话空闲为止，因此为了引导繁忙代理而发送的消息（也是人们发送它的主要原因）只会在它本欲纠正的工作完成之后才被读取。此后送达需要两个相互独立的同意：发送方会话必须将消息标记为紧急，接收方会话必须开启该设置。两者缺一不可。未加该标记的消息仍然像今天一样，在轮次结束时送达。

## 为什么需要它

网络协议中已经存在一个表示送达紧迫性的字段，文档说明它是为将来的“中断”路径而保留，目前接收方会把两种优先级都排到下一轮。此前没有任何代码写入或读取该字段，因此本改动正是基于该字段实现那条路径，而不是另外引入一套并行的概念——这也保住了现有设计所要维护的特性：紧迫性是发送方对自己消息所作的主张，是否采纳完全由接收方的设置决定。#9638 已经在同样的边界处投递队友（teammate）报告，因此接收会话对“轮次中间到达、且并非我用户在说话的内容”只有一种处理方式。

由对端发起的工作对接收会话并非没有代价。在一次真实的双会话运行中，一个接收方用户从未要求的对端提问，仍然消耗了该会话一次很长的思考、若干次 shell 调用以及一次回复——处理得完全正确，但账记在了从没过问的人身上。正因如此，这次放宽自带一个上限而非无条件开放，也正因为如此，默认值保持现有行为不变。

### 如何验证

在同一台机器的两个终端中从源码各启动一个会话（`node scripts/dev.js`）。在作为接收方的会话的 `~/.qwen/settings.json` 中设置 `agents.crossSessionMessaging: true`、`agents.crossSessionInbound: "accept"`、`agents.crossSessionMidTurn: true` 以及 `agents.crossSessionMidTurnBudget: 3`，然后重新启动两个会话以使配置生效。

1. 在接收会话中运行**多个相互独立**、每个耗时数秒的 shell 工具调用（例如五条单独的 `sleep 8` 命令——若用一条串联命令则只产生一个边界，看起来就像什么都没发生）。
2. 从另一个会话发送一条带紧急标记的消息。预期：接收会话在轮次仍在运行时显示一行带署名的消息，并在同一轮次内处理该指令，而不是等到轮次之后。
3. 再发送一条不带紧急标记的消息。预期：它会等待，直到轮次结束时才被读取——这是对照组，也是两种情况下原有的行为。
4. 在五分钟窗口内发送超过预算条数的消息。预期：出现一条提示，说明本窗口的轮中间送达已暂停，并且超出的消息仍会在轮次结束时送达，而不会丢失。
5. 在接收会话中先排队一条消息，随后收到一条对端消息，再排队另一条。预期：用户后输入的提示不会越过先到的对端消息封装。
6. 关闭 `agents.crossSessionMidTurn` 并重复步骤 2。预期：带标记的消息与其他消息一样等待轮次边界。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前——所有已被接收的对端消息只在会话空闲时才出现，且其行与普通通知无法区分：

```
● Message from another session (session-a): stop and re-check the lease
● Background agent completed
```

之后——同一条消息在轮次仍在运行时到达，并被明确标注为来自其他会话：

```
⇄ Message from another session (session-a): stop and re-check the lease
● Background agent completed
```

上述步骤 1-6 已在 macOS 上的一次真实双会话运行中验证。单元层面：`useMessageQueue`、`use-llm-stream`、`AppContainer`（其中新增的 `usePeerMidTurnDrain` 覆盖了设置开关、收件方失效的情形、预算导致的延后、限频提示，以及回退与退还额度）、`peer-messaging`、`settingsSchema`、`settingsUtils`、`HistoryItemDisplay`——`packages/cli` 中 831 个测试与 `packages/core` 中 199 个测试全部通过，`tsc --noEmit`、eslint 与 prettier 均无告警。完整运行 `packages/cli` 会报告 21 个失败，它们在干净的 `main` 分支上逐字节一致（相同的 12 个文件、相同的 21 个测试），因此属于本分支之外的既有问题。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境

源码检出目录，使用 `node scripts/dev.js` 运行；终端界面（ink）。未使用沙箱。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：一条已被接收的消息现在可以改变已经在进行中的工作，这比在空闲边界送达更尖锐地触及 #10925 提出的“议程控制”担忧。有两项缓解措施是承重的，值得放在一起阅读。第一，消息是否被接收的判定完全未变——本 PR 只改变时机，而接收判定路径永远看不到紧迫性字段。第二，该设置默认关闭，并且工作区设置文件只能收紧而不能放宽这两项设置。还有一个早于本 PR、但因本改动而更显眼的缺陷：一致性判定依赖于发送方自行声明的审查级别，而该声明没有任何认证，因此两个运行在“无需审查”审批模式下的会话会默认互相接收。开启轮中间送达后，这样一对会话可以在无人审查其动作的情况下让机器持续忙碌。若这不是你想要的效果，请将 `agents.crossSessionInbound` 设为 `hold`。预算限制的是“打断次数”，而不是“开销”：一条被延后的消息在轮次结束后代价相同；而对对端发起的*工作*（而非仅送达次数）加以限制，才是这项能力真正需要的后续改进。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：只有终端界面读取这两个新设置，因此其他前端会忽略它们（这些前端目前也不接收对端入站消息）。只接通了工具调用边界——在一次没有工具调用的长时间生成期间到达的消息仍需等待会话空闲。每个边界只取走一条消息封装。轮中间送达在 `/clear` 或 `/resume` 之后的存留沿用既有边界路径的做法，其保障来自与该路径一致，而非有专门的测试。紧迫性参数尚未写入命令参考文档。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：没有默认值改变，也没有移除任何行为——两个新设置默认关闭/取保守值，未带紧迫性标记的消息与今天完全一致。但有两项改动对所有已开启对端消息（即默认状态）的用户是即时生效的，并且并未受新设置门控：已被接收的对端消息行现在使用其独立的前缀符号，而不再是普通通知的圆点；并且空闲排空路径不再允许把在对端消息之后输入的用户文本挤到该对端消息之前。第二项修复的是一个真实存在的既有排序缺陷。两者都只涉及显示与顺序：不会送达任何原本本就会送达的消息，也不会触及关闭了对端消息的会话。

## 关联 Issues

关联 #9638（队友报告在同样边界处投递）、#9576（本改动刻意未触碰的入站门控）与 #10925（会话议程的控制权）。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): enable external workspace execution
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Builds the external Workspace execution slice on top of the materialization prerequisite in #15654. The branch now includes live `hosted-workspace-external-files/1` admission, bounded and single-query Workspace discovery, authoritative registration checks, stable lifecycle refusal classification, and receipt-backed release for external Runtime bindings. The separate materialization operation still creates metadata only; it does not allocate storage or start a worker.

This revision closes the remaining review gaps in that execution slice: registration decode failures, including field-type failures, now resolve to a permanent `409 workspace_unavailable`; a malformed registration disables only its own Workspace during batch discovery; saved-provider shutdown is classified as retryable `503`; attachment actor lookup fails closed on zero, multiple, or null rows; and external lifecycle authorization preserves the exact permanent fence response.

## Why it's needed

#15512 needs a durable link from registered external storage to a Workspace that can be discovered and used safely. A Session must not become executable through a partially wired path, and one corrupt storage row must not hide every healthy Workspace on the page. The same branch also needs terminal close and recovery paths to distinguish permanent identity failures from provider availability failures.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On an isolated fresh catalog, register external storage using the loopback operator credential, materialize its alias with an owner, and verify that only the owner can discover it. Exercise Session creation after the external-files gates and a Harness lifecycle capability are available. Confirm that prompts can run, file tools remain within the external profile, and close/recovery uses the receipt-backed ownership transition without destroying a shared placement.

For the query and failure paths, corrupt one registration and confirm only that Workspace loses Session-creation eligibility while another Workspace remains visible. Confirm that an admission attempt against the corrupted Workspace returns `409 workspace_unavailable` with `retryable=false`. Shut down the saved external provider during drain-capability checks and confirm a retryable `503`. Submit a non-current lifecycle authority to the external attachment path and confirm `409 workspace_lifecycle_claim_fenced` with `retryable=false`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before this revision, a field-type error while decoding an opaque-persisted registration could escape as a mapper failure, batch discovery could fail as a whole when one row was malformed, and a shut-down saved provider was conflated with a permanent binding conflict. The candidate maps these cases explicitly, uses one registration batch read rather than per-row JDBC work inside a mapper, and keeps external lifecycle fences non-retryable.

Earlier evidence in this stack covered materialization, registration replay, and isolated MySQL validation. The newest commit was checked statically and through the repository's CI gates; no local test, build, or typecheck was run under the requested execution policy.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ static review and `git diff --check`; no heavy local execution |
| Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| Linux | ✅ repository CI for the branch; the new head is checked again after push |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the authenticated operator delegates the Workspace owner. That field is a grant target, not authenticated user identity. Existing operator and tenant checks remain required.
- Batch discovery now fails closed per malformed storage row instead of failing the whole Workspace page. A failed SQL read remains a retryable provider-unavailable verdict.
- `workspace_lifecycle_claim_fenced` remains permanent. Do not reinterpret a stale or non-current authority as a transient outage.
- Full external Hosted shell/capture, attachment widening beyond the current profile, and the Resident shared-worker behavior remain outside this PR. #16023 carries the Resident and EPHEMERAL layers.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the preceding stack extends the shared V1 catalog under the repository's pre-release fresh-catalog policy. No V2 migration is introduced here.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #15512. Related prerequisite: #15654. The Resident shared-worker increment is stacked in #16023 and must not merge before this PR.

prs.title: fix(acp): add defensive legacy NDJSON cancellation cleanup
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Add defensive cancellation cleanup to the legacy unbounded transport. Downstream cancellation forwards its reason upstream, releases the upstream reader lock, and prevents processing or closing a stream that has already been canceled. The cancellation state is checked before each complete frame, including when a message-observation hook cancels through the consumer's reader partway through a chunk. Normal EOF and malformed-JSON log-and-continue behavior remain unchanged.

## Why it's needed

The legacy and bounded transports currently differ in cancellation semantics. Directly canceling the legacy readable leaves the upstream reader locked and the pump waiting. This is a latent lifecycle gap reproduced through the public transport entry point. Current shipped callers do not exercise this cancellation branch, so the change is defensive parity for future consumers, not a demonstrated production CLI leak or hang.

Following #13082, the patch is limited to cancellation cleanup. The code records this defensive scope explicitly. Maintainer confirmation of this narrow direction remains needed before merge.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Cancel before data, after a complete message, with a pending downstream read, and immediately after queueing bytes. Expect the original reason to reach upstream once, no later frame to be enqueued, and the upstream reader lock to be released. Repeat cancellation and reject upstream cancellation; cleanup should still settle. Confirm normal EOF, malformed JSON followed by a valid message, and already-locked-input rejection retain their existing behavior.

For a slow upstream cancellation, pause its completion: downstream cancellation must stay pending while the upstream reader lock is already released. Observe enqueue attempts directly; the check must not depend on how parsing errors are logged.

Put three complete messages in one input chunk, acquire the downstream reader, and cancel through that reader from the first message's synchronous observation hook. Expect one enqueue attempt, no parse-error logs, one upstream cancellation with the original reason, and a released upstream lock. Without cancellation, all three messages must still be delivered both from a single chunk and when a message is split across chunks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent hosted Linux job checked out the exact updated head `6ff638bf37e54fe23619d1b445b01497251089b3` and installed the full frozen-lockfile workspace.

- Native Vitest: **57 passed** across the existing 44 transport cases and 13 focused cases; the runner exited successfully.
- Normal workspace build and bundle during installation: **passed**.
- Full workspace and integration typecheck: **passed**.
- Prettier and ESLint for the changed source and tests: **passed**.
- The new hook-cancellation regression fails against the previous reviewed source: **1 failed, 56 passed**. Removing only the per-frame guard also fails both the enqueue-count and console-error assertions. In each case, the measured behavior is three enqueue attempts and two error logs, versus one attempt and zero logs after the fix.
- Removing the guard while narrowing the catch to parsing still fails the direct enqueue assertion (**1 failed, 56 passed**), even though there are no parse-error logs. Keeping the guard intact with the same parsing-only catch is a green control (**57 passed**). These variants establish that the test does not depend on the broad catch producing an error log.

[Validation job and full logs](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/36760085858/job/110040128426). Temporary mutations were confined to the independent job and the exact candidate files were restored afterwards. The validation workflow is on a separate fork branch and is not included in this PR.

The [previous round's validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/36738934323/job/109967842478) also established that the strengthened lock-release and queued-frame assertions catch their specific regressions. Those assertions remain in the current suite.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| Linux | Focused native tests, build, bundle and workspace typecheck passed |
| macOS | Not tested |
| Windows | Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Hosted Ubuntu, Node 22 and repository-pinned pnpm 11.24.0, using frozen-lockfile installation.

## Risk & Scope

- Cancellation actively releases an upstream resource when a consumer actually invokes it. There is no new CLI teardown wiring.
- This is defensive parity; no production cancellation reachability or CLI E2E result is claimed.
- No protocol or public API changes, new size limits, legacy transport retirement, or error-propagation changes.
- Upstream fork workflows still need maintainer approval. The independent job does not replace that gate or the maintainer's scope decision.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13082; cancellation portion only.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动内容

为旧版无界传输补充防御性的取消清理：把取消原因转发给上游，释放上游 reader 锁，取消后不再处理后续帧或再次关闭下游流。每个完整消息帧开始前检查取消状态，覆盖消费者在同一数据块的首条消息观察钩子中通过自己的 reader 取消的情况。保持正常 EOF 和非法 JSON 记录后继续处理的行为。

## 修改原因

旧版与有界传输的取消语义存在差异。直接取消旧版 readable 时，上游 reader 仍被锁定，读取泵仍在等待。这是通过公开传输入口复现的潜在生命周期缺陷；当前发布的调用方不触发这条取消分支，因此属于面向未来调用方的防御性对齐，不宣称修复了已经观测到的生产 CLI 泄漏或挂起。

根据 #13082，仅处理取消清理，代码中也已明确说明防御性范围。合并前仍需维护者确认该最小方向。

## 审查者测试计划

### 验证方式

分别在数据到达前、完整消息后、下游读取挂起时及字节刚入队时取消。应仅向上游转发一次原始原因，停止后续入队并释放上游锁。重复取消或上游取消拒绝时，清理仍应完成。正常 EOF、非法 JSON 后接合法消息及输入已被锁定时的行为保持不变。

使上游取消保持挂起：下游取消此时应尚未完成，但上游 reader 锁应已经释放。直接观察取消后的入队尝试，避免依赖解析错误日志来判断。

在单个输入块中放入三条完整消息，先取得下游 reader，再在首条消息的同步观察钩子中通过该 reader 取消。应只有一次入队尝试、没有解析错误日志、向上游传递一次原始取消原因，并释放上游锁。不取消时，单块多消息以及消息跨块分帧均应完整交付三条消息。

### 前后证据

准确的当前提交 `6ff638bf37e54fe23619d1b445b01497251089b3` 已在完整锁定工作区中验证：44 项既有测试加 13 项针对性测试，共 **57 项原生 Vitest 测试通过**，运行器正常退出；工作区构建、打包、完整工作区与集成类型检查，以及改动源码和测试的 Prettier/ESLint 检查均通过。

新增的钩子取消回归对上一轮审查源码产生准确的 **1 项失败、56 项通过**。仅删除逐帧取消保护，也同时触发入队次数和错误日志断言：修复前为三次入队尝试、两条错误日志，修复后为一次入队尝试、零条错误日志。

同时删除保护并把捕获范围收窄到 JSON 解析时，虽然没有解析错误日志，直接入队断言仍能检出问题，结果为 **1 项失败、56 项通过**。保留保护且仅收窄解析范围的对照保持 **57 项通过**。这些变体验证表明测试不依赖宽泛 catch 输出日志。临时变体只在独立任务中使用，验证后准确恢复候选源码和测试。

[验证任务及完整日志](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/36760085858/job/110040128426)。独立验证工作流位于 fork 的单独分支，不包含在此 PR 中。

[上一轮验证](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/actions/runs/36738934323/job/109967842478)已确认补强后的锁释放与已排队数据断言能检出各自的错误变体。这些断言保留在本次测试中。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| Linux | 针对性原生测试、构建、打包及工作区类型检查通过 |
| macOS | 未测试 |
| Windows | 未测试 |

### 环境

托管 Ubuntu、Node 22、仓库锁定的 pnpm 11.24.0，使用冻结锁文件安装依赖。

## 风险与范围

- 在消费者实际取消时主动释放上游资源；没有新增 CLI 关闭接线。
- 属于防御性对齐，不宣称生产取消路径可达或 CLI 端到端测试通过。
- 不改变协议、公开 API、大小限制或错误传播方式，也不移除旧版传输。
- 上游 fork 工作流仍需维护者批准。独立验证不代替上游门禁或维护者的范围决定。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #13082，仅处理取消部分。

</details>

releases.body:
<!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 -->

## Highlights

_See the complete change list below._

## Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

## Complete Change List

### Features

- Adds a Web Shell sidebar activity view for trusted workspace conversations, showing approval/input/error states, unread completions, running work, and bulk read/archive controls. ([#16022](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16022)) by @deggs7
- Adds an "Add to Split View" option to eligible sidebar session menus in web shell, making it easier to open sessions side by side. ([#15956](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15956)) by @4ekuct25
- Adds request success rate, output speed, per-model success indicators, and distinct model colors to the Web Shell token usage panel. ([#16108](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16108)) by @qqqys
- Web Shell composer shows a dismissible Workflow chip that turns Workflow mode off, warns when tools are unavailable, and summarizes the mode in the + menu. ([#16107](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16107)) by @qqqys
- Web Shell Token Usage now plots per-request output speed, first-token latency, and failure details by model, making session performance and errors easier to inspect. ([#16111](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16111)) by @qqqys
- With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, more ACP turns, including channel prompts and Goal-proposal approvals, run on the shared loop. ([#15902](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15902)) by @qqqys
- Mods can now run prompt.submit hooks in headless runs for -p prompts and stream-json user messages, allowing prompt inspection or rewriting before submission. ([#15905](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15905)) by @qqqys
- Desktop releases now publish Fedora 44 and RHEL 10 x64 RPM installers alongside existing Linux packages. ([#16060](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16060)) by @yiliang114
- feat(web-shell): make GitHub channel configuration usable ([#16096](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16096)) by @wenshao
- feat(verify-pr): inherit --publish consent on same-session re-verification ([#16112](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16112)) by @wenshao
- feat(ci): let the PR review canary cohort carry its own endpoint ([#16130](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16130)) by @yiliang114

### Bug Fixes

- OAuth refresh lock cleanup now removes the lock only when the current process owns it, preventing exiting processes from deleting active refresh locks. ([#15661](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15661)) by @2SinceJuly
- MCP tool discovery now skips duplicate tool names but keeps all uniquely named tools, preventing one name collision from hiding an entire server's tools. ([#15757](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15757)) by @2SinceJuly
- The Web Shell Plugins page now shows a back control when the navigation rail is unavailable, letting users return to chat from compact layouts. ([#15651](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15651)) by @2SinceJuly
- LSP code-navigation queries now fail with an explicit reason when no language server is ready instead of returning empty results. ([#15946](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15946)) by @404khai
- The verify report now counts targeted gate test-suite results separately from a round's scripted assertions, making assertion totals reflect only round checks. ([#16013](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16013)) by @wenshao
- Makes long /btw answers scroll in a bounded panel with mouse wheel, Shift+Up/Down, PageUp/PageDown, and a scrollbar, while short answers remain unchanged. ([#15982](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15982)) by @2SinceJuly
- Fixes verify-pr to count each suite run as one assertion and handle skip notices on closed PRs so review rounds are not rejected with zero assertions. ([#16050](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16050)) by @wenshao
- Fixes Kimi K3 generation recognition so supported IDs use the 1,000,000-token context window, while k3-256k keeps its 256K window. ([#16048](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16048)) by @wenshao
- Fixes review command so plain-language re-review requests target the intended PR and do not misread resume flags or file-like tokens. ([#15998](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15998)) by @wenshao
- Installs DejaVu fonts in the sandbox so capture cards use the intended monospace font and render legibly. ([#16032](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16032)) by @yiliang114
- Moves the Workflow mode toggle from the composer toolbar into the composer “+” menu to reduce toolbar clutter while keeping it accessible. ([#16047](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16047)) by @qqqys
- Improves managed-agent recovery accuracy by blocking gap fills without child ledger evidence and clarifying unknown or never-started states. ([#16015](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16015)) by @wenshao
- Fixes managed-agent child result delivery status so consumed child results are no longer marked pending. ([#16074](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16074)) by @wenshao
- Fixes AI attribution notes for loosely spelled git commit --amend commands so they diff against the amended commit, not earlier commits. ([#16073](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16073)) by @yiliang114
- Makes loop-protection reminder delivery and telemetry settle only when the model request carrying the reminder is accepted, preventing premature clearing or logging. ([#15559](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15559)) by @suzhiguo7
- fix(core): don't treat fd duplication (2>&1) as a file write in shell permission checks ([#15681](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15681)) by @Suaroman
- Sanitizes goal approval text and edit-diff file paths in Web Shell by escaping control and bidi characters so displayed approval content cannot carry hidden controls. ([#16080](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16080)) by @yiliang114
- Shows Managed Session list failures as a localized Retry notice with request details and avoids the empty state until loading succeeds. ([#16082](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16082)) by @yiliang114
- Fixes invalid Javadoc left after the module split so the managed-agent release profile can build documentation again. ([#16099](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16099)) by @doudouOUC
- Moves the Web Shell managed session list failure notice below the Sessions / Archived tabs and prevents its request id from being cut off. ([#16104](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16104)) by @yiliang114
- Fixes qwen-managed-agent-upgrade start and verify so they reach the control plane and Hosted Harness using the server's resolved endpoint configuration. ([#16051](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16051)) by @wenshao
- Tightens the Web Shell mobile composer layout by aligning workspace controls, truncating long names, and centering the context-usage ring. ([#16103](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16103)) by @ytahdn
- VS Code companion session history now groups This Week by the current calendar week, so earlier sessions are placed in Older instead of incorrectly appearing under This Week. ([#16097](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16097)) by @yiliang114
- The bundled review skill now tells fetch-pr to re-run with both --since and --since-model and removes the retired range model, preventing incomplete anchors. ([#16094](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16094)) by @yiliang114
- The Managed runtime release workflow can now rebuild the missing 0.26.5 runtime from its original tag after repairing the Javadoc issue that blocked the release. ([#16114](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16114)) by @doudouOUC
- Windows installer updates now stop the bundled runtime before replacing files, reducing update failures when node.exe remains locked. ([#16071](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16071)) by @yiliang114
- Channel users can now /approve or /deny their own pending one-time tool permission requests in the current attended turn. ([#16087](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16087)) by @BenGuanRan
- Linux AppImage builds now verify required dynamic libraries are bundled or documented as host-provided, helping prevent missing-library failures. ([#16062](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16062)) by @yiliang114
- Mods that register prompt.paint or ui.place hooks now load successfully, with those unsupported hooks skipped instead of stopping startup. ([#16124](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16124)) by @qqqys
- fix(mcp): warn about disabled tool typos on every discovery path ([#16120](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16120)) by @yiliang114
- fix(managed-agent): Restore profile-owned runtime verification ([#16134](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16134)) by @doudouOUC
- fix(core): attribute background shell notifications to the registering turn ([#16125](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16125)) by @yiliang114
- fix(core): report redirects on cd segments ([#16129](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16129)) by @yiliang114

### Documentation

- Updates daemon usage documentation with current deployment, security, authenticated startup, token sidecar lifecycle, and lifecycle-command guidance. ([#16056](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16056)) by @wenshao
- Adds a README quickstart for daemon mode covering qwen serve startup, status/log/stop commands, default loopback binding, and local security warnings. ([#16053](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16053)) by @wenshao
- Updates managed-agent structure-review documentation to reflect the Runtime Broker extraction and newly separated recovery, reconciliation, and cancellation components. ([#16109](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16109)) by @wenshao
- ManagedAgentStore documentation now reflects the completed store conversion and removes outdated setter descriptions. ([#16118](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16118)) by @wenshao

### Internal Changes

- Public and WebShell Session event streams now share replay and live delivery while keeping existing payloads, event names, and delivery order. ([#15952](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15952)) by @doudouOUC
- ci: route the classify_pr gate to ECS for every pull request ([#16019](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16019)) by @yiliang114
- Adds an end-to-end test for /autofix-pr watch helpers against real git and a fake gh to improve automated fix reliability. ([#16017](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16017)) by @wenshao
- Adds a managed-agent contract test asserting A3 sibling call binding and approval snapshot consistency, with no production behavior change. ([#15995](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15995)) by @wang1408
- Makes Windows preview installer tests run reliably through cmd.exe so nightly results are reported correctly. ([#16028](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16028)) by @yiliang114
- Improves managed-agent broker reliability by separating runtime execution workflows. ([#16029](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16029)) by @doudouOUC
- Makes managed-agent session store initialization safer by using constructor dependency injection. ([#16061](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16061)) by @doudouOUC
- test(managed-agent): gate the expired-cursor resync answer ([#16076](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16076)) by @wenshao
- Refactors Managed Agent runtime execution to centralize dispatch, cancellation, and completion tracking in an internal dispatcher. ([#16084](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16084)) by @doudouOUC
- Adds a Managed Agent test verifying mcp-release refusal and same-id retry behavior when a session uses two MCP servers. ([#16089](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16089)) by @wenshao
- Adds a managed-agent test verifying detach is refused while a tool result is unknown and the session remains attached. ([#16098](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16098)) by @wenshao
- Reconnects Hosted fault probes to current execution owners so managed-agent tests observe dispatch, cancellation, and delayed replies accurately. ([#16101](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16101)) by @doudouOUC
- Settings documentation now matches the runtime schema, and memory.enableAutoSkill and security.auth.useExternal are correctly shown as false. ([#16085](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16085)) by @yiliang114
- Windows installation PATH persistence is now protected by a contract test, reducing the chance that a fresh install fails to remain on PATH. ([#16072](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16072)) by @yiliang114
- Managed Agent storage was reorganized into Agent and Session stores without changing user-visible behavior. ([#16090](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16090)) by @doudouOUC
- refactor(managed-agent): trim store delegation boilerplate ([#16142](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16142)) by @doudouOUC

issues.body:
> **Status at 0.10.1** (re-triaged 2026-10-08): partly done. Filed against Computer Use plugin 0.8.x era; Engine 0.9.14 development tree, filed 2026-09-17 (body updated through 2026-10-04).
>
> **What remains**
>
> * Clean-machine acceptance through each door (website app, marketplace plugin, source checkout) to a working background TextEdit observe-act-verify loop; none is recorded at the tag.
> * One install narrative: same version, same grant troubleshooting, same `request_access` verify step across crates/tui/plugins/computer-use/README.md, the marketplace copy and the website page.
> * Website source change is human-gated; prepare it but do not deploy.
> * Move the long claim log out of the issue body; the work is mostly in codewhale-cu-plugin and codewhale-plugin-marketplace, not the Engine.
>
> **Checked in the 0.10.1 source**
>
> * Built-in Computer Use keeps its review and enablement across upgrades in 0.10.1 (CHANGELOG.md:757-762, cites #6303; commits 94514a866e and a518b2f9b4).
> * The Engine vendors the published upstream release: commits 655ad3ea29 (0.11.3) and c84b50d60b (0.12.0); the tag carries 0.12.1 (crates/tui/plugins/computer-use/package.json:3, plugin.json:4; [CHANGELOG.md:42](<http://CHANGELOG.md:42>)).
> * The Engine captures MCP `initialize.instructions` so the plugin's own guide reaches the model: commit ac9ce1fe83; crates/tui/src/mcp.rs:2236-2238 and :2822-2824.
> * The packaged skill and three references are in the bundle: crates/tui/plugins/computer-use/skills/computer-use/SKILL.md and references/{operating-details,quick-reference,refusal-codes}.md.
> * The bundled README documents the embedded-helper door and `request_access` as the readiness check (crates/tui/plugins/computer-use/README.md:21-27) but says nothing about the website app or marketplace doors, and states that discovery tests are not an installed model-driven trial (README.md:103-104).
> * Version text disagrees inside the 0.10.1 changelog: [CHANGELOG.md:42](<http://CHANGELOG.md:42>) says the bundled plugin is 0.12.1 while [CHANGELOG.md:1235](<http://CHANGELOG.md:1235>) says 0.12.0.

---

Installing Computer Use should be smooth from all three doors, and today each door tells a different story:

1. Website Mac app download ([codewhale.net/computer-use](<http://codewhale.net/computer-use>)) — the signed .app with bundled helper; needs Accessibility + Screen Recording grants with a guided path when missing.
2. Marketplace plugin (codewhale-plugin-marketplace plugins/computer-use) — install/enable/trust flow inside CodeWhale; must land on the same helper + grants without a second ceremony.
3. GitHub repo (Hmbown/codewhale-cu-plugin) — source checkout: npm test, build:app/install:app, MCP stdio wiring for other hosts (muse bundle pattern), dev prerequisites.

Work: audit what each surface says and does today; converge on one install narrative (same version truth, same grant troubleshooting, same verify step — e.g. request_access receipt); fix the repo-side surfaces in this project (README quickstart, DISTRIBUTION/RELEASE_CHECKLIST, marketplace install copy); prepare website source changes for human-gated deploy (gh workflow run web.yml — never deploy from this work).

Acceptance sketch: a clean-machine user coming through any one door reaches a working background TextEdit observe-act-verify loop following only that door's instructions, with every failure naming the missing piece (app vs grant vs host), and all three doors agree on the current version and the verify receipt.

## Implementation claim — 2026-09-29

Founder authorized implementing the Computer Use investigation and preparing Codewhale for Chrome for Chrome Web Store publication. Executing owner: Codex root, current shared checkouts, no new worktrees.

Planned slices: (1) short operating guides delivered with capability discovery, trusted companion references and recorded model context; (2) coherent existing-helper/plugin readiness and explicit local-app / signed-in-Chrome / isolated-browser selection; (3) Chrome tab targeting, task-owned tabs, frame-aware observation/action and dependable interactions while preserving origin grants, sensitive-field checks, cancellation and stop; (4) distribution parity, release package, privacy/listing assets and store submission.

Initial exact write claim: codewhale-cu-plugin/skills/computer-use/\*\*, mcp/server.mjs, src/tools.mjs, tests/mcp-skills.test.mjs; codewhale-plugin-marketplace/plugins/computer-use mirrored equivalents; codewhale-plugin-marketplace/plugins/chromewhale/{skills/chromewhale/SKILL.md,mcp/server.mjs,src/tools.mjs,extension/src/browser.js,extension/src/panel.js,extension/src/page.js,extension/panel.html,extension/panel.css,tests/browser.test.mjs,tests/page.test.mjs,tests/server.test.mjs,README.md,package.json,plugin.json,kimi.plugin.json,extension/manifest.json,scripts/build-store.mjs,tests/store.test.mjs} and Chrome listing documentation/assets. Engine and GPUI paths will be claimed after checking current owners; active Engine CI qualification branch and its running build are preserved.

The repository contract that model-visible input must be persisted is required acceptance: automatically supplied guides must use existing logged context/tool-result paths with identity/digest evidence, and persisted content must match what the model receives. No unlogged prompt injection or weakened audit contract.

Store owner account requested from founder; no account, terms, payment or publication step has been taken. Source/local/protocol checks, actual model-driven GUI behavior, hosted CI, submitted review and public availability will be reported separately.

Scope update — 2026-09-29: founder said to ignore the Chrome Web Store/account portion for now. Publication, publisher setup, store assets and submission are deferred. Continue the computer-use/plugin guidance, setup and Chrome usability implementation; no store account answer is needed for this work.Implementation paths added (2026-09-29): Engine crates/tui/src/mcp.rs, crates/tui/src/mcp/tests.rs, crates/tui/src/core/engine/turn_loop.rs and its tests, crates/tui/src/plugins/builtin.rs, and mirrored crates/tui/plugins/computer-use runtime/skill tests. Plan: preserve standard MCP initialize.instructions as bounded, server-attributed guidance; append through add_session_message before request from policy-filtered connected catalog, dedup against surviving history so resume/compaction remain correct. This uses the existing session-update event/persistence path and never changes tool permissions or the frozen prompt prefix. MCP resources provide exact packaged skill/reference bytes under existing reviewed source validation. Chrome Web Store work remains deferred.

Ownership correction from founder (2026-09-29): fix/mcp-server-instructions owns Engine's guidance consumption, logging and lifecycle implementation. This computer-use chat removed ALL its Engine-source and embedded-bundle edits; the Engine checkout is clean. Work here is limited to the Computer Use MCP producer/skills/resources and marketplace Chrome changes. Downstream Engine bundle vendoring (including new operating-details reference inventory) is a handoff dependency, not a competing implementation. No Engine tests/build will be run by this chat.

This slice will vendor those two exact upstream files with the new guide so its .upstream-sha describes an actual byte-identical mirror. No new Darwin behavior is authored here. The marketplace extension overview and its source seal (whalewiki/pages/extensions.md and whalewiki/manifest.json) also require refresh for the new tool contract. The wiki gate detected stale Chrome/version claims, including preexisting generation-15 source drift. These two documentation paths are included; no Engine skills or runtime changes.

Chrome adds explicit tab/frame targets and session/document-bound action handles. Engine edits were removed; fix/mcp-server-instructions retains sole ownership of host ingestion, model delivery and embedded vendoring. Preserve its existing capture/runtime protections while bringing in the new guide/reference.

Local evidence: canonical npm test 389 passed / 18 skipped / 0 failed; focused resource suite 11 passed. Marketplace npm test 688 passed / 18 skipped / 0 failed; check:web 13 passed / 9 expected mobile-extension skips / 0 failed. Catalog, wiki (3 fresh) and package builds pass. Two native recording fixtures timed out in concurrent repository runs; 7/7 focused and both full sequential reruns passed without runtime changes. Marketplace bytes match canonical; full three-tree sync fails on Engine-only/different runtime files and is not claimed green. Hosted CI is pending. No ordinary toolbar onboarding, real-provider first loop, packaged-app acceptance, native setup UI, release or Chrome Store publication claim. Keep this issue open for integration/acceptance.

## Cua parity producer claim — 2026-10-04
